f23a5a78.title: Cloud AI Engineer, Technical Onboarding Center
f23a5a78.description:
In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process.
  
  
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following:
**Bengaluru, Karnataka, India; Hyderabad, Telangana, India; Gurgaon, Haryana, India; Pune, Maharashtra, India**
.
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 6 years of experience in software engineering, enterprise cloud architecture, or technical consulting
* 3 years of experience in advanced AI/ML architecture, deploying generative AI applications, intelligent agents, or LLM-powered solutions globally.
* Experience in Python including implementation and deployment of tiered microservices applications.
* Experience deploying production-grade cloud infrastructure or architecting and building cloud-based data solutions (e.g., enterprise data warehouses, data lakes, data pipelines, and associated technologies).

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Master’s degree or PhD in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related field.
* Experience pioneering multimodal AI solutions (text, image, video, and voice) to solve novel, previously unsolved enterprise workflow challenges.
* Experience with AI security, Large Language Model (LLM) governance, enterprise guardrails, and global compliance requirements (e.g., data privacy regulations, data sovereignty).
* Ability to architect highly resilient, globally distributed Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems and securely connecting LLMs with disparate legacy enterprise databases.
* Recognized industry thought leadership (e.g., patents, published research, keynotes) in Generative AI, agentic workflows, or large-scale cloud data infrastructure.

**About The Job**
The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.
  
  
As a Cloud AI Engineer, you will play a key leadership role in ensuring that strategic customers have the best experience adopting Gemini Enterprise alongside the broader Google Cloud Agentic AI suite of products. You will design and implement robust, production-ready application architectures to support customer use cases, leveraging Gemini Enterprise and core Google AI products. You will work with customers to identify opportunities to transform their workflows with autonomous agents, actively removing technical barriers to ensure successful deployment and high adoption rates of Gemini Enterprise. You will have access to Google’s technology to monitor application performance, debug and troubleshoot complex agent behaviors, and address customer and partner needs. In this role, you will lead the end-to-end and timely execution of adopting Google Cloud Platform solutions to the customer.
  
  
Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead and oversee the global delivery and implementation of Gemini Enterprise solutions, utilizing Agent Development Kits (ADKs) to solve highly complex, enterprise-scale technical challenges.
* Serve as the trusted technical advisor to C-suite executives at Google’s most strategic global accounts, shaping their overarching AI strategy and accelerating the adoption of Gemini Enterprise.
* Influence the core product roadmap by translating complex architectural challenges into actionable requirements for Google's engineering teams.
* Deliver leading practice recommendations and high-stakes technical presentations to executive boards and key business stakeholders to secure massive-scale technical wins.
* Act as a thought leader and mentor across the Google Cloud organization, elevating the technical acumen of engineers and shaping best practices for agentic AI architectures.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

c97d6382.title: Consultant - Cloud Operations
c97d6382.description:
Join us at Orange Business!
  
  
We are a network and digital integrator that understands the entire value chain of the digital world, freeing our customers to focus on the strategic initiatives that shape their business.
  
  
Every day, you will collaborate with a team dedicated to providing consistent, sustainable global solutions, no matter where our customers operate. With over 30,000 employees across Asia, the Americas, Africa, and Europe, we offer a dynamic environment to develop and perfect your skills in a field filled with exciting challenges and opportunities.
  
  
**About The Role**
Be at the forefront of cloud innovation by collaborating with international customers to deliver tailored solutions and enhance operational excellence in a virtual, multi-stakeholder environment.
  
  

* Engage proactively with international customers to understand and address their cloud operational requirements through customized solutions.
* Collaborate seamlessly with internal teams to support the integration and delivery of cloud services, ensuring consistent service quality.
* Identify and resolve technical issues efficiently, applying methodical problem-solving techniques to maintain service continuity.
* Operate effectively within a virtual environment, coordinating with stakeholders across various time zones to support cloud operations.
* Manage unexpected challenges calmly and strategically to ensure prompt resolution and minimal operational impact.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives aimed at enhancing operational processes and overall service performance.

**About You**
You are a knowledgeable professional with over 7 years of experience in cloud operations and virtualization technologies, holding a graduate degree in science, engineering (BE/B Tech), or M.Sc. IT. Your strong technical skills include advanced knowledge of vCloud Director, VMware ESXi and vSphere, NSX-T, along with hands-on experience with key infrastructure such as Dell and Cisco chassis, complemented by a solid understanding of public cloud environments including Azure. You combine expertise in Linux and automation tools with clear communication and effective customer engagement skills, consistently adapting solutions to meet evolving needs.
  
  
**Your professional skills:**

* Demonstrate advanced management and configuration skills in vCloud Director environments to optimize cloud operations.
* Apply in-depth technical expertise in VMware ESXi and vSphere, including proficiency in vCenter and ESXi management tasks.
* Utilize comprehensive knowledge of NSX-T to implement and manage advanced network virtualization features.
* Experience with hardware including Dell M1000 Chassis and M630, Cisco UCS, and HPE chassis to support infrastructure needs.
* Apply understanding of public cloud platforms, particularly Microsoft Azure, to design and maintain effective cloud solutions.
* Exhibit proficiency in Linux operating systems and automation tools to streamline cloud service management.
* Communicate clearly and effectively with customers and team members to foster understanding and collaboration.
* Provide proactive customer support that ensures positive experiences and addresses client concerns efficiently.
* Adapt problem-solving approaches as required by changing environments to maintain stable cloud operations.
* Collaborate with colleagues to advance team objectives and share knowledge for mutual benefit.

**Your soft skills:**

* Contributes to team success through cooperation and knowledge sharing across functions.
* Communicates ideas and technical information clearly to diverse audiences.
* Responds flexibly to changing priorities and operational requirements.
* Maintains a professional and approachable demeanor when interacting with stakeholders.
* Demonstrates persistence in resolving challenges while maintaining composure.

Join Orange as a Consultant in cloud operations and engage in shaping the future of cloud technologies on an international scale. Here, you will apply your expertise to provide practical, client-focused solutions while working within a collaborative and dynamic team setting. The role offers the opportunity to continuously expand technical knowledge and contribute to operational excellence, supporting a culture of learning and innovation aligned with Orange’s values of integrity and respect.
  
  
**What We Offer**

* Global Opportunities: Work in multi-national teams with opportunity to collaborate with colleagues and customers from all over the world.
* Flexible Work Environment: Flexible working hours and possibility to combine work from office and home (hybrid ways of working).
* Professional Development: training programs and upskilling/re-skilling opportunities.
* Career Growth: Internal growth and mobility opportunities within Orange.
* Caring and Daring Culture: Health and well-being programs and benefits, diversity & inclusion initiatives, CSR and employee connect events.
* Reward Programs: Employee Referral Program, Change Maker Awards.

**Only Your Skills Matter**
Regardless of your age, gender identity, race, ethnic origin, religion/belief, sexual orientation, marital status, neuroatypia, disability, veteran status or appearance, we encourage diversity within our teams because it is a strength for the collective and a vector of innovation. Orange Group is a disabled-friendly company and equal opportunity employer: don't hesitate to tell us about your specific needs.

cdefff34.title: Senior MDM Service Delivery Manager
cdefff34.description:
**Life Unlimited.** At Smith & Nephew (S+N) is a large multinational Medical Technology organization with an extensive Enterprise Applications ecosystem to run end-to-end business operations. Master Data Management (MDM) is at the core of this ecosystem to create, govern and maintain trusted master records, and to establish a single source of truth across the enterprise. At S+N, Syndigo and Alation are our primary MDM and data governance platforms, amongst others. These MDM systems are tightly integrated with ERPs, other best-in-class enterprise systems such as PLM (Windchill), Data Warehouse (Snowflake), CRM (Salesforce), HR (Workday), and also external regulatory and marketplace platforms like GDSN.

**What will you be doing?**  
We are seeking a Senior Service Delivery Manager (SDM) for MDM who is responsible for end-to-end service delivery, operations and continuous improvement of Master Data Management (MDM).

The SDM owns the service lifecycle from Inception to Build through Run. This role ensures platform stability, data integrity and data quality while driving governance, vendor management, and roadmap execution.

The role serves as the primary interface between business stakeholders, data governance, IT, and external partners to ensure the MDM platform supports business growth, digital transformation, and data-driven decision-making.

This role is also expected to prepare for our strategic ERP transition to SAP S/4HANA.

**What will you need to be successful?**  
Service Delivery & Operational Excellence (30%), Platform Ownership, Strategy & Roadmap (20%), Program Delivery & Transformation Leadership (20%), Vendor, Partner & Commercial Management (15%), Continuous Improvement (15%).
  
  
**Education:** Bachelor's degree in information systems, Computer Science, Data Management, or related field. Master's degree preferred.
  
Experience: 10+ years in data platforms, MDM, or enterprise applications. 5+ years in a service delivery, platform owner, or product owner role.

  

**You Unlimited.**

We believe in crafting the greatest good for society. Our strongest investments are in our people and the patients we serve.

**Inclusion + Belonging:** Committed to Welcoming, Celebrating and Thriving., Learn more about Employee Inclusion Groups on our website ( https://www.smith-nephew.com/ ).

**Other reasons why you will love it here!**

* **Your Future:** Major medical coverage + policy exclusions and insurance non-medical limit. Educational Assistance.
* **Work/Life Balance** : Flexible Personal/Vacation Time Off, Privilege Leave, Floater Leave.
* **Flexibility** : Hybrid Work Model (For most professional roles)
* **Your Wellbeing:** Parents/Parents-in-Law’s Insurance (Employer Contribution of 8,000/- annually), Employee Assistance Program, Parental Leave.
* **Training:** Hands-On, Team-Customized, Mentorship.

Stay connected by joining our Talent Community .

We're more than just a company - we're a community! Follow us on LinkedIn to see how we support and empower our employees and patients every day.

Check us out on Glassdoor for a glimpse behind the scenes and a sneak peek into **You. Unlimited.** , life, culture, and benefits at S+N.

f1ef795c.title: Program Manager
f1ef795c.description:
**Project Manager JD**

**About FinacPlus**

FinacPlus is a Great Place to Work® Certified organization — a recognition of our people first culture, collaborative environment, and focus on professional growth. We provide high-end virtual business process and technology services to leading global clients across finance, banking, mortgage, research, and data services. At FinacPlus, you’ll work with world-class talent, cutting-edge technology, and international stakeholders — while still enjoying the openness, agility, and career visibility of a fast-growing company.

**About Our Client — Toorak Capital Partners**

You will be part of a dedicated engineering team supporting Toorak Capital Partners, a leading U.S.-based integrated correspondent lending platform that funds residential, multifamily, and mixed-use real estate loans across the U.S. and U.K. Headquartered in Summit, New Jersey, Toorak’s leadership team brings deep expertise across real estate lending, capital markets, securitization, asset management, and credit. To date, Toorak-funded projects have renovated or stabilized housing for 9,000+ families — averaging 500+ families every month.This is a rare opportunity to build mission-critical, cloud-based mortgage technology platforms that directly support one of the most respected players in the global mortgage finance industry.

**Forget Everything You Know About Project Management**

This isn't a role for someone who lives in status meetings and colour-coded Gantt charts. We need a delivery leader who thinks in systems, moves in sprints, and makes hard calls — fast.

**The Mission**

Own the end-to-end delivery of complex, high-stakes tech initiatives — across web applications, APIs, and operational platforms — from the first line of discovery to the final push to production. You're not a coordinator. You're the force that keeps engineering, product, and QA moving as one.

**What You'll Drive**

* Architect and own the delivery rhythm — sprint planning, release cadences, and retrospective loops — with precision and intent.
* Lead cross-functional squads through full-SDLC cycles: design, build, test, deploy, ship, repeat.
* Operate as the risk radar — surface dependencies, call out blockers, and execute mitigation before the team feels the friction.
* Translate technical complexity into sharp, audience-ready narratives — from engineering standups to C-suite briefings.
* Own the metrics. Analyse velocity trends, delivery gaps, and sprint health to continuously push performance forward.
* Govern the backlog ruthlessly — every undelivered feature has a home, a plan, and an owner.
* Partner with PMO and senior leadership to drive trade-off decisions with clarity and speed.

**What You Bring**

* **6–10 years**
  owning tech delivery in fast-moving, high-growth environments — startup DNA preferred.
* Deep command of Agile: Scrum, Kanban, sprint execution, and release governance — not just the theory.
* A track record of leading delivery of web applications, APIs, and operational tools from kick-off to production — steering teams, not writing code.
* The instinct to lead without authority — aligning engineers, designers, and product owners around a shared outcome.
* Surgical communication: you make complex delivery information crisp, clear, and impossible to ignore.
* Pioneer AI-driven process innovation across teams and platforms — reimagining how delivery works, not just automating how it's reported.
* Proficient in Jira, Confluence, and the Microsoft Office suite.
* Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or Information Systems — or the scars to prove equivalent experience.

**Bonus Points**

* CSM or equivalent Scrum Master/Project Manager certification.
* Experience in fintech, mortgage tech, or regulated financial services.

**Why This Role Will Challenge You**

You won't be managing projects. You'll be managing outcomes — in an environment where priorities shift, timelines compress, and the bar keeps rising. If you've been the calmest person in the room when everything is on fire, and the sharpest thinker when the roadmap needs rebuilding from scratch — this is your seat.

**Why Join FinacPlus?**

✔ Great Place to Work® Certified — collaborative, inclusive culture

✔ Exposure to global financial technology platforms

✔ Work with senior stakeholders across India, U.S. & U.K.

✔ Hybrid working with flexibility & work-life balance

✔ Competitive compensation and growth opportunities

✔ Opportunity to shape enterprise-grade products that create real-world impact

**We're not looking for someone who fits the mould. We're looking for someone who breaks it.**

**Only Immediate Joiners can apply. Candidates who are currently serving their notice period with 15 days or less remaining are also eligible to apply.**

**Location:**
Bangalore | Manyata Tech Park

**Timings:**
11:00 AM – 8:00 PM IST

**Compensation:**
Best in Industry

f9a2a3e3.title: Customer Engagement Manager – AI Data Centers
f9a2a3e3.description:
**Job Title: Customer Engagement Manager – AI Data Centers**

**Location: Mumbai / Hybrid.**

**Department: Commercial & Client Solutions / Enterprise Delivery**

**Reports To: AI Datacenter Head / SVP / Director of Customer Engagement & Commercial Delivery**

**Position Overview**

We are seeking a technically adept, client-facing Customer Engagement Manager to serve as the primary strategic interface between our internal design, construction, and operations teams and our hyperscale / enterprise AI clients.

You will lead the end-to-end customer journey—from technical deal structuring and site design customization through core & shell build tracking, liquid cooling layout sign-offs, and final data hall handover. This role requires an individual who can bridge the gap between high-level commercial relationship management and deep technical requirements for 100 kW to 150 kW+ per rack GPU deployments.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Technical Client Onboarding & Design Alignment

Requirement Translation: Act as the direct liaison between customer engineering teams and internal Design/MEP leads to translate high-density AI hardware roadmaps (NVIDIA H100/B200/GB200 clusters) into facility design specifications.

Liquid Cooling & Density Sign-Offs: Guide clients through core & shell layouts, secondary fluid loop handoffs, CDU placement preferences, and in-rack power/cooling boundaries (100 kW–150 kW+ per rack).

Service Level Agreements (SLAs): Co-author and refine technical SLAs, Power Usage Effectiveness (PUE) guarantees, and environmental operating parameters within customer leases.

2. Project Buildout & Delivery Governance

Milestone Reporting: Provide enterprise clients with transparent progress updates across Civil/PEB milestones, MEP fit-out, long-lead equipment delivery, and Level 1–5 commissioning sequences.

Customer Change Management: Manage client-requested scope changes, evaluate cost and schedule impacts with the PMO team, and oversee execution of technical variation orders.

Audit & Inspection Facilitation: Organize and lead client technical teams through factory acceptance testing (FAT), field site walk-throughs, and Level 5 Integrated Systems Testing (IST) validations.

3. Relationship Management & Retention

Single Point of Contact (SPOC): Serve as the trusted single point of contact for customer escalations, schedule alignments, and operational readiness reviews.

Post-Handover Transition: Facilitate smooth transitions from construction/commissioning leads to live facility operations teams, ensuring client fit-out and server rack deployment start on time.

**Qualifications & Requirements**

Experience: 8–12+ years in technical customer account management, solutions engineering, or project delivery within hyperscale data centers or cloud infrastructure.

Technical Core: Solid understanding of data center design, direct-to-chip liquid cooling, power distribution (UPS/Busways), and high-density AI rack specifications.

Client Management: Proven track record managing C-suite, engineering, and procurement executives at major hyperscale (cloud) providers or large AI technology enterprises.

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Science, or Business/Construction Management.

Key Skills: SLA/MSA contract negotiation, technical client presentation, project progress reporting, change order negotiation, and cross-functional team leadership.

Get a taste of how Grab really works, behind the scenes. You will create and maintain the delivery roadmap for the teams you work with, along with the respective Tech and Product Leaders. You will also get to define the way of driving these programs and always find ways of improving this process in a data-driven manner.
  
  
You will report to a Senior Technical Program Management Leader, and will be based onsite in our Bangalore office.
  
  
**The Day-to-Day Activities**

* The "Builder Mentality" (Core Mindset)

The successful candidate must embody a "builder mentality," which we define as:
  
  

* Ownership: You don't wait for directives; you identify gaps in dependencies, communication, or process and create the structure to bridge them.
* Execution over Internal Dynamics: In complex, multi-stakeholder environments, you prioritize tangible outcomes and efficient execution over navigating office dynamics.
* Driving Momentum: You are an engine for progress. And move projects forward even when initial requirements are undefined or imperfect.
* Systematic Execution: You build repeatable, scalable execution systems rather than relying on "heroics" to get things over the line.
* Key Responsibilities (Critical Tasks)
* Program Leadership: Drive the delivery of key initiatives by leading roadmap planning and prioritization discussions with cross-functional leaders.
* Technical Facilitation: Lead technical whiteboard sessions to troubleshoot project implementation details, remove blockers, and provide strategic input on complex issues impacting tech and non-tech teams.
* Cross-Functional Alignment: Manage communications across teams to align non-tech and tech stakeholder needs, tracking and reporting progress against milestones.
* Continuous Improvement: Proactively identify and implement improvements in team and organizational delivery practices; drive the adoption of best practices to enhance responsiveness.
* Strategy: Develop long-term planning frameworks and roadmaps aligned with broader strategic goals.
* Nice-to-Haves (Preferred Skills)
* Certifications: PMP or Scrum Master certification.
* Culture: Alignment with Grab's principles (Heart, Hunger, Honour, Humility).

**Qualifications**
**Essential Skills You Will Need**

* Experience: 12+ years of hands-on experience in Technical Program Management, PMO leadership, or similar roles in tech or tech-adjacent domains.
* Portfolio Management: Proven track record in managing complex, cross-functional portfolios and end-to-end program delivery, including ownership of large, cross-organizational programs.
* Technical Literacy: Solid understanding of software development processes and the software development lifecycle (SDLC).
* Frameworks: Strong experience in applying Agile frameworks to guide teams and establishing/evolving program management frameworks using a data-driven approach.
* Risk & Judgment: Proven ability to identify, mitigate, and manage risks throughout the project lifecycle and making cross-group decisions backed by business and technical insights.
* Stakeholder Management: Demonstrated ability to collaborate with senior leadership and stakeholders to align objectives and manage executive-level escalations.
* Tools: Proficiency with JIRA and Confluence to streamline project workflows and tracking.

**Additional Information**
**Life at Grab**
We care about your well-being at Grab, here are some of the global benefits we offer:
  
  

* We have your back with Term Life Insurance and comprehensive Medical Insurance.
* With GrabFlex, create a benefits package that suits your needs and aspirations.
* Celebrate moments that matter in life with loved ones through Parental and Birthday leave, and give back to your communities through Love-all-Serve-all (LASA) volunteering leave
* We have a confidential Grabber Assistance Programme to guide and uplift you and your loved ones through life's challenges.
* Balance personal commitments and life's demands are made easier with our FlexWork arrangements such as differentiated hours

**What We Stand For At Grab**
We are committed to building an inclusive and equitable workplace that provides equal opportunity for Grabbers to grow and perform at their best. We consider all candidates fairly and equally regardless of nationality, ethnicity, race, religion, age, gender, family commitments, physical and mental impairments or disabilities, and other attributes that make them unique.

75ed0509.title: Technical Program Manager (Optical Networks)
75ed0509.description:
**Job Description**
Imagine being part of a team that is fundamentally changing the way people communicate. Utilizing our differentiated technology, we have created Intelligent Transport Networks with more speed, capacity and scalability than ever before. Imagine a world with unlimited bandwidth. The network of tomorrow will allow for content and creativity limited only by its users' imaginations. If this is something that interests you and you want to be part of what the network will be, come take a look at a team where an idea today can be set in motion tomorrow!
  
  
Nokia is looking for an experienced Technical Program Manager to lead product development programs in a fast-paced complex multi-site, multi-product, multi-release environment. Tangible results would be measured through improved cross-functional synergy to deliver innovative products by working with Systems Engineering (ASIC, Hardware, Software, Test/QA), PLM, Architecture & Technical Support Teams.

* Strong engineering background with a passion for delivering high-performance, scalable software
* Passion for lightweight, effective processes and methodologies to improve productivity & efficiency of engineering teams; must be able to quickly learn and apply process/skills to make an immediate impact

62e4cee6.description:
**Company Description**
At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content - wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future.

Key Responsibilities:
  
  

* Lead governance of growth initiatives with comprehensive weekly updates on progress, providing visibility into development timelines, milestone achievements, risks and any deviations from targets.
* Identify and communicate risks across engineering and product teams, creating alerts and detailed risk mitigation strategies.
* Build and maintain advanced performance dashboards using JIRA and other analytics tools like Tableau, consolidating key metrics such as sprint velocity, cycle time, quality metrics, and resource allocation.
* Utilize data insights to drive process improvements and present actionable recommendations to cross-functional leaders.
* Act as an advisor to Product Managers and Scrum Masters on technical process alignment, maintenance of JIRA scrum boards, ensuring compliance with PDLC standards and enforcing RACI guidelines to maintain clear accountability across all stages of the development cycle.

* Oversee integration testing and provide final quality signoffs before production check-ins, coordinating with engineering leads to validate that all code meets defined standards.
* Participate in sprint planning, retrospectives, and other agile ceremonies as required providing technical guidance and ensuring alignment to PDLC best practices.
* Collaborate with engineering leads to refine continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) processes, enabling faster delivery cycles with robust testing and quality gates.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
* 8+ years of experience in product operations, quality engineering, or technical program management within agile, software-focused environments.
* Advanced proficiency and hands-on scripting experience with JIRA, Confluence, and similar tools like Tableau/Power BI.
* Solid understanding of PDLC methodologies, risk management practices, and quality metrics relevant to software development.
* Strong background in software testing frameworks, CI/CD pipelines, and integration testing.
* Technically astute, with the ability to bridge the gap between engineering and product for high-quality, scalable deliveries.
* Proactive, with exceptional analytical skills and a passion for implementing quality governance in complex, cross-functional environments.
* A collaborative problem-solver, skilled at navigating fast-paced environments while enforcing technical standards and operational excellence.

7122a79b.title: IT Infrastructure Program Manager
7122a79b.description:
Position Summary
  
  
Responsible for leading complex cybersecurity programs and strategic security initiatives across the enterprise. This role drives cross-functional execution, manages security risks and dependencies, coordinates with security, infrastructure, and business teams, and ensures successful delivery of security objectives aligned with organizational priorities, compliance requirements, and risk management goals. The individual operates with significant autonomy and influences decision-making across multiple stakeholder groups..
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
**Security Program Leadership**

* Lead enterprise cybersecurity programs, including risk remediation, vulnerability management, compliance initiatives, identity security, cloud security, security operations, and governance programs.
* Develop and manage integrated program roadmaps, milestones, dependencies, budgets, and resource plans.
* Drive execution of board, executive, and regulatory security commitments.
* Ensure alignment between security strategy, technology roadmaps, and business objectives.

**Risk & Findings Management**

* Drive end-to-end remediation of security findings, audit observations, penetration testing gaps, and risk register items.
* Facilitate prioritization of remediation efforts with Security, Infrastructure, and Business leaders.
* Coordinate risk acceptance and exception processes where remediation is not feasible.
* Maintain visibility into security risks and provide executive-level reporting on mitigation progres.

**Executive Stakeholder Management**

* Act as a trusted advisor to Security leadership, PMO leadership, and senior business stakeholders.
* Prepare executive-ready status reports, dashboards, risk assessments, and decision materials.
* Facilitate steering committees, governance reviews, and leadership discussions.
* Drive alignment among multiple technical teams, vendors, and business functions.

**Program Delivery & Governance**

* Establish and maintain program governance, RAID logs, action tracking, and decision registers.
* Manage interdependencies across Security, Network, Platform & Hosting, EUC, Engineering, and third-party vendors.
* Ensure delivery using Agile, SAFe, hybrid, or traditional methodologies as appropriate.
* Drive issue resolution and escalation management to maintain delivery commitments.

**Compliance & Regulatory Initiatives**

* Coordinate programs supporting NIST, ISO 27001, CMMC, ITAR, SOX, NIS2, and other regulatory requirements.
* Track security control implementation and compliance milestones.
* Partner with Governance, Risk, and Compliance teams to ensure audit readiness and evidence collection.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Drive process improvements within security planning, risk management, and project delivery practices.
* Implement metrics and KPIs to measure cybersecurity program effectiveness.
* Promote best practices for governance, reporting, prioritization, and dependency management.
* Mentor junior project managers and contribute to PMO standards and methodologies..

**Required Skills**

* Strong experience managing complex IT infrastructure projects across Network, Platform, Hosting, and Cloud
* Expertise in Agile/Scrum and traditional project management methodologies
* Hands-on experience with ServiceNow (PPM/ITSM modules preferred)
* Solid understanding of enterprise infrastructure architecture and integration points
* Proven ability to manage cross-functional and multi-vendor environments
* Strong stakeholder management, negotiation, and influencing skills

**Behavioral Competencies**

* Ability to solve complex problems using multiple data sources and independent judgment
* Strong communication and ability to influence stakeholders and build consensus
* High ownership and accountability for delivery outcomes
* Ability to operate independently with minimal guidance 5+ years of experience developing enterprise automation, integrations, or infrastructure engineering solutions.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field (or equivalent experience)
* 5-10 years of experience in IT project/program management, preferably in IT infrastructure domains PMP / PRINCE2 / Agile Scrum certification (preferred)

**Nice To Have**

* Experience in large-scale infrastructure transformation or outsourcing programs (MSP engagements)
* Exposure to cloud platforms (Azure, AWS) and hybrid infrastructure environments
* Familiarity with ITIL frameworks and enterprise service management practices

**Lead – Solution Consulting**

* Proven experience supporting enterprise or mid-market B2B SaaS sales.
* Strong expertise in customer discovery, solution consulting, technical presentations, and product demonstrations.
* Experience creating solution proposals, responding to RFPs/RFIs, and building proof-of-concepts.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong analytical thinking and structured problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to quickly learn new technologies and adapt in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong ownership mindset with the ability to manage multiple strategic opportunities simultaneously.

**Preferred**

* Good understanding of SaaS platforms, CRM, Sales Automation, Marketing Automation, and cloud technologies (AWS or equivalent).
* Understanding of APIs, integrations, and enterprise software ecosystems.
* Experience working with BFSI or other enterprise technology ecosystems is an advantage.
* Familiarity with AI/ML, automation, conversational AI, and modern GTM technologies.
* Hands-on programming or scripting experience is a plus.

**Why Join LeadSquared?**

* Own strategic, high-impact enterprise opportunities.
* Work alongside some of the industry's best Sales, Product, and Engineering leaders.
* Fast-paced environment with accelerated learning and career growth.
* High ownership, quick decision-making, and approachable leadership.
* Competitive rewards and recognition for impact.
* Flexible work environment and opportunities to grow with one of India's leading SaaS companies.

In this role you will shape compelling client-facing proposals, orchestrate pursuit activities end to end, and partner with sales, delivery, and solution teams to bring our best thinking to every opportunity. **In this role you will**

* Support opportunity qualification, account intelligence, and client research activities to strengthen every pursuit.
* Develop proposal content, presentations, response documents, and sales collateral that clearly articulate value.
* Coordinate pursuit activities, reviews, governance checkpoints, and submission timelines across stakeholders.
* Collaborate with solution teams to build compelling Data, Analytics, and AI value propositions.

**What You Need To Have To Be Considered**

* Experience in pre-sales, business development support, bid management, or proposal management.
* An MBA degree.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to synthesize complex information into compelling client-facing content.
* Experience supporting RFPs, proposals, presentations, capability decks, and client research activities.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with strong attention to detail.

**These will help you stand out**

* Ability to coordinate with cross-functional stakeholders across sales, delivery, and solution teams and manage pursuit processes in a structured manner.
* Familiarity with Data, Analytics, AI, and Generative AI concepts and solution narratives.
* Proficiency in PowerPoint, Excel, and collaboration tools, with exposure to proposal management and CRM platforms.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, global environment and manage multiple priorities effectively.

We are excited to see how you will help shape the pursuits that define our future. Apply today and bring your talent to Cognizant.

ce4e07d2.description:
**Our Mission**
At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.
  
  
**Who We Are**
In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!
  
  
We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.
  
  
**Job Summary**
**Our Mission**
At Palo Alto Networks®, everything starts and ends with our mission:
  
  
Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.
  
  
We have the vision of a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. These aren’t easy goals to accomplish – but we’re not here for easy. We’re here for better. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.
  
  
We’re changing the nature of work. Palo Alto Networks is evolving to meet the needs of our employees now and in the future through FLEXWORK, our approach to how we work. From benefits to learning, location to leadership, we’ve rethought and recreated every aspect of the employee experience at Palo Alto Networks. And because it FLEXes around each individual employee based on their individual choices, employees are empowered to push boundaries and help us all evolve, together.
  
  
**Your Career**
The Solutions Consultant is the evolution of the traditional Sales Engineering role, aligning how we best serve our customers in understanding their environment, providing solution guidance and ensuring value realization in their investment with Palo Alto Networks. As a Solutions Consultant you provide technical leadership and expertise and guidance in your customer’s security transformation journey. As a Solutions Consultant for IT/ITeS, you will be part of the core technical team, architecting solutions for large IT/ITeS customers in the region. You will play a key role in defining technical solutions that secure a customer’s key business imperatives and ensuring value realization of their investment with Palo Alto Networks. You evangelize our industry leadership in on-prem, cloud, and security operations services that establish PANW as your customer’s cybersecurity partner of choice.
  
  
**Your Impact**
**Role**
Curiosity is core to the Solutions Consultant role, and you see complex problems as opportunities to learn and deliver innovative solutions! You define your impact by:
  
  

* Meeting and exceeding sales quotas by building and implementing strategic, technical account plans that target cross-platform solutions.
* Your ability to position, demonstrate and create high level designs across the entire PANW portfolio based on customer business needs.
* Conducting discovery to understand and articulate the key technical, operational, and commercial imperatives of your prospects and customers
* Working closely with Professional Services, Customer Success and Specialist teams to ensure overall customer implementation and adoption of solutions.
* Demonstrating strong communication skills and the ability to influence through effective presentations and customer-specific demos, technical engagements, and workshops
* Leading successful technical validation efforts based on best practices to ensure technical win in assigned opportunities.
* Orchestrating supporting resources (Specialists, Channel Resources, Customer Support) to ensure a one-team approach that demonstrates a cohesive strategy
* Promoting end-to-end solutions that include PANW and/or partner professional services to ensure customers realize business value sooner
* Understanding the competitive landscape and effectively differentiating our leadership
* Continuously investing in yourself to develop technical and professional skills that drive your ever-increasing contributions to success of our customers while actively participating within the Solutions Consultant community and at industry events
* (OT) - Identifying technical stakeholders and cultivating relationships with key personas to build and drive a security architecture transformation roadmap

**Qualifications**
**Your Experience**

* Understanding of data networking and/or modern application design and cloud architectures
* Delivering cybersecurity solutions that solve technical challenges and influence new business initiatives
* Influencing and gaining buy-in from key stakeholders, either in a customer-facing or internal role; prior experience in a pre-sales role is ideal
* Creating and delivering technical presentations, workshops, or technical validation engagements
* Experience in selling, designing, implementing, or managing one or more of the following solutions: Network Security, SASE, SaaS, CNAPP and/or SOC Transformation Technologies
* Partnering with Customer Support functions to ensure successful implementation and adoption of sold solutions
* Complex sales involving long sales processes with multiple buying centers and multi-product solutions are preferred
* Proficient in English

**The Team**
Our Solutions Consultant team members work hand-in-hand with large organizations around the world to keep their digital environments protected. We educate, inspire, and empower our potential clients in their journey to transform their security architectures.
  
  
You are empowered with unmatched systems and tools and a team built on joint success. You won’t find someone at Palo Alto Networks that isn’t committed to your success – with everyone pitching in to assist when it comes to solutions selling, learning, and development. Our Solutions Consulting community is driven by the mission to be our customers’ cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting their digital way of life.

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

6fdedf55.title: Solutions Engineer – Public Sector | Splunk Security (Delhi/Gurgaon)
6fdedf55.description:
**Meet the Team**
Join Splunk, a Cisco company solution engineering team supporting Public Sector customers and helping organizations address complex security and technology challenges. In this role, you’ll work closely with government and Public Sector organizations, partners, and cross-functional sales teams to deliver innovative Cisco and Splunk security solutions. You’ll serve as a trusted technical advisor, helping customers strengthen their security posture while driving adoption and growth across the portfolio.
  
  
**Your Impact**
**As a Technical Sales Professional, You Will**

* Own the technical relationship with Public Sector customers and partners, serving as a trusted technical advisor and primary technical sales influencer.
* Partner with account and sales teams on strategic account planning, identifying growth opportunities and aligning technical strategies with Public Sector customer objectives.
* Engage with IT and security leaders, technical decision-makers, and lines of business to understand customer environments, security challenges, business priorities, and technical requirements.
* Translate customer business and security needs into innovative Cisco and Splunk Security solutions and lead strategic solution conversations.
* Design and present cross-architecture security solutions, demonstrations, and technical presentations that address complex Public Sector challenges.
* Lead technical engagements throughout the sales cycle, helping move opportunities from technical discovery and validation through closure.
* Leverage strong knowledge of Splunk Security technologies, including Splunk Cloud, Splunk Enterprise Security (ES), SIEM, SOAR, UEBA, Risk-Based Alerting (RBA), Threat Intelligence, Detection Engineering, Mission Control, and security analytics.
* Apply knowledge of security technologies and architectures including SOC, incident response, threat hunting, XDR/EDR, network security, cloud security, Zero Trust, and security operations to develop relevant customer solutions.
* Leverage competitive market insights to position and differentiate Cisco and Splunk solutions against competing security platforms.
* Coordinate and influence virtual teams of sales resources, security specialists, internal stakeholders, and external partners to drive customer success.
* Provide feedback to Business Entities (BEs) and relevant sales teams on strategic Public Sector customer needs, security trends, market opportunities, and competitive tactics.
* Contribute to demand-generation, technical enablement, and education initiatives that strengthen Cisco and Splunk security capabilities across the Public Sector.
* Adapt technical and engagement strategies to evolving Public Sector priorities, cybersecurity threats, technology trends, and market conditions.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree with 7+ years of related experience, or Master’s degree with 4+ years of related experience, or PhD with 1+ year of related experience.
* 7+ years of experience in technical sales, solutions engineering, security consulting, cybersecurity, or a related customer-facing technical role.
* Experience engaging with Public Sector customers, IT/security leaders, technical decision-makers, and business stakeholders.
* Experience designing, presenting, and demonstrating security or technology solutions aligned to customer business challenges.
* Experience with security technologies such as SIEM, SOAR, security analytics, threat detection, incident response, or security operations.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working with Public Sector or government customers, particularly within complex or regulated environments.
* Strong knowledge of Splunk Security, including Splunk Enterprise Security, SIEM, SOAR, UEBA, Risk-Based Alerting, Threat Intelligence, and security analytics.
* Experience across XDR/EDR, Network Security, Cloud Security, Zero Trust, Threat Hunting, SOC, and Incident Response.
* Experience driving cross-sell, up-sell, competitive displacement, or market-share growth within strategic accounts.
* Strong understanding of cybersecurity trends, customer environments, and competitive security technologies.
* Experience influencing technical executives and leading strategic security solution conversations.

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
  
  
**Disclaimer**
**About**
To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:
  
  

* be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site
* begin with screening or an interview
* originate from a Cisco email address, and
* be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other than https://careers.cisco.com or cisco.wd5.myworkday.com, do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, driver's license, or passport.
  
  
If you are the target of a recruiting scam, consider filing a report with your local law enforcement authorities. Cisco bears no responsibility, and cannot be held liable, for any claims, damages, expenses, or other inconvenience resulting from or in any way connected to recruiting scams.

* Lead the response to the RFP’s/RFI’s by providing detailed technical inputs and creating solution deliverables
* Work with sales and bid teams to develop technical proposals and ensure alignment between proposed solutions and customer requirements
* Participate in customer workshops, bid defense activities
* Stay updated on ServiceNow product releases, competitive landscape, and industry trends to effectively position the ServiceNow solutions

* Excellent communication skills
* Presentation skills
* Analytical thinking and problem solving
* Ability to work collaboratively
* Ability to work in fast paced environment

*****Why Cognizant SNBG:*****

* ServiceNow Global Elite Partner
* Collaborative and supporting Environment
* Work with industry leaders
* Opportunity for career growth and professional development

****Job Summary****
Drive the design and enhancement of AI infrastructure agent solutions that integrate analytics workflows with enterprise Service Now platforms in a hybrid work model. Apply deep experience in automation incident management and data driven optimization to improve operational resilience and business decision quality. Collaborate with cross functional teams to implement scalable AI components that streamline processes and elevate user experience.
  
  
****Responsibilities****

* Design and implement AI infrastructure agent solutions that integrate tightly with Service Now to automate incident handling request fulfillment and workflow orchestration in a secure and scalable manner.
* Develop robust interfaces between analytics platforms and Service Now modules to ensure efficient data exchange monitoring and reporting that supports transparent operational insights.
* Optimize AI agent performance by analyzing operational metrics and user interaction data refining algorithms and configurations to reduce resolution time and increase process reliability.
* Collaborate with analytics stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical AI infra agent capabilities that drive measurable improvement in service quality and resource utilization.
* Configure and extend Service Now components to support AI driven automation such as intelligent routing prioritization and knowledge suggestions that enhance productivity and user satisfaction.
* Create detailed technical design documents runbooks and standards that guide consistent deployment scaling and maintenance of AI infra agent solutions across hybrid environments.
* Implement monitoring and alerting strategies for AI agents and Service Now integrations using analytics to identify anomalies early and support proactive remediation actions.
* Conduct performance tuning of data pipelines and Service Now integrations to ensure low latency response stable throughput and predictable behavior under varying load conditions.
* Coordinate with security and compliance teams to embed access control logging and data protection practices into AI infra and Service Now workflows supporting responsible and accountable operations.
* Provide advanced troubleshooting for complex AI agent and Service Now incidents using structured analytics approaches to identify root causes and implement sustainable corrective actions.
* Guide adoption of best practices in AI infra engineering and analytics usage within project teams helping peers apply standards that improve system robustness and business value.
* Evaluate emerging AI infra tools Service Now features and analytics techniques recommending targeted innovations that align with organizational strategy and deliver societal impact through improved service efficiency.
* Partner with business and operations teams to showcase how AI infra agent solutions and analytics insights reduce friction for end users and contribute to more responsive and inclusive services.

****Qualifications****

* Bring eight to ten years of experience in designing and implementing enterprise grade infrastructure solutions with a strong focus on AI powered automation in complex environments.
* Demonstrate expert hands on proficiency with Service Now configuration customization and integration including incident management request management and workflow capabilities.
* Apply deep domain experience in analytics including data modeling metric definition and insight generation to inform AI infra agent behavior and continuous improvement strategies.
* Use strong programming and scripting skills in common enterprise languages to build connectors automation scripts and integration components that support AI and Service Now workflows.
* Exhibit advanced capability in using monitoring and observability tools to analyze performance reliability and user experience of AI infra and Service Now solutions and drive tuning efforts.
* Communicate fluently in English as a native speaker across written documentation technical discussions and stakeholder presentations to ensure clarity and shared understanding.
* Operate effectively in a hybrid work model by coordinating tasks documentation and collaboration tools that maintain productivity and alignment without requiring travel.

****Certifications Required****
Service Now Certified System Administrator or equivalent AI and analytics certification

About us

Join us at Orange Business!

We are a network and digital integrator that understands the entire value chain of the digital world, freeing our customers to focus on the strategic initiatives that shape their business.

Every day, you will collaborate with a team dedicated to providing consistent, sustainable global solutions, no matter where our customers operate. With over 30,000 employees across Asia, the Americas, Africa, and Europe, we offer a dynamic environment to develop and perfect your skills in a field filled with exciting challenges and opportunities.

About the role

Be at the forefront of cloud innovation by collaborating with international customers to deliver tailored solutions and enhance operational excellence in a virtual, multi-stakeholder environment.  

* Engage proactively with international customers to understand and address their cloud operational requirements through customized solutions.
* Collaborate seamlessly with internal teams to support the integration and delivery of cloud services, ensuring consistent service quality.
* Identify and resolve technical issues efficiently, applying methodical problem-solving techniques to maintain service continuity.
* Operate effectively within a virtual environment, coordinating with stakeholders across various time zones to support cloud operations.
* Manage unexpected challenges calmly and strategically to ensure prompt resolution and minimal operational impact.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives aimed at enhancing operational processes and overall service performance.

About you

You are a knowledgeable professional with over 7 years of experience in cloud operations and virtualization technologies, holding a graduate degree in science, engineering (BE/B Tech), or M.Sc. IT. Your strong technical skills include advanced knowledge of vCloud Director, VMware ESXi and vSphere, NSX-T, along with hands-on experience with key infrastructure such as Dell and Cisco chassis, complemented by a solid understanding of public cloud environments including Azure. You combine expertise in Linux and automation tools with clear communication and effective customer engagement skills, consistently adapting solutions to meet evolving needs.  
  
**Your professional skills:**  

* Demonstrate advanced management and configuration skills in vCloud Director environments to optimize cloud operations.
* Apply in-depth technical expertise in VMware ESXi and vSphere, including proficiency in vCenter and ESXi management tasks.
* Utilize comprehensive knowledge of NSX-T to implement and manage advanced network virtualization features.
* Experience with hardware including Dell M1000 Chassis and M630, Cisco UCS, and HPE chassis to support infrastructure needs.
* Apply understanding of public cloud platforms, particularly Microsoft Azure, to design and maintain effective cloud solutions.
* Exhibit proficiency in Linux operating systems and automation tools to streamline cloud service management.
* Communicate clearly and effectively with customers and team members to foster understanding and collaboration.
* Provide proactive customer support that ensures positive experiences and addresses client concerns efficiently.
* Adapt problem-solving approaches as required by changing environments to maintain stable cloud operations.
* Collaborate with colleagues to advance team objectives and share knowledge for mutual benefit.

  
**Your soft skills:**  

* Contributes to team success through cooperation and knowledge sharing across functions.
* Communicates ideas and technical information clearly to diverse audiences.
* Responds flexibly to changing priorities and operational requirements.
* Maintains a professional and approachable demeanor when interacting with stakeholders.
* Demonstrates persistence in resolving challenges while maintaining composure.

Join Orange as a Consultant in cloud operations and engage in shaping the future of cloud technologies on an international scale. Here, you will apply your expertise to provide practical, client-focused solutions while working within a collaborative and dynamic team setting. The role offers the opportunity to continuously expand technical knowledge and contribute to operational excellence, supporting a culture of learning and innovation aligned with Orange’s values of integrity and respect.

What we offer

* **Global Opportunities:** Work in multi-national teams with opportunity to collaborate with colleagues and customers from all over the world.
* **Flexible Work Environment:** Flexible working hours and possibility to combine work from office and home (hybrid ways of working).
* **Professional Development:** training programs and upskilling/re-skilling opportunities.
* **Career Growth:** Internal growth and mobility opportunities within Orange.
* **Caring and Daring Culture:** Health and well-being programs and benefits, diversity & inclusion initiatives, CSR and employee connect events.
* **Reward Programs:** Employee Referral Program, Change Maker Awards.

Regardless of your age, gender, background, origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability, neurodiversity, or appearance, we actively encourage diversity within our teams, as it is a collective strength and a driver of innovation.

d66060b1.title: Solutions Engineer – Public Sector | Splunk Security (Delhi/Gurgaon)
d66060b1.description:
**Meet the Team**
Join Splunk, a Cisco company solution engineering team supporting Public Sector customers and helping organizations address complex security and technology challenges. In this role, you’ll work closely with government and Public Sector organizations, partners, and cross-functional sales teams to deliver innovative Cisco and Splunk security solutions. You’ll serve as a trusted technical advisor, helping customers strengthen their security posture while driving adoption and growth across the portfolio.
  
  
**Your Impact**
**As a Technical Sales Professional, You Will**

* Own the technical relationship with Public Sector customers and partners, serving as a trusted technical advisor and primary technical sales influencer.
* Partner with account and sales teams on strategic account planning, identifying growth opportunities and aligning technical strategies with Public Sector customer objectives.
* Engage with IT and security leaders, technical decision-makers, and lines of business to understand customer environments, security challenges, business priorities, and technical requirements.
* Translate customer business and security needs into innovative Cisco and Splunk Security solutions and lead strategic solution conversations.
* Design and present cross-architecture security solutions, demonstrations, and technical presentations that address complex Public Sector challenges.
* Lead technical engagements throughout the sales cycle, helping move opportunities from technical discovery and validation through closure.
* Leverage strong knowledge of Splunk Security technologies, including Splunk Cloud, Splunk Enterprise Security (ES), SIEM, SOAR, UEBA, Risk-Based Alerting (RBA), Threat Intelligence, Detection Engineering, Mission Control, and security analytics.
* Apply knowledge of security technologies and architectures including SOC, incident response, threat hunting, XDR/EDR, network security, cloud security, Zero Trust, and security operations to develop relevant customer solutions.
* Leverage competitive market insights to position and differentiate Cisco and Splunk solutions against competing security platforms.
* Coordinate and influence virtual teams of sales resources, security specialists, internal stakeholders, and external partners to drive customer success.
* Provide feedback to Business Entities (BEs) and relevant sales teams on strategic Public Sector customer needs, security trends, market opportunities, and competitive tactics.
* Contribute to demand-generation, technical enablement, and education initiatives that strengthen Cisco and Splunk security capabilities across the Public Sector.
* Adapt technical and engagement strategies to evolving Public Sector priorities, cybersecurity threats, technology trends, and market conditions.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree with 7+ years of related experience, or Master’s degree with 4+ years of related experience, or PhD with 1+ year of related experience.
* 7+ years of experience in technical sales, solutions engineering, security consulting, cybersecurity, or a related customer-facing technical role.
* Experience engaging with Public Sector customers, IT/security leaders, technical decision-makers, and business stakeholders.
* Experience designing, presenting, and demonstrating security or technology solutions aligned to customer business challenges.
* Experience with security technologies such as SIEM, SOAR, security analytics, threat detection, incident response, or security operations.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working with Public Sector or government customers, particularly within complex or regulated environments.
* Strong knowledge of Splunk Security, including Splunk Enterprise Security, SIEM, SOAR, UEBA, Risk-Based Alerting, Threat Intelligence, and security analytics.
* Experience across XDR/EDR, Network Security, Cloud Security, Zero Trust, Threat Hunting, SOC, and Incident Response.
* Experience driving cross-sell, up-sell, competitive displacement, or market-share growth within strategic accounts.
* Strong understanding of cybersecurity trends, customer environments, and competitive security technologies.
* Experience influencing technical executives and leading strategic security solution conversations.

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
  
  
**Disclaimer**
**About**
To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:
  
  

* be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site
* begin with screening or an interview
* originate from a Cisco email address, and
* be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other than https://careers.cisco.com or cisco.wd5.myworkday.com, do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, driver's license, or passport.
  
  
If you are the target of a recruiting scam, consider filing a report with your local law enforcement authorities. Cisco bears no responsibility, and cannot be held liable, for any claims, damages, expenses, or other inconvenience resulting from or in any way connected to recruiting scams.

* Strong expertise in modern C++ development and object-oriented design principles.
* Deep hands-on experience with the Qt Framework, including GUI development, Signals and Slots, Multithreading, and Custom Widgets.
* Experience working with MITK (Medical Imaging Interaction Toolkit).
* Strong expertise in VTK (Visualization Toolkit) for visualization and imaging applications.
* Hands-on experience with OpenGL and advanced graphics rendering techniques.
* Strong Linux development, deployment, and troubleshooting experience.
* Solid understanding of Software Architecture principles and large-scale application design.
* Experience architecting scalable, maintainable, and high-performance software systems.
* Strong knowledge of design patterns, software engineering best practices, and performance optimization techniques.
* Experience with debugging, profiling, performance analysis, and troubleshooting complex systems.
* Proficiency with Git and modern software configuration management practices.
* Experience working in Agile and Scrum-based development environments.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities.
* Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to mentor development teams and provide technical leadership across multiple initiatives.
* Experience with DevOps practices and CI/CD pipelines.
* Familiarity with Docker and containerized application development.
* Exposure to cloud-native architectures and modern deployment models.
* Experience in healthcare, medical imaging, diagnostics, or visualization domains is highly preferred.
* Understanding of software compliance, quality standards, and regulatory requirements for medical applications.

Bain & Company is one of the top management consulting firms in the world that helps the world’s most ambitious changemakers define the future.

Across 65 cities in 40 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperforming the competition, and redefine industries. We complement our tailored, integrated expertise with a vibrant ecosystem of digital innovators to deliver better, faster, and more enduring outcomes.

The firm established several functions in the Indian market early 2000s and its remit across functions has expanded over time. Since 2019, these functions have become part of Global Business Services (GBS). Global Business Services (GBS) is a network of five interconnected business functions hubs across India, Poland, Malaysia, Mexico and Portugal, serving Bain globally to run our business, support other functions, and help drive innovation internally. We are over 1000 business professionals – serving functions in operations, HR, finance, legal, tech, marketing, research, and data analytics – who support our offices globally. Our mantra of “shared innovation, seamless execution,” underpinned by a passion for results, teamwork, and creativity, helps Bain stay at the top of our game operationally.

  
  

**WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK**

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top-ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times.

Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.

  

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**

The Staff Architect II will have ownership of the technical architecture and technology aspects for multiple enterprise software products/platforms, supporting specific business capabilities. This involves providing comprehensive technical leadership throughout all phases of the product/platform lifecycle and fostering deep connections with product teams, development teams, and business and technical leadership. Additionally, this role includes active participation in licensing and cost discussions to contribute to ongoing budget planning in coordination with business and TSG leadership.

An individual in this role will independently manage deliverables and projects in scope, demonstrate excellent communication and collaboration skills and will drive improvements based on their insights from the sources across related departments and Functions.

  

**Technology Delivery (80%)**

* Technology Strategy and Alignment: align initiatives with business vision, evaluate vendors, and present recommendations emphasizing unique aspects for business vision.
* Project Management and Coordination: lead a 3rd Party software product/platform implementation, coordinate teams, and manage engagements for quick resolutions.
* Security and Risk Management: assess and bridge security risks between applications, data, and project teams.
* Data Integration and Documentation: support data integrations, exports, and document procedures for exchange and configurations.
* Technical Guidance and Collaboration: define integration methodologies, guide 3rd party teams on Bain systems, and offer testing guidance.
* AI/ ML Integration: Assess AI features in vendor platforms for business and technical fit, support integration of AI/ML services into applications, and ensure compliance with data privacy and security standards.

  

**Planning & Technology R&D (20%)**
