8d115314.title: Senior Solutions Architect – AI Infrastructure Networking
8d115314.description:
**Company Description**
**About Mirantis**
Mirantis, an IREN company, is the Kubernetes-native AI infrastructure company, enabling organizations to build and operate scalable, secure, and sovereign infrastructure for modern AI, machine learning, and data-intensive applications. By combining open source innovation with deep expertise in Kubernetes orchestration, Mirantis empowers platform engineering teams to deliver composable, production-ready developer platforms across any environment—on-premises, in the cloud, at the edge, or in sovereign data centers. As enterprises navigate the growing complexity of AI-driven workloads, Mirantis delivers the automation, GPU orchestration, and policy-driven control needed to manage infrastructure with confidence and agility. Committed to open standards and freedom from lock-in, Mirantis ensures that customers retain full control of their infrastructure strategy. https://www.mirantis.com/
  
  
**Job Description**
About the role
  
  
We are seeking a Senior Solutions Architect with deep networking expertise to join the Voyager team in the Mirantis Office of the CTO. You will own the network solutioning of k0rdent AI, our platform for building and operating GPU clouds and AI factories, from metal to model.
  
  
You will design how large GPU clusters are interconnected, how tenants are isolated, and how workloads reach the network from containers, virtual machines and bare metal nodes. You will turn that design into published reference architectures, working code and proofs of concept that run on real hardware with our customers and partners.
  
  
As part of the Office of the CTO, research is a core part of the job. You will explore designs and technologies before customers ask for them, prototype ideas that may not ship, and challenge established practice when a better approach exists. Your work will shape where k0rdent AI goes next, not only how it is deployed today.
  
  
This role combines research with hands-on, outward-facing work. You will split your time between exploring new designs, writing architecture, building and validating it in the lab, and explaining it to engineers, executives and conference audiences. You will work with Solutions Architects, Partner Management and Engineering colleagues across many countries and time zones.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Reference architecture
  
  

* Design and publish network reference architectures and solution designs for k0rdent AI, covering data center topologies from a single rack to multi-thousand-GPU clusters.
* Define compute (east-west) fabrics on InfiniBand and on RoCEv2 Ethernet, including rail-optimised and fat-tree / Clos designs, oversubscription and failure-domain choices.
* Define front-end, storage and management networks, and how they connect to customer data centers, public clouds and hybrid environments.
* Specify multi-tenant isolation across the stack: InfiniBand partitions (PKeys), VRFs and EVPN-VXLAN on Ethernet, and Kubernetes-level network policy.
* Document scale limits and trade-offs (cost, performance, operability, vendor lock-in) with defensible reasoning a customer can follow.

Host and platform networking
  
  

* Define how Linux hosts expose NICs, DPUs and SuperNICs to workloads: PCI passthrough, SR-IOV virtual functions, IOMMU groups, NUMA and GPU-NIC affinity.
* Design Kubernetes networking for AI workloads: primary and secondary CNIs, Multus, SR-IOV and RDMA device plugins, NVIDIA Network Operator, and Dynamic Resource Allocation (DRA).
* Design networking for virtual machines on KubeVirt, including passthrough and SR-IOV for GPU and RDMA traffic.

Research and exploration
  
  

* Track and evaluate emerging technologies and standards in AI networking, such as Ultra Ethernet (UEC), SuperNIC and DPU offloads, scale-up and scale-across fabrics, and Kubernetes DRA network drivers.
* Prototype alternative designs in the lab, including ones customers have not yet asked for, and measure them against current practice.
* Challenge established or customer-preferred designs when evidence points to a better option, and make the case with data.
* Publish findings as internal research notes and design proposals and, where appropriate, as external papers, blog posts or talks.

Code and proofs of concept
  
  

* Build and run proofs of concept with customers and partners, on Mirantis lab hardware and on customer sites, and report results against agreed success criteria.
* Write automation and tooling (Python, Go, Bash, Ansible, Helm, Kubernetes manifests, Terraform) that makes the reference architectures reproducible.
* Run validation and benchmarking of fabrics and host configurations (e.g. NCCL tests, perftest, ib\_write\_bw) and turn findings into design guidance.

Customers, partners and community
  
  

* Act as the network subject matter expert in customer discovery, design reviews and architecture workshops, bringing thought leadership and new ideas rather than only reflecting current practice.
* Work with hardware and networking partners (e.g. NVIDIA, server OEMs, switch and network vendors) on joint designs and validations.
* Innovate and feed research results back to Product and Engineering, and help shape the k0rdent AI roadmap.
* Present at industry events, webinars and partner summits, and run hands-on workshops for technical audiences.
* Write technical content: reference architecture documents, solution briefs, blog posts and internal enablement.

**Qualifications**
Education and experience
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8+ years in network engineering or network architecture, with at least 3 years in data center, HPC or cloud infrastructure networking.
* Customer-facing experience as a solutions architect, pre-sales engineer, consultant or technical lead.

**Required Technical Skills**

* Data center network design: spine-leaf and Clos topologies, rail-optimised GPU fabrics, oversubscription, ECMP, and the operational challenges of scaling to thousands of nodes.
* InfiniBand: subnet management, partitioning, adaptive routing, and how NCCL / RDMA traffic behaves on the fabric.
* RoCEv2 on Ethernet: lossless and congestion-controlled designs (PFC, ECN, DCQCN), QoS, MTU and buffer tuning.
* Routing and overlays: BGP, EVPN-VXLAN, VRFs and their use for multi-tenancy.
* Hybrid and multi-cloud connectivity: interconnects, VPN, cloud provider networking constructs, and IP address and DNS planning across sites.
* Linux networking: how the kernel and drivers manage NICs, PCI passthrough, SR-IOV, IOMMU, NUMA affinity, and tools such as iproute2, ethtool and devlink.
* Kubernetes networking: CNI plugins (e.g. Cilium, Calico, OVN-Kubernetes), Multus and secondary networks, SR-IOV and RDMA device plugins, network policy and service exposure.
* Virtualisation on Kubernetes: KubeVirt, and how VM networking, passthrough and SR-IOV are configured there.
* Programming or scripting in at least one language (Python or Go preferred), and comfortable using Git, CI and infrastructure-as-code.

How you work
  
  
We hire for these behaviours as much as for technical depth, and will ask for concrete examples of each.
  
  

* Curious. You dig into why a fabric behaves the way it does, read the specs and the source, and keep up with how AI networking is changing. You question established designs, including the ones customers are used to, when there is a better way.
* Ownership. You take a reference architecture or a POC from the first sketch to a published, validated result, and you stand behind it.
* Proactive. You spot gaps in the product, the documentation or a customer design before you are asked, and you act on them.
* Fast learner. You get productive quickly in unfamiliar hardware, software or customer environments.
* Business acumen. You connect network design choices to cost, time-to-value and risk, and explain them in those terms to decision makers.

Communication and collaboration
  
  

* Excellent written and spoken English; you write documents others can build from.
* Comfortable presenting to large audiences at conferences and events, and running hands-on workshops.
* Able to adapt the message to the audience, from network engineers to customer executives.
* Experience working in an international, distributed company, across time zones and different work cultures, with Solutions Architects, Partner Management and Engineering teams.

Nice to have
  
  

* Hands-on experience with NVIDIA networking: Quantum InfiniBand, Spectrum-X Ethernet, ConnectX SuperNICs, BlueField DPUs, UFM, and NVIDIA reference designs for AI factories.
* Experience with GPU cloud, neocloud or HPC operators, or with NVIDIA Cloud Partner (NCP) style deployments.
* Bare-metal provisioning and lifecycle: Metal3, Ironic, Redfish, PXE / iPXE, and Cluster API.
* Network automation and SDN controllers, and switch operating systems such as Cumulus Linux, SONiC or vendor equivalents.
* Global load balancing and service exposure for distributed inference (GSLB, Gateway API, ingress).
* Familiarity with Software-Defined Storage networking for AI (NVMe-oF, GPUDirect Storage).
* Experience with Mirantis products, MKE, k0s, k0rdent networking.
* Contributions to open-source networking or Kubernetes projects, or a track record of public talks and technical writing.
* Participation in standards or industry bodies (e.g. Ultra Ethernet Consortium, OCP, IETF), or published research, patents or white papers.
* Additional languages beyond English, for example a European language.

Location, travel and working model
  
  
This role is remote, open to candidates based in he United States (East Coast).
  
  

* You will work with a team spread across many time zones; some meetings will fall outside standard local hours.
* Travel of up to 25% for customer engagements, partner meetings, lab work and industry events, primarily within the EU and US.
* Mirantis is an equal opportunity employer. Compensation and benefits are set according to the local market and employment arrangement.

Additional Information
  
  
**Why you’ll love Mirantis**

* Build the observability foundation for the AI cloud era, working directly with leading GPU cloud operators, NeoClouds, sovereign clouds, and AI-first enterprises
* Collaborate with a world-class, distributed team committed to openness and technical excellence
* Shape the product narrative and influence go-to-market success

**It is understood that Mirantis, Inc. may use automated decision-making technology (ADMT) for specific employment-related decisions. Opting out of ADMT use is requested for decisions about evaluation and review connected with the specific employment decision for the position applied for. You also have the right to appeal any decisions made by ADMT by sending your request to [email protected]**
By submitting your resume, you consent to the processing and storage of your personal data in accordance with applicable data protection laws, for the purposes of considering your application for current and future job opportunities.

e8e0dfb9.title: Automation and AI Solutions Lead
e8e0dfb9.description:
Are you passionate about Automation and AI and eager to make a significant impact? We are seeking a highly motivated Automation & AI Solutions Lead with strong organizational and technical skills.You will work closely with architects, developers, and business stakeholders to translate real-world problems into robust AI systems. The role demands deep expertise in LangGraph, LangChain, and AWS-based deployments, with accountability from discovery through production. Success in this role means delivering reliable, scalable AI solutions that create measurable business impact. If you're excited to make real impact, apply now and be part of our innovative journey!
  
  
**About The Role**
In this role as an Automation & AI Solutions Lead, you will
  
  

* Engage internal SMEs to understand current processes and as-is workflows — translate into buildable AI requirements.
* Demo working solutions to internal stakeholders up to business leadership level.
* Support the Architect during feasibility and POC phases — contribute to rapid builds and validate fit.
* Maintain stakeholder communication throughout: progress updates, issue escalation, solution walkthroughs.
* Co-invest with the Architect in upfront solution design — design robustness directly determines build speed and test quality.
* Translate architecture into implementation plans — break down into assignable streams for Developer and Associate.
* Own day-to-day technical decisions during build when the Architect is focused on other projects.
* Identify architectural risks early and escalate before they become build or production problems.
* Build complex solution components end-to-end on AWS AgentCore and LangGraph — hands-on coding role.
* Scale solutions from POC to production: performance, reliability, monitoring, and cost management.
* Debug production failures: hallucination patterns, retrieval degradation, agent loops, latency regressions.
* Use AI coding tools (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Cline) to accelerate delivery. Own all generated code.
* Build Low Code automations (Copilot Studio, Power Automate) when use case and bandwidth allow.
* Guide Developer and Associate through implementation, code reviews, and debugging.
* Ensure the team uses AI tools effectively — accelerating delivery without sacrificing code understanding.
* Work Mode: Hybrid - 3 days from office.
* Shift Timing: 1pm IST to 10pm IST

**About You**
**You’re a fit for the role of Automation & AI Solutions Lead, if your background includes:**

* Experience — 5–8 years total; 2–4 years production GenAI/LLM; 12–24 months multi-agent LangGraph; 3+ systems owned post-deployment.
* LangGraph — multi-agent state machines, parallel execution, checkpointing, HITL — non-negotiable
* AWS Bedrock — Model deployment, knowledge bases, guardrails.
* Database & AI Data Access — SQL proficiency, NL-to-SQL, LLM-powered query layers. Snowflake a plus.
* Systems Integration — REST API development, MCP awareness, enterprise system connectors.
* Advanced RAG — Hybrid search, re-ranking, query reformulation, retrieval evaluation.
* Evaluation Frameworks — RAGAS / TruLens, golden test sets, automated regression pipelines.
* Observability — LangSmith or LangFuse — agent tracing, production debugging.
* Python — Expert-level — design patterns, async, testing, CI/CD.
* Multi-Model — OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, Llama — trade-offs at production scale.
* Pro Code vs Low Code — Working knowledge of Copilot Studio and Power Automate; build when use case fits.

* Stakeholder Communication — Demo AI solutions to business stakeholders; translate SME knowledge into requirements.
* AWS AgentCore Deep — All services hands-on.
* MCP / A2A — Server/client production implementation.
* Document Intelligence — OCR, layout-aware chunking.
* Fine-Tuning — LoRA / QLoRA for domain adaptation.
* Certifications — AWS ML Specialty, Azure AI Engineer, GCP ML Engineer.

**What’s in it For You?**

* Hybrid Work Model: We’ve adopted a flexible hybrid working environment (2-3 days a week in the office depending on the role) for our office-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected.
* Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance.
* Career Development and Growth: By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow’s challenges and deliver real-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future.
* Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing.
* Culture: Globally recognized, award-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together.
* Social Impact: Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives.
* Making a Real-World Impact: We are one of the few companies globally that helps its customers pursue justice, truth, and transparency. Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world.

**About Us**
Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. We serve professionals across legal, tax, accounting, compliance, government, and media. Our products combine highly specialized software and insights to empower professionals with the data, intelligence, and solutions needed to make informed decisions, and to help institutions in their pursuit of justice, truth, and transparency. 9a50d520.description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

As the Principal AI/ML Engineer for GTS , you will drive the architectural design, hands-on development, and production delivery of scalable, resilient, and secure software solutions that integrate AI/ML capabilities into healthcare applications and workflows. Combining deep software engineering expertise with applied AI/ML engineering, you will build cloud-native services, reusable components, and robust APIs that embed intelligent capabilities into enterprise applications. You will develop and integrate machine learning models, generative AI solutions, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and AI agents that support workflow automation and decision-making. Using AI-powered development tools and cloud AI services, you will accelerate engineering delivery and establish automated pipelines for model evaluation, deployment, and monitoring, ensuring solutions are secure, reliable, scalable, and aligned with responsible AI practices. In this principal technical role, you will guide engineering decisions across teams, mentor engineers, and advance software modernization and engineering excellence turning promising AI/ML use cases into reliable, maintainable production solutions that deliver measurable

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Translate business needs into measurable ML tasks. Validate data, establish simple baselines, and integrate suitable models. Demonstrate whether AI improves outcomes over simpler approaches
* Integrate generative AI and large language models (LLMs) where they add value. Use retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), which supplies relevant source content to a model, when appropriate. Evaluate accuracy, unsupported claims, latency, and cost
* Build model-serving interfaces and machine learning operations (MLOps) workflows for versioning, deployment, monitoring, and rollback
* Track changes in data and model performance, then improve models, prompts, or product design
* Apply responsible AI practices through documented evaluations, bias and robustness checks, privacy safeguards, and human review where needed. Address prompt injection and sensitive-data leakage, define safe fallback behavior, and explain model limitations
* Design and build distributed services, application programming interfaces (APIs), and reliable data integrations. Make clear trade-offs across scalability, performance, cost, and maintainability
* Write and review production code, automate unit and integration tests, and build continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD) pipelines for safe, repeatable cloud releases
* Build security and privacy into software design through access controls, secrets management, and safe data handling. Identify technical risks before release and address them with product and security partners
* Own production readiness and service health through logs, metrics, and traces. Troubleshoot incidents, remove recurring failure points, and improve reliability and response times
* Lead cross-team architecture decisions and deliver reusable components. Document trade-offs, mentor engineers, and break complex requirements into manageable releases that meet agreed product and quality goals
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* 15+ years of relevant engineering experience, including 8+ years of hands-on software engineering and 3+ years delivering AI/ML capabilities in production
* Experience taking ML or generative AI capabilities from evaluation to production, including model integration, deployment, monitoring, and measurable quality assessment
* Solid coding skills in at least one production backend language, with working proficiency in Python for AI/ML development
* Demonstrated delivery of distributed systems, APIs, data integrations, automated tests, and cloud deployments, including practical security and operational ownership
* Ability to explain technical decisions clearly, influence architecture across teams, and mentor engineers while continuing to contribute production code

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience building healthcare applications or working with other regulated or sensitive data
* Experience delivering shared services or platforms used by multiple engineering teams
* Experience with containers, infrastructure as code, or model registries to support reliable software and model releases
* Experience with vector search or RAG evaluation, and familiarity with an established ML framework.

*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone - of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income - deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

974519cc.description:
Lead Specialist, Solution Architect - OnVUE

  
  

About OnVUE

  
  

OnVUE is Pearson’s online proctored test delivery platform, supporting the secure, reliable, and scalable delivery of assessments for Pearson’s certification and professional testing business. The platform enables candidates to test remotely while maintaining exam integrity through identity verification, monitoring, secure delivery workflows, and operational controls. The OnVUE environment includes modern and legacy systems, with ongoing focus on platform modernization, service resilience, API-first integration, cloud-native delivery, candidate and proctor experience, and improved developer and operational practices.

  
  

Role summary

  
  

As a Lead Specialist, Solution Architect, you are a recognized subject-matter expert who provides technical leadership for sophisticated, high-impact solution work. You independently translate business needs, stakeholder constraints, and technical requirements into secure, scalable, viable, and maintainable architectural models and guide solution delivery from inception through implementation.

  
  

You maintain technical consistency within the assigned scope, balance advanced solution design with hands-on support for complex delivery challenges, and resolve day-to-day integration and build issues. You influence through depth of knowledge, sound judgment, clear communication, and the ability to steer architecture discussions toward practical outcomes. You mentor engineers, junior architects, and peers, establish trusted technical patterns within your domain, ensure conformance to established frameworks, and escalate decisions that materially exceed the assigned scope to senior experts.

  
  

Key responsibilities

  
  

Solution architecture and technical leadership

  

  
* Translate business needs, stakeholder constraints, and technical requirements into robust architectural models and fit-for-purpose solution designs.
  
  
* Own solution architecture from discovery and design through implementation and production adoption.
  
  
* Provide technical leadership for high-impact projects, major features, product changes, services, domains, or business capabilities.
  
  
* Maintain technical consistency within the assigned product, service, project, domain, or broader solution footprint.
  
  
* Evaluate and communicate tradeoffs involving scalability, security, resilience, maintainability, integration, delivery risk, operational needs, and business value.
  

  

Implementation and delivery guidance

  

  
* Guide engineering and delivery teams through implementation while preserving architectural intent.
  
  
* Resolve complex architectural, integration, and build issues within the assigned scope.
  
  
* Consult on technical feasibility for major features, updates, integrations, and solution approaches.
  
  
* Identify high-stakes architectural risks early and coordinate practical mitigation.
  
  
* Adapt architecture to changing requirements without sacrificing solution stability, security, or long-term maintainability.
  

  

Standards, influence, and capability building

  

  
* Establish trusted and repeatable technical patterns within the assigned domain while ensuring conformance with established architecture frameworks, standards, and guidelines.
  
  
* Participate in architecture forums and guide discussions toward sound, practical outcomes.
  
  
* Mentor engineers, junior architects, and peers in solution design, technical practices, and architectural decision-making.
  
  
* Communicate design options, recommendations, constraints, and tradeoffs clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  
  
* Escalate decisions outside the assigned scope or requiring senior technical or enterprise direction.
  

  

Required education and experience

  

  
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience.
  
  
* Progressive experience in software engineering, solution architecture, or a related technical discipline.
  
  
* Demonstrated experience designing sophisticated solutions and guiding delivery from inception through implementation.
  
  
* Experience translating business needs and technical constraints into secure, scalable, maintainable architecture.
  
  
* Experience influencing architecture and delivery outcomes without formal authority.
  

  

Desired knowledge, skills, and abilities

  

  
* Strong solution architecture, system design, integration, and technical problem-solving skills.
  
  
* Ability to evaluate solution options and explain tradeoffs across business value, delivery feasibility, risk, and long-term technology health.
  
  
* Working knowledge of Java-based enterprise application stacks, cloud-native design, APIs, microservices, event-driven integration, containers, orchestration, CI/CD, observability, security, data consistency, and operational readiness.
  
  
* Practical familiarity with service decomposition, API gateway patterns, versioned API contracts, distributed tracing, messaging, data-driven backend systems, and headless or decoupled front-end and back-end architecture patterns.
  
  
* Strong documentation, facilitation, communication, and influencing skills.
  
  
* Ability to mentor others and introduce trusted, repeatable technical approaches.
  

  

Success measures

  

  
* Architecture artifacts are clear, fit for purpose, timely, and enable secure, scalable, stable implementation.
  
  
* Solution designs are adopted successfully, integrate effectively, and remain durable in production.
  
  
* Design choices minimize avoidable rework, support business continuity, and reduce preventable technical risk.
  
  
* Technical blockers and high-stakes architectural risks are identified and resolved or escalated in time to protect delivery.
  
  
* Documentation and quality standards are met with limited revision cycles.
  
  
* Repeatable technical approaches, mentorship, and knowledge transfer improve team effectiveness.
  
  
* Stakeholders trust the role to explain design options, constraints, and tradeoffs and to guide solution delivery.
  

  

Leadership behaviors

  

  
* Customer Centricity — Tailors architecture decisions to real operational and business needs and responds quickly when issues threaten outcomes.
  
  
* Raise the Performance Bar — Applies advanced design techniques, strengthens technical practices, and shares approaches that improve solution quality.
  
  
* Exceptional Collaboration for Value — Guides technical discussions, incorporates different perspectives, and supports alignment and integration across the assigned scope.
  
  
* Our Leaders Inspire — Models technical curiosity, sound judgment, visible accountability, and a commitment to developing others.
  

  

**Location & Working Pattern**

  
  

India. Bangalore is the preferred location and Chennai is an option. Exact hybrid attendance requirements will be shared during the recruitment process.

  
  

**Why Join Pearson?**

  
  

This is an opportunity to develop engineering talent, strengthen delivery and quality practices, and help teams adopt emerging AI-assisted ways of working across technology that supports assessment experiences at scale.

**Required Qualifications**

* Experience with modern application technologies including React.js/Angular/Vue.js, SQL, PostgreSQL, Entity Framework, Git, unit testing, and PowerShell.
* Strong knowledge of DevOps and cloud operations, including automated CI/CD, environment provisioning, configuration management, deployment strategies, logging, monitoring, tracing, alerting, dashboards, and operational support.
* Strong architecture, analytical, communication, and presentation skills, with experience evaluating technical trade-offs, working in Agile environments, and an architectural certification with one or more Public Cloud providers (Azure, AWS, or GCP).

* Good understanding of HL7 and DICOM protocols.
* Experience or demonstrated ability to quickly learn and implement data analytics tools.

3801116f.title: Product Delivery Manager - ServiceNow - Now Assist-HRSD
3801116f.description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY-ServiceNow – Supervising Associate (Product Delivery Manager – Now Assist & HRSD)**
**Role Overview:**
The ServiceNow Product Delivery Manager is responsible for the end-to-end management and delivery of one or more ServiceNow technology solutions within EY. The role ensures that solutions are aligned with the overall EY ServiceNow strategy, integrate effectively within the enterprise technology ecosystem, and consistently deliver high-quality business outcomes.
  
  
As the primary representative and advocate of ET ServiceNow, the Product Delivery Manager is accountable for the success of assigned products and services. This includes ownership of product planning, roadmap development, backlog prioritization, stakeholder engagement, and delivery oversight throughout the product lifecycle. The Product Delivery Manager is accountable for evaluating emerging ServiceNow capabilities, aligning them with business objectives, driving stakeholder awareness and adoption through demonstrations and consultations, and establishing a prioritized roadmap and implementation backlog to maximize platform value.
  
  
The role of Product Delivery Manager is responsible for the end-to-end management and delivery of ServiceNow solutions focusing on HR Service Delivery as well as Now Assist capabilities (including AI agents, agentic workflows and now assist skills). In addition, this role would lead implementations to make ServiceNow as an orchestrator to call multiple AI agents within and outside of ServiceNow using Model Context Protocol (MCP) or Agent-to-Agent protocol (A2A) to allow ServiceNow agents to invoke external data sets and APIs.
  
  
The Product Delivery Manager ensures that solutions are delivered in accordance with governance standards, within agreed timelines and budgets, and meet quality, security, and user experience expectation.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**
**Product Strategy & Lifecycle Management:**

* Ensure products align with the EY ServiceNow strategy and broader enterprise technology objectives.
* Evaluate new ServiceNow platform capabilities and features, assess business value, and drive adoption opportunities.
* Develop and maintain the product implementation backlog based on business priorities and platform capabilities.

**Stakeholder Management:**

* Serve as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor between ET ServiceNow and business stakeholders.
* Collaborate with business teams to understand requirements, challenges, and strategic objectives.
* Translate business needs into scalable ServiceNow solutions while promoting platform best practices and standardization.
* Work with multiple stakeholders/ vendors to clear business/ technical impediments/ blockers

**Product backlog and Planning:**

* Own and govern the product backlog, ensuring alignment with business priorities and strategic goals
* Work closely with Product Owners to define, prioritize, and refine features, enhancements, and technical requirements
* Balance business demands with platform capabilities, technical constraints, and long-term solution sustainability (strong functional understanding of ServiceNow is a must. Development experience expected).

**Delivery Management:**

* Successfully execute the project to agreed schedule, budget and scope
* Manage the demand process
* Monitor risks, dependencies, and delivery milestones, implementing mitigation plans as required.
* Coordinate with cross-functional teams, including architecture, development, testing, operations, and vendors.
* Coordinate UAT and production go-live

**Governance and Continuous improvement:**

* Establish and maintain governance processes for product performance, quality, and compliance.
* Track product KPIs, adoption metrics, and customer satisfaction measures.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to optimize business processes and maximize platform value.

**Innovation and Platform enablement:**

* Stay current with ServiceNow roadmap developments and emerging platform capabilities.
* Demonstrate new features and innovations to business stakeholders and leadership teams.
* Identify opportunities to improve user experience, operational efficiency, and business outcomes through ServiceNow.

**Knowledge and Skills Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field
* 3+ years of hands-on experience in ServiceNow development.
* Understanding of ITIL processes and HR Services
* Understanding of conversational experiences, virtual agents, knowledge management, and self-service adoption strategies.
* Implementation expertise of Now Assist capabilities (out of box and custom skills), agentic workflow and AI agents
* Experience in configuring out of box agentic workflows and implementing custom AI agents
* Understanding of A2A and MCP protocols
* Deep functional knowledge of LLMs, agentic patterns and API integration paths (REST)
* Advanced comprehension of agile SAFe project management methodology, tools and templates (includes project planning, schedule development, scope management and cost management)
* Strong problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills
* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) certification

**What are we looking for?**

* A team player and leader with strong technical acumen and leadership capabilities
* Proactive problem-solving mindset with a focus on operational excellence
* Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and priorities in a fast-paced environment
* Passion to learn and adapt to new technologies
* Strong functional/ technical understanding of HRSD and ITSM applications.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Lead. Inspire. Innovate. Define Your Future.

Not everyone who works for a global company shares the same background, experiences and perspectives. We leverage the differences of our employees to bring new ideas to the table. The role will focus on building and maintaining scalable cloud data solutions, supporting data warehouse migration and consolidation, developing data pipelines, and transforming legacy business logic into scalable solutions using **Databricks, Spark SQL, Delta Lake, and AWS S3**.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Build and maintain robust data pipelines using ETL tools, with ingestion into S3 and processing in Databricks.

* Work closely with cross-functional teams to support the transition and integration of data sources into a unified platform.
* Triage, debug, and resolve technical issues related to data lakes and data pipelines.
* Maintain and manage code repositories using **Git**.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, retrospectives, backlog grooming, and other development activities.
* Contribute to the scalability, reliability, and cost optimization of the cloud data platform.

**Required Skills**

* 5+ years of hands-on experience with **Databricks**.
* Strong experience with **Spark SQL and Delta Lake**.
* 3+ years of experience designing and implementing **data lake architectures on Databricks**.
* Strong **SQL and PL/SQL** skills.
* Ability to interpret, reverse-engineer, and refactor legacy stored procedures.
* Hands-on experience with **data modeling and data warehouse design principles**.
* Proficiency in at least one programming language such as **Python, Scala, or Java**.
* Strong understanding of AWS data lake concepts, particularly **Amazon S3**.
* Experience building and maintaining ETL/data pipelines.
* Experience working in **Agile environments** and iterative development cycles.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Engineering, or a related field.

**Good to Have**

* **Databricks certification**.
* Exposure to enterprise data governance.
* Knowledge of metadata management practices.
* Experience with cloud data platform migration or modernization.
* Experience with performance and cost optimization of cloud data platforms.

f66cbe66.title: Lead Specialist, Solution Architect
f66cbe66.description:
Lead Specialist, Solution Architect - OnVUE

About OnVUE

OnVUE is Pearson’s online proctored test delivery platform, supporting the secure, reliable, and scalable delivery of assessments for Pearson’s certification and professional testing business. The platform enables candidates to test remotely while maintaining exam integrity through identity verification, monitoring, secure delivery workflows, and operational controls. The OnVUE environment includes modern and legacy systems, with ongoing focus on platform modernization, service resilience, API-first integration, cloud-native delivery, candidate and proctor experience, and improved developer and operational practices.

Role summary

As a Lead Specialist, Solution Architect, you are a recognized subject-matter expert who provides technical leadership for sophisticated, high-impact solution work. You independently translate business needs, stakeholder constraints, and technical requirements into secure, scalable, viable, and maintainable architectural models and guide solution delivery from inception through implementation.

You maintain technical consistency within the assigned scope, balance advanced solution design with hands-on support for complex delivery challenges, and resolve day-to-day integration and build issues. You influence through depth of knowledge, sound judgment, clear communication, and the ability to steer architecture discussions toward practical outcomes. You mentor engineers, junior architects, and peers, establish trusted technical patterns within your domain, ensure conformance to established frameworks, and escalate decisions that materially exceed the assigned scope to senior experts.

Key responsibilities

Solution architecture and technical leadership

* Translate business needs, stakeholder constraints, and technical requirements into robust architectural models and fit-for-purpose solution designs.
* Own solution architecture from discovery and design through implementation and production adoption.
* Provide technical leadership for high-impact projects, major features, product changes, services, domains, or business capabilities.
* Maintain technical consistency within the assigned product, service, project, domain, or broader solution footprint.
* Evaluate and communicate tradeoffs involving scalability, security, resilience, maintainability, integration, delivery risk, operational needs, and business value.

Implementation and delivery guidance

* Guide engineering and delivery teams through implementation while preserving architectural intent.
* Resolve complex architectural, integration, and build issues within the assigned scope.
* Consult on technical feasibility for major features, updates, integrations, and solution approaches.
* Identify high-stakes architectural risks early and coordinate practical mitigation.
* Adapt architecture to changing requirements without sacrificing solution stability, security, or long-term maintainability.

Standards, influence, and capability building

* Establish trusted and repeatable technical patterns within the assigned domain while ensuring conformance with established architecture frameworks, standards, and guidelines.
* Participate in architecture forums and guide discussions toward sound, practical outcomes.
* Mentor engineers, junior architects, and peers in solution design, technical practices, and architectural decision-making.
* Communicate design options, recommendations, constraints, and tradeoffs clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Escalate decisions outside the assigned scope or requiring senior technical or enterprise direction.

Required education and experience

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience.
* Progressive experience in software engineering, solution architecture, or a related technical discipline.
* Demonstrated experience designing sophisticated solutions and guiding delivery from inception through implementation.
* Experience translating business needs and technical constraints into secure, scalable, maintainable architecture.
* Experience influencing architecture and delivery outcomes without formal authority.

Desired knowledge, skills, and abilities

* Strong solution architecture, system design, integration, and technical problem-solving skills.
* Ability to evaluate solution options and explain tradeoffs across business value, delivery feasibility, risk, and long-term technology health.
* Working knowledge of Java-based enterprise application stacks, cloud-native design, APIs, microservices, event-driven integration, containers, orchestration, CI/CD, observability, security, data consistency, and operational readiness.
* Practical familiarity with service decomposition, API gateway patterns, versioned API contracts, distributed tracing, messaging, data-driven backend systems, and headless or decoupled front-end and back-end architecture patterns.
* Strong documentation, facilitation, communication, and influencing skills.
* Ability to mentor others and introduce trusted, repeatable technical approaches.

Success measures

* Architecture artifacts are clear, fit for purpose, timely, and enable secure, scalable, stable implementation.
* Solution designs are adopted successfully, integrate effectively, and remain durable in production.
* Design choices minimize avoidable rework, support business continuity, and reduce preventable technical risk.
* Technical blockers and high-stakes architectural risks are identified and resolved or escalated in time to protect delivery.
* Documentation and quality standards are met with limited revision cycles.
* Repeatable technical approaches, mentorship, and knowledge transfer improve team effectiveness.
* Stakeholders trust the role to explain design options, constraints, and tradeoffs and to guide solution delivery.

Leadership behaviors

* Customer Centricity — Tailors architecture decisions to real operational and business needs and responds quickly when issues threaten outcomes.
* Raise the Performance Bar — Applies advanced design techniques, strengthens technical practices, and shares approaches that improve solution quality.
* Exceptional Collaboration for Value — Guides technical discussions, incorporates different perspectives, and supports alignment and integration across the assigned scope.
* Our Leaders Inspire — Models technical curiosity, sound judgment, visible accountability, and a commitment to developing others.

**Location & Working Pattern**

India. Bangalore is the preferred location and Chennai is an option. Exact hybrid attendance requirements will be shared during the recruitment process.

**Why Join Pearson?**

* **Technical Governance**: Evaluate technical risks and implementation approaches, support production issue resolution, and maintain architecture diagrams, technical specifications, and development standards

  

**Required Technical Skills**

* Strong technical decision-making, problem-solving, communication, team mentoring skills
* Working knowledge of Java and PostgreSQL is desirable.

  

**Preferred Domain Knowledge**

  

* Experience in Mediclaim, health insurance, TPA, or healthcare applications.
* Familiarity with cashless pre-authorization, reimbursement claims, member enrollment, policy data, hospital networks, and insurer/corporate integrations.
* Knowledge of cloud platforms, containerization, distributed systems, health data privacy, and audit requirements.

  

**Qualifications & Expected Outcomes**

* Strong analytical, communication, stakeholder management, and technical decision-making skills.

The role will focus on assessing Azure services, defining and implementing security controls, and identifying security risks, misconfigurations, and control gaps across enterprise Azure environments.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Define, review, and recommend security policies, standards, and controls for Azure infrastructure and services.

* Identify potential security risks, misconfigurations, and gaps associated with Azure infrastructure and services.

* Use **attack path analysis** to identify potential attack routes and security weaknesses within Azure environments.

* Strong knowledge of Azure **networking, compute, storage, identity, access management, and resource management**.
* Experience developing, reviewing, or assessing cloud security policies, standards, and controls.
* Ability to translate technical security risks and requirements into practical security controls.
* Experience assessing Azure infrastructure and services from a security perspective.
* Good understanding of the **Microsoft Cloud Security Benchmark (MCSB)** and its application to Azure environments.
* Understanding of **attack path analysis** and its use in identifying potential security risks and attack routes.
* Knowledge of **Azure Policy, governance, and security best practices**.
* Basic knowledge of **Microsoft Defender for Cloud**.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and risk-assessment skills.

30d0b386.title: Principal Technical Program Manager, Fulfillment By Amazon (FBA)
30d0b386.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Ready to do something big?  
  
How would you build the next generation of mission-critical systems and services that power the ability to send, store, and manage billions of products across the globe on behalf of our selling partners?  
  
Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) is the Amazon service for worldwide sellers that offers access to Amazon's vast distribution network as a service. Similar to how AWS provides infrastructure as a service, FBA allows sellers to only pay for what they use, leveraging our world-class infrastructure. Sellers in 135 countries worldwide, from Fortune 50 companies to hundreds of thousands of small businesses and entrepreneurs, rely upon our technology to grow and thrive on Amazon's Marketplaces.  
  
In a very real way, we are changing lives with the work we do. FBA team members wake up every day thinking about how to enable our sellers to be successful by building highly scalable and highly reliable platforms. Enabling seller success allows us to provide Amazon customers with unparalleled selection and pricing. FBA is a win for sellers and a win for customers.  
  
What is Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA)?  
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IAi4fPb\_kp4&t=2s  
  
The Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) team  
https://vimeo.com/80948105  
  
Third-party sellers have become one of Amazon's greatest growth engines, outpacing our own first-party retail business for years. That success did not happen by accident. We invested in building the best possible selling tools — from inventory management and payment processing to shipment tracking, reporting, and cross-border commerce — and we continue to invent new ones every year. FBA and the Prime membership program sit at the heart of that effort, dramatically improving the customer experience of buying from independent sellers and unlocking growth for businesses of every size.  
  
As a Principal Technical Program Manager with FBA, you will lead broad cross-organization efforts from the early stages through release. You will work closely with product managers, engineering managers, scientists, and engineers to build the next generation of seller platforms. You will be responsible for influencing the organization's product and technical roadmap and technical architecture. You will drive organization-wide engineering and operational excellence initiatives, represent difficult trade-off decisions and solutions clearly to senior leaders, and leverage your technical knowledge to guide technical choices. You will manage cross-functional and cross-organization communication to ensure all stakeholders are informed and needs are aligned, guiding technical direction to deliver solutions that meet Amazon's high standards for customer satisfaction, efficiency, stability, extensibility, simplicity, and operational excellence.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Lead broad, cross-organizational programs from strategy definition through delivery, owning the technology roadmap for seller-facing platforms and driving alignment across product, engineering, and science teams.
* Define and decompose complex technical problems into clear solutions, assessing risk, driving clarity, and creating the right sense of urgency to keep programs on track.
* Influence the organization's product and technical architecture by applying deep system knowledge, identifying gaps across services and workflows, and proposing improvements that reduce repeated effort year over year.
* Partner with senior leadership to communicate trade-offs, present options, and drive decisions — managing cross-functional stakeholder alignment and escalating with strong judgment when necessary.
* Amplify your impact by mentoring other technical program managers, driving adoption of program management best practices, and contributing to the broader technical community.

  
A day in the life  
Your primary focus will be guiding large-scale, cross-team programs that directly shape how millions of sellers interact with Amazon's fulfillment network. You will spend your time working across product managers, engineering leaders, and scientists — aligning priorities, unblocking technical decisions, and ensuring delivery stays on course. Expect a mix of deep technical design reviews, strategic roadmap discussions with senior leaders, and hands-on problem solving when programs hit ambiguity.  
  
About the team  
The FBA team builds and operates the platforms that enable sellers in 135 countries to store, ship, and manage billions of products through Amazon's global fulfillment network. Our mission is straightforward: make sellers successful so customers get the selection and value they expect. We are investing in the next generation of seller tools and infrastructure, and this role will be central to shaping that future. If you want to work on programs that operate at massive scale and have a direct impact on both sellers and customers worldwide, this is the team for you.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
* 5+ years of technical product or program management experience
* 5+ years of software development experience
* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
* Experience managing technical programs across cross-functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering or a related field

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 8+ years of hands-on work managing complex technology projects experience
* Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

37122c51.title: Presales Consultant
37122c51.description:
**Company Description**

  

Truva is a prop-tech ,real estate startup founded by IIT and Stanford alumni to make buying and selling homes in India simple, transparent, and enjoyable. The company specializes in fully renovated, quality-checked, and legally assured homes for buyers, and offers sellers a streamlined process with upfront tokens and guaranteed pricing. Truva manages the end-to-end transaction, including data-backed pricing, professional renovations, legal paperwork, and one-year quality guarantees. Currently operating in Mumbai, Truva has helped over 100 families buy and sell homes worth more than 160 crores since its launch in January 2024. The team is focused on building the future of real estate transactions through technology, operational excellence, and customer-centric services.

  

**Role Description**

  

The Presales Consultant role at Truva is a full-time/ contractual, on-site position based in Mumbai. In this role, you will be closely working with the sales team to understand client requirements, analyze property and market data, and craft tailored solutions that highlight Truvas offerings. Day-to-day responsibilities include conducting discovery calls, preparing presentations, demos, and proposals, and supporting client meetings with clear explanations of Truvas processes, guarantees, and value proposition. The consultant collaborates with operations and project teams to ensure feasibility and alignment of proposed solutions, and maintains accurate documentation of presales activities in internal systems. This role also involves contributing to continuous improvement of presales playbooks, gathering feedback from prospects, and supporting training for new team members on Truvas products and services.

  

**Qualifications**

* Strong Analytical Skills to interpret market data, property metrics, and client requirements.
* Experience in Consulting and Presales, including client engagements.
* Demonstrated Sales acumen, with the ability to support deal closure and communicate value effectively.
* Project Management capabilities to coordinate cross-functional efforts and ensure timely delivery of proposals.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex information clearly.
* Comfort working on-site in a fast-paced startup environment in Mumbai, with a collaborative and proactive mindset.
* Background in real estate, financial services, or technology-driven services is an added advantage.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Economics, or a related field; an advanced degree is a plus.
* Proficiency with productivity and presentation tools (e.g., Excel, PowerPoint, CRM platforms).

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a AI Architect - Cross Functional to join our team in Bangalore, Karnātaka (IN-KA), India (IN).
  
  
AI Solution Architect
  
  
NTT DATA is a trusted global innovator of business and technology services, helping clients innovate, optimize, and transform for success. We strive to hire exceptional, innovative, and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
Overview:
  
  
The AI Solution Architect designs fit-for-purpose AI solutions for qualified opportunities, aligned to client requirements, NTT DATA offering standards, commercial expectations, and delivery capabilities. This role owns the practical translation of client needs into solution blueprints, scope, work estimates, phasing, timelines, pricing inputs, SOW content, and delivery handoff materials. The AI Solution Architect partners closely with AI Consultants, Principal Architects, FDE, Delivery, Finance, Commercial, Sales, and ecosystem partners.

* Design AI solutions aligned to client requirements, NTT DATA standards, and delivery capabilities.

a87ae94a.title: Salesforce Technical Architect
a87ae94a.description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*
Job Category
  
  
Customer Success
  
  
Job Details
  
  
**About Salesforce**
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
  
  
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
  
  
Technical Architect successfully designs and manages the delivery of complex Salesforce solutions for our customers. These technologies include—but are not necessarily limited to Salesforce products and APIs, Apex/Visualforce, Lightning, mobile development technologies, and integration/ETL technologies.
  
  
You are both a big picture thinker and in-depth problem solver, your knowledge and skills are both broad and deep. You take pride in designing systems that stand up to high volumes and won't fail at critical points. You have a good mix of technical and enterprise skills when it comes to architecting a solution, including knowing how to leverage AI development tools like Claude and GitHub Copilot to optimize code quality and accelerate design cycles. The solutions you design are built for the long-term and will scale with the customer's growth plans seamlessly. You have proven experience integrating systems via API's as well as a strong development background.
  
  
**What You'll Actually Be Doing**

* Collaborate with client stakeholders to define requirements, deliverables, and set and manage expectations
* Translate business requirements into well-architected solutions that best leverage the Salesforce platform, including identifying opportunities to embed autonomous AI capabilities using Agentforce
* Drive Enterprise AI Architecture by designing and integrating scalable predictive and generative AI solutions within custom Salesforce environments, optimizing performance, resource consumption, and platform governor limits
* Lead technical design sessions; architect and document technical solutions aligned with client business objectives; identify gaps between client's current and desired end states, using advanced LLMs like Claude to review architectural assumptions and simulate system edge cases
* Provide oversight and governance of Salesforce projects, championing an AI-First Delivery & Engineering methodology by utilizing advanced AI tools, developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude), and agentic evaluation frameworks to accelerate implementation
* Follow and help define coding standards. Lead code reviews during projects to ensure quality and appropriate design patterns are followed, utilizing AI coding assistants to help enforce standards and optimize code performance
* Manage the technical delivery of custom development, integrations, and data migration elements of a Salesforce implementation, championing the team's use of tools like GitHub Copilot to accelerate the generation of Apex classes, mock data, and REST integrations
* Focus on Performance Evaluation & ROI by collaborating with customers to develop evaluation frameworks to measure AI performance and business value for their specific use cases
* Maintain a target billable utilization aligned to the role
* Ability to understand a project and deep dive to debug issues, leveraging AI diagnostics to interpret system logs and isolate performance bottlenecks quickly
* From time-to-time, the TA may be expected to partake in other pre-sales activities such as discovery and technical deep-dive sessions, Proof-Of-Concept (POC) development with prospects using AI tools to build prototypes rapidly
* Liaise with Salesforce product teams to support client implementations
* Travels to client sites for projects, estimated 50-75%

**You're Our Person If...**

* Degree or equivalent proven experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core proficiencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)
* 9-14 years CRM experience with a minimum of 6 years on the Salesforce platform
* Expert level understanding of the Salesforce product suite, including Sales, Service, Community, Marketing, and Community Clouds, as well as an understanding of Agentforce architecture
* Understanding of systems architecture and ability to design scalable performance-driven solutions, including using AI platforms to evaluate architectural scaling and load limits
* Understanding of key design patterns and large data volume limitations and best practices, with experience using AI tools to model data distribution and analyze potential data skew risks
* Understanding of data sharing and visibility considerations and how these play into platform architecture
* Familiarity with platform authentication patterns (SAML, SSO, OAuth) and how to configure them securely
* Knowledge of data integration tools and experience integrating Salesforce with different business systems (ETL, CPQ, marketing automation, reporting, etc.), utilizing AI platforms to parse third-party REST API documentation and map complex data schemas
* Strong understanding of environment management, release management, code versioning best practices, and deployment methodologies
* Experience with platform security capabilities (TLS, SSL)
* Practical fluency using AI coding assistants and modern development ecosystems (e.g., Copilot, Cursor, Claude) to accelerate delivery, document technical architecture, and maintain a high standard of code quality
* Expert level experience defining the system architecture landscape, identifying gaps between current and desired end-states, and delivering a comprehensive solution that will enable achievement of the desired business outcomes
* Strong background in design/development of large web-based systems, or complete software product lifecycle exposure
* Active Salesforce certifications or ability to achieve relevant certifications upon hire.

Unleash Your Potential
  
  
When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
*be your best*
, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can
*do your best*
. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.
  
  
Accommodations
  
  
If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.
  
  
Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.
  
  
Posting Statement
  
  
Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

**Were Hiring | Principal Software Architect High-Performance Computing**

**Location:** Chennai | Bengaluru

**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**About the Role:**

We are looking for an experienced Software Architect with deep expertise in High-Performance Computing, GPU infrastructure, parallel programming, and heterogeneous computing.  
The role involves designing and optimizing high-performance solutions for low-latency, high-throughput image processing and deep-learning workloads, working across CPUs, GPUs, and FPGAs.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Design and implement scalable HPC infrastructure using CPUs, GPUs and FPGAs.  
  • Architect workload partitioning across different compute units for optimal performance.  
  • Develop prototypes and contribute hands-on code to validate architectural designs.  
  • Lead performance profiling, optimization and capacity planning across HPC clusters.  
  • Optimize GPU workloads and monitor GPU infrastructure using tools such as NVIDIA DCGM.  
  • Work closely with algorithm, product and engineering teams to translate requirements into technical solutions.  
  • Act as a technical SME and provide architectural guidance to engineering teams.  
  • Evaluate technologies and frameworks for scalable, reliable and cost-effective solutions.

**Must-Have Skills:**

* 10–20 years of experience in **HPC** / Software Architecture / Heterogeneous Computing.
* Strong programming skills in **C/C++** and Data Structures amp; Algorithms.
* Hands-on experience with **CUDA / GPU Programming**.
* Experience with MPI, UCX or similar parallel programming frameworks.
* Strong understanding of multithreading, synchronization, IPC and distributed computing.
* Experience with GPU inference platforms such as NVIDIA Triton.
* Hands-on experience with performance profiling tools such as VTune, perf, NVIDIA Nsight, etc.
* Experience with low-level optimization, vectorization, intrinsics and cache-aware programming.
* Experience with Docker/Singularity and microservices architecture.
* Strong understanding of parallel and distributed systems.

We're looking for a
**Principal Consultant- Oracle Cloud HCM**
to own the end-to-end architecture and design integrity of complex, high-value HCM transformation programs, including AI-enhanced solutions. You'll be the recognized HCM subject matter expert who shapes solution strategy, guides design decisions, mentors architects and consultants, and makes sure what is designed is what gets delivered. **Key Responsibilities**

**Solution Architecture & Design**

* Design end-to-end Oracle Cloud HCM architectures across Core HR, Talent Management, Benefits, Time & Labor, Recruitment, and Workforce Management

* Define integration architecture (HCM Extracts, HDL, REST/SOAP APIs, OIC, Payroll, Finance, and third-party systems), data migration strategy, and security and role design
* Build reusable solution accelerators, industry templates, and reference architectures on Oracle Cloud HCM

**Implementation Leadership & Governance**

* Own the solution architecture across the full implementation lifecycle, from discovery and fit-gap through design, build, test, deployment, and hypercare
* Lead fit-gap analysis and drive design decisions, including configuration vs. extension trade-offs
* Serve as the technical and functional escalation point, protecting design intent through delivery
* Establish solution governance: design authority forums, architecture reviews, and change control
* Represent the solution in steering committees and stakeholder reviews

**Pre-Sales & Client Advisory**

* Support strategic pursuits with solution strategy, effort and risk assessment, and technical sections of complex RFP/RFI responses
* Run executive workshops and architecture discussions, translating technical solutions into business outcomes
* Build high-impact demos and POCs that show measurable ROI

**Emerging Technology: Agentic AI & Redwood**

* Architect solutions that integrate Oracle Cloud HCM with Gen AI and Agentic AI capabilities (intelligent process automation, conversational HR assistants, AI-driven talent and workforce insights)
* Guide Oracle Redwood adoption, including UI/UX, personalization, and change and adoption planning
* Advise clients on Oracle's AI and Redwood roadmap and how to sequence adoption

**Team Leadership & Enablement**

* Mentor solution architects, functional leads, and consultants on design standards and best practices
* Drive quality through design reviews, peer reviews, and reusable knowledge assets
* Collaborate with Oracle product management and the partner ecosystem on roadmap alignment and co-innovation

**Required Skills & Experience**

* Deep functional and architectural expertise across Oracle Cloud HCM: Core HR, Talent Management, Benefits, Time & Labor, Recruitment, and Workforce Management
* Proven track record as a lead or architect on multiple full-lifecycle Oracle Cloud HCM implementations or large-scale transformation programs, with named projects and clear ownership
* Strong command of integration, data migration, security, and reporting/analytics (OTBI, BI Publisher, HCM Extracts, HDL, OIC)
* Ability to design and speak credibly to solutions integrating Oracle Cloud HCM with Gen AI and Agentic AI
* Hands-on exposure to Oracle Redwood (UI, personalization, adoption)
* Experience leading fit-gap analysis, solution governance, and design authority forums
* Strong communication and storytelling skills, able to explain architecture to both technical and executive audiences
* Strong stakeholder management across client leadership, delivery, sales, and product teams
* Ability to build and deliver demos and POCs with measurable outcomes
* Willingness to travel for client engagements as needed

**Preferred Skills & Experience**

* Multi-country or global HCM rollouts, including compliance and localization
* Thought leadership in HCM transformation, such as speaking engagements or published POVs
* Working knowledge of commercial structuring, deal shaping, and SaaS partnership models
* Experience partnering with Oracle product management or the partner ecosystem on roadmap and co-innovation

704e0320.description:
**Overview**
With more than 45,000 employees and partners worldwide, the Customer Experience and Success (CE&S) organization is on a mission to empower customers to accelerate business value through differentiated customer experiences that leverage Microsoft’s products and services, ignited by our people and culture. We drive cross-company alignment and execution, ensuring that we consistently exceed customers’ expectations in every interaction, whether in-product, digital, or human-centered. CE&S is responsible for all up services across the company, including consulting, customer success, and support across Microsoft’s portfolio of solutions and products. Join CE&S and help us accelerate AI transformation for our customers and the world.
  
  
The Global Customer Success (GCS) organization is leading the effort to create the desired customer experience through support offer creation, driving digital transformation across our tools, and delivering operational excellence across CE&S.
  
  
As a Cloud Solution Architect aligned to Factory delivery, you will enable customers to achieve their outcomes based on their investments in Microsoft technology. Leveraging your Microsoft Copilot Studio technical subject matter expertise, you will lead technical conversations with customers and Microsoft colleagues, driving value to their organization. This is a hands-on role that includes accelerating customer adoption by building Agentic AI solutions and identifying resolutions to unblock customer success projects for the AI Factory. You will also drive product influence with Engineering through technical feedback via the[MR1.1][PR1.2][PR1.3] factory. This opportunity will allow you to accelerate your career growth, honing your technical and program management skills, and deepen your cloud expertise.
  
  
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees, we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
  
  
CSAs are senior individual contributors who operate globally and engage directly with customers. It is a hands-on technical role spanning across design, build, and production with a focus on issue resolution to remove customer production blockers. Candidates are expected to comfortably switch from a whiteboard to the keyboard. This is a truly exciting role that will feature unique and challenging technical problems to solve and to help our customers succeed.
  
  
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Customer-Centric Approach:
  
  

* Play a pivotal role in the AI Cloud Accelerate Factory, providing technical enablement, operational support, and strategic engagement across customer projects. This role is designed to ensure successful delivery of AI solutions built on Copilot Studio, troubleshoot complex issues, and support innovation through pilot evaluations and advanced use case development. Understand customers' overall data estate, business priorities, and IT success measures. Innovate with Agent solutions that drive business value.
