a92fd548.description:
**WELCOME TO BASF**
At BASF Digital Hub Hyderabad we develop innovative digital solutions for BASF, create new exciting customer experiences and business growth, and drive efficiencies in processes, helping to strengthen BASF´s position as the digital leader in the chemical industry. We believe the right path is through creativity, trial and error and great people working and learning together. Become part of our team and develop the future with us - in a global team that embraces diversity and equal opportunities.
  
  
**Objectives**
:
  
  
BASF’s Business Process Integration (BPI) team provides and supports digital solutions for B2B integrations with external partners through a variety of systems and processes within the BASF’s architectural landscape. BPI is considered a strategic tool to digitalize processes and enable seamless exchange of data between applications, businesses, customers and partners in real-time.
  
  
In this role, you will focus on consulting representatives of BASF businesses and BASF partners on integrating business processes primarily in the Order-to Invoice process area, including respective mappings.
  
  
**Role**
:
  
  
The Solution Consultant provides customized integration solutions for internal partners and external partners via EDI, API, Micro Services, AI Agents, and similar technologies.
  
  
The Solution Consultant supports our internal (SAP ERP and Satellite Systems) and external partners to specify their requirements and translates those into best-in-class solution designs based on technical and business process knowledge, aligned with process design and architecture. The consultant will be responsible for supplemental tasks in the daily operation, e.g. operational support (2nd/3rd level), issue resolving, quality assurance, and business interaction. The role does also include assignments to support comprehensive business integration projects.
  
  
The Solution Consultant works in a global, international setting, interacting with team members in all other regions to provide sustainable digital solutions for our partners.
  
  
Additional work aspects: strategic contribution to IT architecture and cross-process digitalization efforts, interact with connectivity solutions by supporting API, micro services, generative AI and other industries relevant technical developments.
  
  
The business processes in scope of this role are: Order-to-Cash, Order-to-Invoice.
  
  
**Requirements**
:
  
  
**Education**
:
  
  

* Master's degree in computer science, business or STEM major with 4-6 years of IT or related field experience OR
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, business or STEM major with 6-8 years of IT or related field experience OR
* Diploma or comparable training with 6+ years of professional experience in IT and/or business areas

**Work Experience**
:
  
  

* Minimum 4 years related working experience
* Experiencing Agile way of working or agile implementation approach
* Work experience in an international company is a plus

**Technical & Professional Knowledge (mandatory and nice to have)**
:
  
  
**Our main requirements:**

* Consult and support internal and external partners when dealing with complex processes and IT application questions.
* Good business knowledge in various application and process areas, esp. Order to Invoice: Sales Orders, Deliveries, Picking-Post Goods Issue, Invoicing, Inter Company Flows).
* Conducts and support the technical implementation of the B2B Integration to external partners
* Showing strong transactional experience in SAP R3 and/or S4/HANA (SD / MM)
* Ability to work and navigate in SAP middleware platforms (PO, CPI Integration Suite)
* Provides a deep technical understanding of standard connectivity messages EDI-APIs and programming protocols (supporting e.g. iDocs, XML, EDIFACT, JSON, UI etc.)
* Execute studies in preliminary stages of projects, including evaluation of existing or new solutions
* Familiar with Azure DevOps (or GitHub or similar)
* Consult and support IT analysis (process and/or data), mentoring, modeling, solution design and optimization of related business processes and models
* Coordinate and execute prototyping, configuration and testing of solutions based on BASF requirements, while ensuring quality and security aspects
* Provide structured acceptance, analysis and description of solutions and/or concepts
* Support and/or steer the formulation of more complex costs estimates for efforts spend solution design, testing and implementation of business solutions
* Provides Business support and training (processes, tools, reports, etc.) where required
* Provide guidance and structure to enable day2day operational support incl, advising external support resources
* Extensive knowledge of standard connectivity messages, related business processes and applications

**Personal traits:**

* You can demonstrate fluent communication skills in English (spoken and written)
* Well-developed sense of teamwork in an international team with strong interpersonal, written and verbal communication and conflict resolution skills.
* Business consulting skill with a focus on value generation
* Ambitious, proactive & entrepreneurial character
* Highly developed sense of responsibility
* High customer- and innovation-orientation
* Time flexibility to work across different time zones

**Nice to have:**

* Experiences as project manager
* Experiences in strategic planning and realization
* Experiences in AI Agents and AI based communciation
* Certifications in Agile, SAP S/4

**Language Proficiency:**
Fluent spoken and written English proficiency.
  
  
**What We Offer**
Be part of a global leader in digital transformation, working in a vibrant Digital Hub that values innovation, agility, and cross-functional collaboration. Shape the future of BASF’s digital landscape, contributing to projects that drive sustainability and make a real impact. Thrive in a high-performance culture that supports your personal and professional growth, offering diverse learning opportunities and career development. Enjoy a modern, inclusive work environment where your ideas are valued, and your curiosity and ambition are encouraged. Benefit from flexible working models, international networking, and a strong sense of purpose as we enable our customers’ green transformation and lead the way in digital excellence.

ebd47653.title: Solutions Architect - Backend (Agentic AI & Python)
ebd47653.description:
**Job Description**
Responsibilities: - Agentic AI and LLM Orchestration: Design, build, and take to production agentic AI systems with multi-step, tool-using workflows in which LLMs reason, plan, and trigger external function calls to complete complex tasks reliably. Architect and implement robust orchestration and tool-calling loops using frameworks such as LangGraph, AutoGen, or CrewAI, or well-structured custom implementations. Design conversational and workflow state management, memory, context handling, and multi-turn continuity for reliable long-running agent interactions. - Implement retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) patterns: document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector stores, and grounded generation with citations to improve accuracy and traceability. - Apply advanced prompt engineering, guardrails, evaluation, and fallback strategies to maximise reliability and minimise hallucination in production agent behaviour. - Integrate model APIs (such as OpenAI and Anthropic) into backend services, focusing on the agentic routing and orchestration layer rather than training foundational models. - Design agent-to-agent and multi-agent orchestration patterns for complex, decomposed workflows. - Backend Architecture and API Development: Architect, design, and develop robust, scalable backend services and RESTful/event-driven APIs that power AI-driven and conventional workloads at scale. EngiNeo Solutions - Lead the end-to-end design of backend systems from domain modelling and service. - Build and maintain services using modern Python frameworks, with deep expertise in FastAPI, applying clean architecture and well-established design patterns. - Own service performance tuning, profiling, query optimisation, caching, and resource management to ensure efficient handling of large-scale traffic. - Design and implement asynchronous and concurrent processing patterns using async/await, background workers, task queues, and message-driven workflows. - Build real-time streaming interfaces using Server-Sent Events (SSE) or WebSockets to stream LLM responses and live updates to clients. - Implement reliable messaging and event-processing patterns using tools such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, or Celery where applicable. - Define reliability standards, retry logic, timeout handling, graceful degradation, and idempotent processing across all asynchronous and AI workloads. - Third-Party Integration and Orchestration: Design and build integrations with external APIs and platforms, managing complex multi-step orchestration flows and service-to-service state machines. - Handle asynchronous third-party failure states gracefully alongside the agent's reasoning logic, with robust timeout, fallback, and reconciliation strategies. - Build integration and middleware layers that abstract external dependencies and keep the core system decoupled and testable. - Security, Authentication and Compliance: Design and implement secure authentication and authorisation, including token-based mechanisms such as JWT and OAuth 2.0 cryptographic signing, and role-based access control. Apply secure-by-design principles: input validation, secrets management, least-privilege access, and secure handling of sensitive data across services. - Configure secure network patterns: CORS, content security policies, and outbound proxying and ensure services meet applicable security and compliance requirements. - Cloud, DevOps and Reliability: Design and deploy backend and AI services on cloud platforms AWS, GCP, or Azure using containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) and cloud-native services. - Champion DevOps practices: CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, observability, and environment management to improve reliability and deployment velocity. Implement monitoring, logging, tracing, and alerting to ensure system health, and lead incident diagnosis and resolution. - Technical Leadership and Mentoring: Serve as a technical lead for the backend and AI engineering team, providing architectural guidance, conducting design and code reviews, and setting coding and documentation standards. Mentor and coach junior and mid-level engineers through hands-on guidance and structured feedback to accelerate their technical growth. - Lead technical discussions, architecture design sessions, and proof-of-concept evaluations for new AI and backend initiatives. Contribute to engineering roadmap planning, sprint estimation, and technical backlog prioritisation in collaboration with the engineering manager. - Collaboration and Stakeholder Engagement: Partner closely with product managers, frontend engineers, QA, data engineers, and solution architects to deliver high-quality, production-ready features. Engage directly with stakeholders to understand requirements, translate them into technical specifications, and manage expectations on delivery timelines. Participate in Agile ceremonies sprint planning, standups, retrospectives, and reviews and contribute to continuous improvement of the team's delivery processes. Requirements: - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or a related engineering discipline. - 7-10 years of hands-on backend engineering experience, with a strong focus on building and scaling production services and APIs. - Proven, production-grade experience designing and building agentic AI / LLM-orchestration workflows using frameworks such as LangGraph, AutoGen, or CrewAI, or robust custom tool-calling implementations. - Demonstrated ability to instruct an LLM to reliably reason, trigger external function calls, and manage conversational state and memory in production. - Expert-level proficiency in Python, including asynchronous programming, with deep experience in FastAPI. - Strong expertise in real-time streaming (SSE / WebSockets) for LLM responses and asynchronous/event-driven processing. - Proven experience integrating third-party model APIs (such as OpenAI or Anthropic) and orchestrating complex external API state machines. - Solid understanding of authentication, authorisation, and application security best practices, including token-based auth (JWT / OAuth 2.0). - Hands-on experience with relational databases and SQL, and experience deploying services on at least one major cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure) with containerization. - Experience with the Model Context Protocol (MCP) or making enterprise systems agent-ready. - Experience building RAG systems at scale: embeddings, vector databases, and grounded generation with citations. - Familiarity with message brokers and streaming platforms: Kafka, RabbitMQ, or cloud-native equivalents. - Experience with LLM evaluation, observability, and guardrail tooling. - Experience with observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Datadog) and structured logging. Soft Skills and Leadership Qualities: - Strong ownership mindset takes end-to-end accountability for backend and AI deliverables and system reliability. - Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical peers and non-technical stakeholders. - Collaborative and team-oriented, works effectively across product, engineering, and business teams in a fast-paced environment. - Structured problem-solver who can diagnose and resolve complex production issues under time pressure. - Proactive learner who stays current with the rapidly evolving agentic AI, LLM, and backend engineering landscape. - Experience working in Agile delivery environments with a continuous improvement mindset. Company Summary EngiNeo specializes in SaaS, PaaS, and IaaS implementation services, offering cutting-edge cloud solutions to catalyze digital transformation in Indian enterprises. EngiNeo Team is founded by a team of professionals of Ex-Pwc, Ex-EY, Ex-KPMG, Ex- Oracle who have a combined experience of 50+ years in Technology Consulting, driving ERP implementations, and managed services for customers across industries. We aspire to be the premier suite of cloud product services, targeting the intricate digital transformation requirements of small and medium enterprises in India. We at EngiNeo carry expertise in driving ERP implementations and managed services for customers across industries like banking and finance, telecom, BPO, and professional services for modules like project-task management, contract management, payables, receivables, asset management, taxation, and people management. Our experience with Big4 consulting (PwC, EY, KPMG) has also enabled us to understand problems and advise customers on how to operationalize and automate their cloud investments through multiple models i. e. Applications, Infrastructure, and Services.

* Handle minor enhancements, CRs (Change Requests), and configuration updates as per business need
* Provide end-user support, training, and query resolution related to GL processes

* Practical experience with allocations, revaluation, translation, and consolidation processes
* Experience handling period-close cycle issues and providing close-window support
* Working knowledge of GL integration points with AP, AR, FA, CM, and Expenses
* Hands-on experience with OTBI, FRS (Financial Reporting Studio), and Smart View for troubleshooting/reporting issues
* Familiarity with FBDI templates and resolving failed import/interface issues

* Understanding of Oracle Cloud release cycles (quarterly updates) and their impact on GL configurations
* Good knowledge of ITSM/ticketing tools (ServiceNow, JIRA, Remedy)

f54a5fc1.title: Oracle Cloud PPM Functional Consultant
f54a5fc1.description:
Job Title: Oracle Cloud PPM

Job Type: Hybird /Remote

Job Loc: PAN India / Full Time

Rel Exp: 6+ yrs

NP: immediate to 15 Days

**Key Skills**
:

Oracle Fusion Cloud PPM, Project Costing, Project Billing, Project Contracts, Project Financial Management, Project Accounting, Budgeting, Costing, Billing, Revenue Recognition, Capitalisation, Oracle Financials, GL, AP, AR, FA, CRP, SIT, UAT, Data Migration, Cutover, Post-Go-Live Support, Oracle Cloud Integrations, Reports, Customisations, Production Support, Impact Analysis, Customer Receivables, Month-End Activities, Cross Charge.

**Description:**

We are seeking a pure-play Oracle PPM Functional Consultant with strong construction/EPC industry domain knowledge to lead solutioning and delivery of Oracle Fusion Cloud PPM engagements. This is a functional (non-technical) role, the ideal candidate is someone who can sit directly with business stakeholders (project controllers, cost engineers, project managers, finance), translate their construction project lifecycle needs into Oracle solutions, and drive design decisions independently with minimal technical/developer hand-holding.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Business Requirement Gathering & Solutioning**

* Lead workshops with construction industry stakeholders (project controls, project accounting, procurement, PMO) to elicit business requirements
* Translate business processes specific to construction- job costing, WIP, retention billing, subcontractor cost tracking, change orders, capital project accounting — into Oracle PPM functional designs
* Independently drive fit-gap analysis, identifying where standard Oracle functionality meets requirements vs. where workarounds/extensions are needed
* Own solution architecture at the functional level: propose to-be process flows, configuration approach, and integration touchpoints
* Present solution options to client stakeholders/steering committees with clear trade-offs (standard functionality vs. customization, effort vs. value)
* Author Business Requirement Documents (BRDs), Functional Design Documents (FDDs), and Solution Design Documents (SDDs)

**Oracle PPM Functional Configuration**

* Configure Project Foundation: project types, classifications, templates, resource breakdown structures, calendars
* Configure Project Costing tailored to construction: cost collection from subcontractors/vendors, transaction types, burdening/overhead application, cross-charge for shared equipment/labor pools
* Configure Project Billing: progress billing, milestone billing, retention billing/retainage, T&M and unit-price contract billing common in construction
* Configure Project Management module: WBS setup, task/schedule integration, resource staffing and utilization for field/site resources
* Configure capital project accounting: CIP (construction-in-progress) tracking, asset capitalization triggers, project-to-asset transfer processes
* Support budgeting/forecasting workflows aligned to construction project stage-gates (bid, award, execution, closeout)

**Construction Industry-Specific Domain Expertise**

* Project Management cycle
* Sub Contract Management

**Delivery Leadership**

* Act as the functional SME/lead on Oracle PPM workstreams within larger ERP or EPC digital transformation programs
* Drive design decisions and unblock ambiguity without constant escalation, comfortable owning decisions in fast-paced client environments
* Prepare and lead CRP (Conference Room Pilot) sessions, SIT/UAT test scripts, and cutover planning
* Coordinate (not necessarily build) with technical teams for integrations (OIC), reports (OTBI/BIP), and data conversion (FBDI/HDL), translating functional needs into clear technical specs
* Provide steady-state/hypercare support post go-live, including quarterly release impact assessments

**Stakeholder Management**

* Build trusted advisor relationships with client project controls and finance leadership
* Facilitate governance/steering committee discussions on scope, design decisions, and risk
* Mentor junior functional consultants on Oracle PPM configuration and construction domain nuances

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 7+ years specifically on Oracle PPM (Fusion Cloud PPM; EBS PPM background acceptable if actively working in Cloud)
* Prior experience delivering Oracle PPM in
  **construction, EPC, infrastructure, or capital-intensive industries**
  is mandatory, this is a differentiator, not a nice-to-have
* Demonstrated experience independently gathering requirements and driving solution design directly with business users (not just executing a pre-defined design)
* Strong functional configuration experience across: Project Costing, Project Billing, Project Management, and ideally Project Financial Planning
* Working knowledge of construction-specific financial concepts: job costing, advance, advance recovery, retention/retainage billing, change order management, WIP schedules, POC revenue recognition
* Experience with capital project accounting and CIP-to-asset capitalization processes
* Exposure to schedule-to-cost integration concepts
* Comfortable authoring BRDs/FDDs and presenting solution options to senior client stakeholders
* Minimum 2-3 full lifecycle Oracle Fusion Cloud PPM implementations, at least one in a construction/EPC client environment
* Excellent verbal and written communication; able to run workshops and steer client conversations confidently

**Preferred Certifications**

* Oracle Cloud PPM Certified Implementation Specialist (Project Financial Management / Project Management)
* PMP / PGMP
* Construction-specific certifications (e.g., CCIFP, Certified Construction Industry Financial Professional), a strong plus

**Nice-to-Have**

* Prior experience with Oracle Textura (subcontractor/payment management) if the client uses it alongside PPM
* Experience with Oracle Grants Management (for infrastructure/public sector construction clients).

The purpose of the role is to ensure excellent customer service delivery of all technology solutions and products to clients, through effective project management, service metrics tracking, budget management, issue resolution, optimal resource allocation, and maintenance of a skilled team of all delivery resources for the client.

͏

**Do**

* **Oversee and manage service delivery by meeting all contractual/ SLA commitments**
  + Contract compliance & adherence
    - Ensure all SLA parameters are met in the account
    - Review and drive appropriate actions/ systemic changes on internal and external audit findings to ensure no major non-compliances are cited
    - Monitor and review all projects in the account on various delivery parameters to ensure quality delivery as per budget and timelines
    - Ensure that the service credits, performance incentives, penalty and penalty waivers are incorporated in the invoices
  + Delivery governance across the accounts/projects
    - Lead delivery teams to understand customer goals and key performance metrics and their thresholds for each project
    - Ensure that the project performance parameters stay green for all accounts
    - Monitor and review delivery dashboards/ MIS across accounts to track progress, forecast performance and identify potential red flags
    - Participate and share account performance across operational, quality and fulfillment parameters with internal/external stakeholders & senior leadership
    - Ensure regular invoicing as per the contract terms and condition and performance
  + Technical and/or Operational Issue Resolution
    - Manage and resolve complex project escalations, potential risks or early warning signs on project delivery to eliminate any revenue leakage
    - Acts as an advisor to service delivery managers to meet schedules or resolve technical or operational problems on a daily basis
    - Acts as point of escalation for issues not resolvable by the service lines.
    - Escalate issues with financial implication on the account to Account Head and other senior stakeholders
    - Acts as an advisor to service line managers to meet schedules or resolve technical or operational problems

͏

* Resource Allocation & Retention
  + Ensure effective transition from the client with the well documented and clear process understanding along with the right manpower requirements with requisite skill and training to undertake delivery
  + Review and monitor resource planning and fulfillment in line with account requirements and costs of delivery
  + Responsible for establishing, leading and maintaining a skilled team of all delivery resources for an account on a daily basis
  + Plan training batches to backfill client deliveries during crucial periods
  + Ensure retention by offering relevant trainings and certifications of all allocated resources
* Ensure Process Excellence
  + Partner with the assigned black belt for the account on regular basis to get feedback on account performance
  + Prioritize and drive initiatives for continuous improvement to improve top line revenue and bottom line margins
  + Present the business case for such initiatives to the clients to get their buy-in if required
  + Drive and implement structured cadence around quality, both process and transactional.
  + Conduct periodic meetings with clients and delivery teams daily status updates, service level requirement reviews, continuous improvement, change control and other informal meetings to share focus points, progress and successes.

͏

* **Contribute to revenue and profitable growth by ensuring the agreed revenue targets are met and by identifying opportunities in the form of new and/or adjacent work in the assigned account**
  + Ensure excellent service delivery of all products and solutions to achieve approved margin targets on assigned accounts and is targeted to improve account profitability.
  + Regularly monitors and reports on financial health of the account and remedies any financial misses or anomalies
  + Contribute to the revenue growth of the account by supporting the Account Head through new opportunity identification for deployment of new technology, growth solutions and services within the existing account/client
  + Recognizes business needs and determines if our portfolio offering may be an appropriate solution
  + Qualify and prioritize new opportunities in the funnel in the form of adjacent work in existing accounts
  + Serve as the primary relationship owner for an assigned group of top tier client accounts with responsibility for retention and growth
  + Prepare implementation plans and ensure efficient client on-boarding; present content strategy and annual delivery plan
  + Partner with the process excellence team to incorporate and drive key Wipro initiatives and priorities in the account strategy such as Digital, Automation etc.
  + Set direction for the team, track progress against targets through regular cadence calls and course correct as required
  + Partner with the WFM, Hiring & HR team to ensure optimal resource allocation and maintenance of a ready skilled team of resources to avoid leakages and revenue loss

͏

* **Develop, manage and leverage relationships in account to build customer centricity**
  + Identify key stakeholders/ decision makers in client organization and develop and strengthen relationships with them
  + Interact and engage with the client leadership to communicate and update progress against account plan, project delivery etc.
  + Drive and attend Steering Committee meetings or Client Review meetings to regularly review project dashboards, discuss and resolve escalation points and course correct as required for high customer satisfaction and better quality of experience
  + Act as client advocate and work with internal departments to ensure that client needs are understood and satisfied
  + Liaise between the customer and internal teams
* **Drive Delivery Transformation through automation and innovation focus**
  + Create and drive automation charter and related initiatives within account client (wherever applicable)
  + Drive deployment of automation led solutions and service improvements to deliver value added services to the clients
  + Build focus on and drive deployment of next generation hyper automation initiatives in coordination with Holmes team to enhance productivity, quality and speed of delivery
  + Lead, develop and drive new ways of working (EOT, Digital, Agile etc.) and its capabilities within the account to improve quality, delivery speed and productivity parameters

.

Experience: 8-10 Years
  
.

Of yourself, your career, and your skills. We want to see the constant evolution of our business and our industry. It has always been in our DNA - as the world around us changes, so do we. Join a business powered by purpose and a place that empowers you to design your own reinvention.

4627642a.title: Project Manager – Custom Fintech Solutions
4627642a.description:
Project Manager – Custom Fintech Solutions

**Job Category:**
Information Technology

**Job Type:**
Full Time

**Job Location:**
Mumbai

**Experience:**
10+ Years (Fintech / Financial Services Domain Mandatory)

**Team Size:**
8+Member Cross-Functional Engineering Team
  
**Reporting To:**
Chief Technology Officer (CTO) / Chief Delivery Officer (CDO)

**About Finlabs India**

Finlabs India is a next-generation BFSI-focused fintech company headquartered in Mumbai, operating at the intersection of wealth management technology, investor education, and enterprise learning. Our flagship platforms – FinAware (IAP Management), Finexa / Finexa GenNext (Wealth Management Stack), and LearnGenie (LMS) are trusted by leading institutions including AMCs, NBFCs, Wealth Firms, Banks & Pension Firms. We are a team of builders, thinkers, and domain specialists who believe technology can fundamentally transform how India engages with financial markets. If you are driven by complexity, energized by ambiguity, and committed to excellence this is your stage.

**The Role**

We are seeking an exceptional Project Manager – Custom Fintech Solutions to own end-to-end delivery of bespoke financial technology products across our wealth management, bond markets, and investor platform verticals. This is not a coordination role it is a delivery leadership position for someone who has operated
  
at the confluence of financial domain expertise and modern software engineering.

You will lead a cross-functional team of 8+ members, orchestrating frontend engineers, backend engineers, Flutter developers, QA specialists, and a Business Analysts translating complex financial requirements into production-grade, scalable solutions on time and within scope.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Project Leadership & Delivery**
:

* Own the full project lifecycle — from requirements gathering and sprint planning through UAT, deployment, and post-go-live stabilisation for custom fintech builds.
* Drive delivery of bespoke wealth management platforms, bond market solutions, and investor-facing digital products with zero ambiguity on timelines and accountability.
* Manage parallel workstreams across multiple clients and product lines simultaneously, maintaining delivery integrity without compromise.
* Establish and enforce milestone governance, sprint cadence, and release readiness checkpoints in high-stakes financial environments.

**Business Requirements & Documentation**
:

* Lead BRD (Business Requirements Document) and FRD/SRS authoring in collaboration with Business Analysts, translating client and stakeholder intent into precise technical specifications.
* Conduct deep-dive discovery workshops with BFSI clients to extract, validate, and prioritize requirements for regulatory-compliant, market-ready solutions.
* Maintain living documentation that bridges the business–technology divide, ensuring all stakeholders share a single source of truth throughout the project.

**Team Management (8-Member Cross-Functional Team)**
:

* Lead BRD (Business Requirements Document) and FRD/SRS authoring in collaboration with Business Analysts, translating client and stakeholder intent into precise technical specifications.
* Conduct deep-dive discovery workshops with BFSI clients to extract, validate, and prioritize requirements for regulatory-compliant, market-ready solutions.
* Maintain living documentation that bridges the business–technology divide, ensuring all stakeholders share a single source of truth throughout the project.

**Team Management (8-Member Cross-Functional Team)**
:

* Lead and mentor a team comprising Frontend Developers, Backend Developers, Flutter (Mobile) Developers, QA Engineers, and a Business Analyst.
* Allocate resources intelligently across sprints, manage capacity constraints proactively, and resolve blockers before they become escalations.
* Build a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and technical excellence within the team.
* Conduct regular 1:1s, performance reviews, and structured retrospectives to raise team capability and delivery velocity over time.

**Stakeholder & Client Management**
:

* Serve as the primary interface between Finlabs’ internal leadership, engineering teams, and external BFSI clients — translating both directions with clarity.
* Manage client expectations with transparency: proactively flag risks, communicate trade-offs, and maintain confidence through disciplined delivery updates.
* Deliver executive-level status reporting, structured project dashboards, and escalation protocols as needed.

**Process, Quality & Governance**
:

* Champion Agile/Scrum methodologies: run sprint planning, daily standups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives with precision.
* Ensure QA cycles, regression testing, and UAT are built into delivery timelines — not bolted on at the end.
* Own JIRA project boards end-to-end: epics, stories, task decomposition, sprint velocity tracking, and burndown analysis.
* Enforce change management protocols and scope governance discipline, particularly in bespoke-build engagements with evolving client requirements.

**Skills, Tools & Technology**

**Domain Expertise**
:

* Deep understanding of BFSI — particularly wealth management platforms, bond markets, mutual fund ecosystems, and regulatory compliance frameworks (SEBI, RBI, AMFI).
* Familiarity with financial product lifecycles: portfolio management, fixed income instruments, IAP/investor education mandates, and digital distribution channels.

**Project Management Tools**
:

* JIRA (Advanced): Epic/story management, sprint velocity, Kanban boards, burndown/burnup charts, release planning, and custom dashboards.
* Confluence: Living documentation, BRD wikis, sprint retrospectives, and cross-team knowledge management.
* Monday.com / Asana / ClickUp: Cross-functional visibility dashboards and non-engineering stakeholdermanagement.
* Notion: Internal SOPs, project templates, and team knowledge bases.
* Microsoft Project / Smartsheet: For milestone-heavy client delivery timelines and resource planning.
* Slack / Microsoft Teams: Structured async communication, sprint channel discipline, and stakeholder status updates.
* Miro / Figma (Collaboration): Journey mapping, wireframe reviews, and workshop facilitation with design and product teams.

**Engineering & Technical Acumen:**

* Solid understanding of modern tech stacks — frontend (React.js, Angular), backend (Node.js, Python, Java/Spring Boot), mobile (Flutter/Dart), cloud (AWS / Azure / GCP).
* Ability to review technical architecture proposals, challenge assumptions, and make informed delivery trade-offs with engineering leads.
* Knowledge of REST APIs, microservices architecture, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps practices as they relate to release and deployment governance.
* Exposure to AI/ML integration in fintech products is a distinct advantage — particularly LLM-powered advisory or analytics layers.
* Understanding of data privacy, DPDP Act compliance, cybersecurity fundamentals, and BFSI-specific regulatory constraints.

**Methodologies & Frameworks**
:

* Certified in PMP, PRINCE2, PMI-ACP, CSM, or equivalent — at least one certification is required; multiple are valued.
* Hands-on Agile/Scrum practitioner. Knowledge of SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework) for multi-team program coordination is a strong plus.
* Strong command over SDLC disciplines: requirement elicitation, sprint planning, story pointing, UAT, release management, and hypercare.

**What You Bring**

* 10+ years of overall experience, with a minimum of 5 years in BFSI / fintech environments delivering custom software solutions.
* Demonstrated track record of delivering complex, multi-stakeholder financial technology projects end to-end — on time, on budget, on scope.
* Experience managing cross-functional engineering teams of 6–10 members, with direct line accountability for delivery performance.
* Strong BRD/SRS authoring experience — you are equally comfortable in a client workshop and a JIRA backlog grooming session.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills. You can brief a CXO and a developer in the same day with equal effectiveness.
* High ownership mindset — you thrive in high-accountability environments and do not wait for direction when action is needed.
* Fluency with data: you read velocity charts, risk registers, and resource utilization dashboards the way others read news.

**Bonus Points — What Sets You Apart**

* Experience with bond market platforms, fixed income digital distribution, or algo-driven portfolio tools.
* Prior work on SEBI-regulated platforms, investor education mandates (IAP/IEC), or AMFI-compliant digital products.
* Familiarity with LMS or EdTech platforms — especially in a financial services learning context.
* Exposure to AI-augmented product development: LLM integrations, predictive analytics, or investing concepts. – MBA from a premier institution or CFA / FRM certification — an edge, not a requirement.

Why Finlabs India

**Domain That Matters**
:
  
Build products that touch real financial lives — investor education, wealth creation, and market access at scale.

**Founders Who Build**
:
  
Work directly with a founding team that is technical, commercially sharp, and deeply committed to the mission.
  
  
**Build, Don’t Maintain**
:
  
New products, new clients, and greenfield builds — not legacy maintenance or process babysitting.
  
  
**Marquee Client Base**
:
  
Collaborate with India’s leading AMCs, banks, DPs, and financial institutions — exposure that accelerates careers.

How To Apply

If you are a seasoned fintech project leader who is energized by complexity, obsessed with delivery quality, and ready to build something that lasts — we want to hear from you. Please share your updated resume along with a brief note (no more than 200 words) on the most complex custom fintech project you have delivered and what made it exceptional.
  
hr@finlabsindia.com

****Job Description****

Lead and develop an engineering team made up of junior and senior engineers in the development of Industrial IoT, Edge Computing, Cloud Connectivity, Data Analytics, and Digital Solutions for Husky products and customer operations. Focus on innovation, scalability, cybersecurity, reliability, risk mitigation, and customer satisfaction while enabling data-driven manufacturing and Industry 4.0 initiatives.

* Drive the development and adoption of edge-to-cloud architectures, industrial communications, device management, remote monitoring, predictive maintenance, and data analytics solutions.
* Support customer deployments and operational excellence initiatives through digital solutions that improve machine performance, uptime, quality, and operational visibility.
* Promote a culture of innovation, technical excellence, DevOps practices, cybersecurity awareness, and data-driven decision making.

****Critical Capabilities And Qualifications****

* Strong decision-making, problem-solving, and strategic thinking capabilities.
* System-level thinking at both product and enterprise levels.
* Strong understanding of Industrial IoT architectures, edge computing, cloud platforms, and distributed systems.
* Strong knowledge of software engineering principles, system integration, and modern development methodologies.

* Knowledge of cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or equivalent.
* Experience with IoT device management, telemetry collection, data pipelines, analytics platforms, and monitoring solutions.

* Experience with DevOps tools, CI/CD pipelines, source control systems, and agile development methodologies.
* Demonstrates a high degree of flexibility and adaptability while embracing changing priorities.
* Knowledge of Husky products, manufacturing processes, tools, standards, and technologies is an asset.
* Experience with Edge Computing, AI/ML applications, predictive analytics, digital twins, and Industry 4.0 initiatives is an asset.
* Experience facilitating cybersecurity, safety, or technology risk assessments is an asset.
* Relevant cloud, cybersecurity, or industrial automation certifications are considered an asset.

**Education**

* Proven leadership experience leading multidisciplinary engineering teams.
* Experience delivering enterprise-scale software, cloud, or Industrial IoT solutions from concept through deployment.
* Experience in manufacturing, automation, machinery, packaging, injection molding, or industrial technology industries is an asset.
* Experience managing globally distributed engineering teams and collaborating across multiple functional disciplines is an asset.

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. Husky TechnologiesTM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. Accordingly, Husky TechnologiesTM conditions all offers of employment on satisfactory completion of background checks. No agency or telephone inquiries please.

be274daa.title: Project / Program Manager - Mining Technology and Operations
be274daa.description:
**PROJECT DELIVERY LEAD**

**Digital Mining Technology Deployment • Multi-Site**

  

**Engagement: Multi-year deployment program.**

**Reports to: Project Director.**

**About the company**

**MineExcellence is establishing itself as a leader in mining industry-related software technology in certain specific areas. We provide multiple core offerings currently Software for open-cast as well as underground drilling and blasting. We offer an enterprise platform for underground drill/blast. Our solution integrates mine planning, drone or scanner-based surveying, web/offline tablet-based blast design, post-blast analysis, stope recovery percentage assessment, and stope optimization solutions. The platform is currently used by Tier-1 large mining companies as an Enterprise platform, small mining companies and at individual mines, and by drilling and blasting contractors.**

**We have customers in 8 countries all over the globe currently including Chile, Indonesia, Africa, the United States, Mexico, Australia, and India, etc in both open cast and underground mining products.**

**About the role**

**We are deploying an integrated digital drill-and-blast optimisation solution combining specialist software with field hardware (gyroscope deviation surveys, underground drone scanning, rugged-tablet fragmentation analysis and collar-positioning systems) across two underground mining operations. We are looking for a strong, hands-on Project Delivery Lead to own end-to-end delivery across both sites (or a single site) and act as the single accountable point for delivery, coordination and client relationship.**

**This is a demanding, field-based role for someone who leads from the ground, not the desk. Strong project management and coordination skills are the core requirement. A mining background is preferred but not essential we will support the right delivery-focused candidate to ramp on the domain.**

**Key responsibilities**

**Delivery and cross-site coordination**

* **Run the program as one coherent delivery across both sites: shared standards, aligned reporting and a common way of working, while flexing to each sites plan and conditions.**
* **Sequence commissioning, surveys, scanning, blast design and fragmentation analysis against each sites monthly work plan.**
* **Balance resource and equipment coverage between the two sites, including movement of shared/limited assets to maintain availability against contractual commitments.**

**Team and subcontractor management**

* **Lead and coordinate the on-site teams across both locations mining/diploma engineers, drone pilots, helpers, and software/technical leads.**
* **Manage subcontractor performance and interfaces (vehicles, specialist services, contract labour), holding them to schedule, safety and quality.**

**Client and stakeholder management**

* **Act as the primary day-to-day interface with the client at both sites contract, operations, planning and survey teams.**
* **Secure site-side prerequisites (access, power/network, workspace, statutory and equipment clearances) and escalate blockers early.**

**Performance ownership**

* **Drive the contracted performance targets across both sites (ore recovery, dilution reduction, drilling compliance, fragmentation, scan coverage, design-to-execution data integration and stope turnaround time).**
* **Track equipment availability closely given its direct commercial impact, and maintain the evidence trail for performance-linked payments.**
* **Ensure recommendations are documented and issued where outcomes depend on client-side corrective action.**

**Safety, compliance and governance**

* **Enforce underground safety rules, statutory requirements and IT/cyber-security policies across all deployed systems and both teams.**
* **Own project governance: design sign-offs, calibration certificates, bill-of-materials approvals, SOPs, training delivery, and data confidentiality/handover.**

**Reporting**

* **Produce consistent performance, availability and compliance reporting across both sites for internal leadership and the client.**

**What you’ll need**

**Essential**

* **Proven track record delivering projects in India, ideally in industrial, infrastructure, heavy-industry or field-technology deployments — someone who has delivered on the ground.**
* **Strong project management and coordination skills: planning, resourcing, risk and issue management, stakeholder handling, and holding a distributed multi-site team and subcontractors to schedule.**
* **Willing and medically able to be site-based in a demanding operational environment, travel between two locations, and work underground.**
* **Strong client-facing and communication skills, credible with senior operational and technical stakeholders.**
* **Data- and reporting-literate, able to drive decisions from performance dashboards and KPIs.**
* **Project management certification (PMP / PRINCE2 / equivalent) preferred.**

**Preferred (not essential)**

* **Mining, underground operations, or drill-and-blast domain experience.**
* **Familiarity with survey/geospatial or field-sensor technology (gyroscopes, drones/LiDAR, fragmentation analysis) and industry-standard mine planning software.**
* **Experience deploying integrated software-plus-hardware solutions in the field.Role & responsibilitiesRole & responsibilities**

1427037e.title: Solution Architect - AI
1427037e.description:
**Job Title - Solution Architect - AI - Manager - ACS SONG**

**Management Level:Level 7 -Manager**

**Location:Kochi, Coimbatore, Trivandrum, Bangalore**

**Must have skills:Generative AI,****Intelligent Automation, Conversational AI, or Agentic AI, , Large Language Models (LLMs)**

**Good to have skills:Model Context Protocol (MCP)/ Agent2Agent (A2A)**

**Experience:10 - 15 years of experience is required**

**Educational Qualification:B.Tech/BE/M.Tech/MCA**

**Job **Summary****

We are seeking an experienced Solution Architect - AI with 10+ years of overall technology experience, including at least 3 years of hands-on experience designing and architecting AI, Generative AI, Machine Learning, or Agentic AI solutions. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in enterprise solution architecture and experience designing scalable, secure, resilient, and production-ready AI solutions on at least one major cloud platform such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

The role will be responsible for defining end-to-end AI solution architectures covering application, data, AI/ML, integration, security, infrastructure, and operational components. The architect will work closely with business stakeholders, enterprise architects, data teams, AI engineers, software engineers, security teams, and cloud platform teams to translate business requirements into practical and scalable technology solutions.

The candidate should have strong knowledge of modern AI architecture patterns including Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Agentic AI, AI agents, vector databases, knowledge retrieval, API/tool integration, model orchestration, observability, security, and responsible AI. Experience in taking AI solutions from initial discovery and proof-of-concept through production deployment and operationalization is essential.

**Roles and Responsibilities**

* Design end-to-end AI and Generative AI solution architectures that address business requirements while meeting enterprise standards for scalability, security, performance, reliability, and maintainability.

* Define appropriate architecture patterns for Generative AI, Agentic AI, RAG, Machine Learning, intelligent automation, conversational AI, and AI-enabled enterprise applications.

* Provide architectural leadership across the complete solution lifecycle, from discovery, feasibility assessment, architecture definition, prototyping, implementation, production deployment, and post-production operations.

* Collaborate with business and technology stakeholders to evaluate AI use cases, identify suitable technologies, assess technical feasibility, and define implementation roadmaps.

* Lead the architecture and solution design of enterprise AI, Generative AI, Machine Learning, and Agentic AI solutions across cloud and hybrid environments.
* Translate business requirements, functional requirements, and non-functional requirements into scalable and secure solution architecture designs, architecture diagrams, integration patterns, and technical specifications.
* Design AI solutions using services and technologies available on AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform, including managed AI/ML, data, integration, compute, security, and observability services.
* Define architectures for LLM-based applications, including prompt orchestration, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector search, embeddings, model routing, grounding, knowledge bases, AI agents, tool/function calling, and multi-agent architectures.
* Design enterprise integration patterns connecting AI solutions with APIs, databases, data platforms, SaaS applications, enterprise applications, event-driven systems, and external services.
* Evaluate and recommend appropriate foundation models, LLMs, embedding models, AI platforms, vector databases, orchestration frameworks, and supporting technologies based on business, technical, security, cost, and performance requirements.
* Define architecture approaches for AI security, identity and access management, data privacy, guardrails, content filtering, responsible AI, model governance, and regulatory compliance.
* Establish architectural standards for AI observability, monitoring, tracing, logging, evaluation, performance management, reliability, and operational support.
* Work closely with AI engineers, data scientists, data engineers, application developers, DevOps/MLOps teams, cloud engineers, and security teams to guide implementation and ensure alignment with the target architecture.
* Lead architecture reviews, technical design workshops, proof-of-concepts, technology assessments, and design governance activities while communicating complex technical concepts effectively to both technical and business stakeholders.
* Ability to conduct AI use-case discovery, technical feasibility assessments, architecture assessments, technology evaluations, and solution option analysis.
* Ability to create and communicate high-level architecture, detailed solution architecture, sequence diagrams, data flows, integration diagrams, deployment architectures, and architecture decision records.
* Ability to design appropriate AI guardrails addressing areas such as hallucination, prompt injection, data leakage, harmful content, unauthorized tool execution, and inappropriate model responses.
* Ability to define reference architectures, reusable architecture patterns, technical standards, and architecture governance frameworks for AI solutions.

  
  
**Qualification**  

**Professional and Technical Skills**

* 10+ years of overall experience in software engineering, application architecture, cloud architecture, data architecture, solution architecture, or related technology roles.
* Minimum 3 years of experience designing or implementing AI-based solutions, including Generative AI, Machine Learning, Intelligent Automation, Conversational AI, or Agentic AI.
* Demonstrated experience working as a Solution Architect, Technical Architect, Cloud Architect, AI Architect, or equivalent senior architecture role.
* Proven experience designing and delivering enterprise-scale, production-grade solutions involving multiple applications, platforms, integrations, and data sources.
* Hands-on architecture experience with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), embeddings, vector databases, semantic search, document retrieval, and enterprise knowledge bases.
* Strong hands-on architecture experience with at least one major cloud platform:
  + **AWS** - for example Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker,
  + **Microsoft Azure** - for example Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search,
  + **Google Cloud Platform (GCP)** - for example Vertex AI, Gemini, BigQuery
* Strong understanding of cloud-native architecture patterns, including microservices, APIs, serverless architectures, containers, event-driven architectures, asynchronous processing, and distributed systems.
* Strong understanding of REST APIs, API gateways, authentication and authorization, OAuth/OIDC, networking, secrets management, encryption, and enterprise security architecture.
* Strong understanding of enterprise data architectures including data lakes, data warehouses, lakehouses, relational databases, NoSQL databases, vector databases, and streaming platforms.
* Strong understanding of enterprise security architecture including Identity and Access Management, Role-Based Access Control, network security, encryption, key management, secrets management, and secure API design.
* Strong ability to evaluate architectural trade-offs across cost, performance, scalability, security, maintainability, complexity, and time to market.
* Experience integrating AI applications with enterprise data platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, BigQuery, Amazon Redshift, Microsoft Fabric, or equivalent technologies.
* Experience designing integrations between AI solutions and enterprise systems using APIs, messaging platforms, event buses, queues, workflow engines, and integration platforms.
* Experience designing highly available, scalable, fault-tolerant, secure, and cost-effective enterprise solutions.
* Experience taking technology solutions through multiple lifecycle stages including discovery, architecture, proof-of-concept, implementation, deployment, and production support.
* Experience with prompt engineering, context management, grounding techniques, model selection, model evaluation, hallucination mitigation, and AI guardrails.
* Experience defining deployment strategies for AI applications across development, testing, staging, and production environments.
* Experience working with enterprise security, risk, compliance, and governance teams to ensure AI solutions meet organizational and regulatory requirements.
* Experience estimating solution complexity, cloud infrastructure requirements, implementation effort, technical dependencies, and architecture risks.
* Understanding of common AI orchestration and development frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, LlamaIndex, DSPy, or equivalent technologies.
* Understanding of AI production monitoring including model/application performance, latency, token consumption, cost, prompt and response tracing, model failures, retrieval quality, and system availability.
* Understanding of Agentic AI concepts, including AI agents, planning and reasoning workflows, tool/function calling, agent orchestration, workflow automation, and multi-agent systems.
* Understanding of CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, DevOps, MLOps, LLMOps, containerization, Kubernetes, and automated deployment practices.
* Understanding of data ingestion, ETL/ELT, data pipelines, data quality, metadata management, data governance, and data security concepts.
* Knowledge of Responsible AI principles, AI governance, model risk management, data privacy, prompt security, content moderation, explainability, and human-in-the-loop controls.
* Knowledge of emerging AI interoperability patterns and protocols such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) and Agent-to-Agent (A2A) communication is desirable. Any experience with UCP is also a plus.
* Familiarity with observability platforms and technologies such as OpenTelemetry, CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, Google Cloud Operations, Datadog, Grafana, or equivalent tools.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to engage effectively with business leaders, product owners, enterprise architects, engineering teams, security teams, and senior management.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex AI and architecture concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to evaluate multiple technical approaches and clearly articulate architectural trade-offs.
* Ability to provide technical leadership and architectural guidance to cross-functional engineering teams without necessarily being responsible for direct people management.
* Strong consulting mindset with the ability to understand business problems, challenge assumptions, identify technical risks, and recommend pragmatic solutions.
* Ability to work across multiple projects and technology domains while maintaining consistency with enterprise architecture principles and standards.

**Additional Information**

* Relevant cloud architecture certifications such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Microsoft Certified:Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Google Professional Cloud Architect, or equivalent certifications.
* AI/ML or Generative AI certifications from AWS, Microsoft, Google, Databricks, NVIDIA, or other recognized technology providers are advantageous.
* Experience working in large enterprise environments, consulting organizations, or complex multi-cloud transformation programs.
* Experience defining or contributing to organizational AI architecture standards, Generative AI platforms, AI Centers of Excellence, or enterprise AI governance frameworks would be advantageous.

At Techdome, software architecture goes beyond design. It involves ownership, technical leadership, and accountability for how systems perform in production.

* Lead end-to-end system architecture, including system design, APIs, data models, security, scalability, observability, and cost optimization.
* Own the production performance and reliability of systems serving large user bases.
* Design secure solutions involving healthcare data, Protected Health Information (PHI), and payment workflows.
* Architect applications using the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express.js, React, Node.js) and modern cloud infrastructure.
* Work with AWS, GCP, or Azure, along with Kubernetes, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), networking, and secrets management.
* Drive decisions on microservices, event-driven systems, integrations, and build-versus-buy strategies.
* Identify and resolve production bottlenecks across performance, scalability, and availability.
* Establish engineering standards, reference architectures, and reusable design patterns.
* Participate in coding, architecture discussions, design reviews, and code reviews.
* Mentor senior engineers and develop future technical leaders.

* 8+ years of professional software engineering experience with strong system design and architecture ownership.
* **Proven production experience running a system with a minimum of 100,000 users (mandatory).**
* A strong track record of identifying and solving major production bottlenecks at scale.
* Strong hands-on experience with Node.js and React; MERN stack experience preferred.
* Experience in cloud architecture using AWS, GCP, or Azure.
* Experience in healthcare, payments, fintech, banking, insurance, or other security-critical domains.
* Deep understanding of distributed systems, APIs, databases, scalability, and reliability.
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to explain and justify technical decisions.

### **Good to Have**

* Familiarity with Stripe, Braintree, tokenization, or payment processing systems.
* Experience with microservices, event-driven architecture, and high-availability systems.

### **Why Join Techdome?**

* Build real products in healthcare, fintech, AI, and SaaS used by customers worldwide.

Join a profitable, stable, product-focused organization with minimal bureaucracy.

Ask incisive questions and recommend - do not simply accept requirements.

**Ownership —**
Stay accountable for outcomes and drive issues through to closure.

**Technical Credibility —**
Earn the confidence of scientists, architects and engineers.

**Executive Presence —**
Make complex issues clear and actionable for senior stakeholders.

**Constructive Challenge —**
Professionally disagree when evidence or customer outcomes require it.

**Decision Making —**
Make sound recommendations even when information is incomplete.

**Influence Without Authority —**
Mobilize teams and vendors across organizational boundaries.

**Commercial Awareness —**
Understand how technical choices affect scale, effort, risk and total cost.

**Curiosity —**
Continuously learn, experiment and stay current - especially in AI.

**Low Ego, High Accountability —**
Prioritize outcomes and team success over hierarchy or visibility.

**Who Should Apply**

This role is designed for a rare combination of domain expert, architect, consultant and delivery leader. You should recognize yourself in most of the statements below:

**•**
You can walk into an ambiguous customer situation and quickly structure the problem.

**•**
You are comfortable leading scientists, architects, QA leaders, engineers and executives in the same discussion.

**•**
You can move from scientific workflow to architecture to delivery implications without losing the thread.

**•**
You challenge unnecessary customization and naturally look for reusable, scalable patterns.

**•**
You make recommendations and decisions rather than waiting for perfect information.

**•**
You influence teams and vendors that do not report to you.

**•**
You remain engaged through production; you do not stop at the architecture hand-off.

**•**
You actively experiment with AI and modern software practices because curiosity is part of how you work.

**THE MINDSET**

A strong implementation specialist asks: "What needs to be built?" A Principal Delivery Architect asks: "What problem are we solving, what should we build, how should we architect it, and how do we make it repeatable, scalable and successful in production?"

**Why Join Scitara?**

**Shape Digital Labs**

**•**
Work on enterprise-scale transformation of pharmaceutical and life-sciences laboratories.

**Solve Hard Problems**

**•**
Operate across instruments, scientific applications, enterprise systems, cloud, data and regulated processes.

**Lead at the AI Frontier**

**•**
Help define how AI, agents and automation are applied to trusted scientific data and workflows.

**Influence Product & Delivery**

**•**
Turn customer experience into better product decisions, architecture patterns and delivery methods.

**Work With Global Experts**

**•**
Engage directly with scientists, architects, executives, technology vendors and System Integrators.

**Multiply Your Impact**

**•**
Create reusable patterns and methods that can scale across hundreds of instruments, laboratories and sites.

**What Success Looks Like**

**•**
Customers treat you as a trusted technical advisor, not simply a vendor resource.

**•**
Solutions are scalable, supportable and production-ready - not one-off implementations.

**•**
First-of-Kind patterns are deliberately reused and industrialized.

**•**
Technical and organizational dependencies are surfaced early and resolved quickly.

**•**
Services teams become more capable because you mentor, standardize and create reusable playbooks.

**•**
AI is used practically to improve both customer solutions and delivery productivity.

**FINAL EXPECTATION**

We are looking for someone who can understand the scientific and business problem, determine the right solution, earn stakeholder confidence, make difficult technical decisions, mobilize the organization, and remain accountable until the outcome is successfully delivered and adopted.

**If your professional development stops when the working day ends, this role is unlikely to be the right fit.**

*We are looking for people whose curiosity naturally drives them to experiment, learn, build and stay current with technologies changing the way scientific work is performed.*

3f1b5a03.title: Salesforce Field Service Architect
3f1b5a03.description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*
Job Category
  
  
Customer Success
  
  
Job Details
  
  
**About Salesforce**
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
  
  
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
  
  
Our Field Service Professional Services team works across technology and business stakeholders to usher customers into the next phase of their business transformation journey and achieve innovative outcomes that craft the future.
  
  
Technical Architect successfully designs and manages the delivery of complex Salesforce solutions for our customers. These technologies include--but are not necessarily limited to Salesforce.com products and APIs, Apex/Visualforce, Lightning, mobile development technologies, and integration/ETL technologies.
  
  
As a core part of this role, you will realize solutions for our customers by focusing on consultancy, technical development & delivery for the customers and partners to solve critically meaningful business challenges using Salesforce’s Field Service Platform (SFS). Salesforce FS product provides FSM solutions for a wide variety of customer verticals and ecosystem(s) like Telecom, Utilities, Oil & Gas, Manufacturing, Finance etc.
  
  
You are both a big picture thinker and in-depth problem solver, your knowledge and skills are both broad and deep. You take pride in designing systems that stand up to high volumes and won't fail at critical points. You have a good mix of technical and enterprise skills when it comes to architecting a solution. The solutions you design are built for the long-term and will scale with the customer's growth plans seamlessly. You have proven experience integrating systems via API’s as well as a strong development background.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with client stakeholders to define requirements, deliverables, and set and manage expectations
* Drive Enterprise AI Architecture by designing and integrating scalable predictive and generative AI solutions within custom Salesforce environments, optimizing performance, resource consumption, and platform governor limits
* Lead technical design sessions; architect and document technical solutions aligned with client business objectives; identify gaps between client's current and desired end states, using advanced LLMs like Claude to review architectural assumptions and simulate system edge cases
* Champion an AI-first delivery methodology, utilizing advanced AI tools, developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude), and agentic evaluation frameworks to accelerate implementation across projects
* Translate business requirements into well-architected solutions that best leverage the Salesforce platform
* Provide oversight and governance of Salesforce projects
* Follow and help define coding standards. Lead code reviews during projects to ensure quality and appropriate design patterns are followed
* Manage the technical delivery of custom development, integrations, and data migration elements of a Salesforce implementation
* Maintain a target billable utilization aligned to the role
* Ability to understand a project and deep dive to debug issues
* From time-to-time, the TA may be expected to partake in other pre-sales activities such as discovery and technical deep-dive sessions, Proof-Of-Concept (POC) development with prospects
* Liaise with Salesforce product teams to support client implementations
* Travels to client sites for projects, estimated 50-75%

**Requirements**

* Degree or equivalent proven experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core proficiencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)
* 9-14 years CRM experience with a minimum of 6 years on the Salesforce platform
* Expert level understanding of End-to-End Field Service Implementation
* Good understanding of the Salesforce product suite, including Sales, Service, Marketing, and Community Clouds
* Understanding of systems architecture and ability to design scalable performance-driven solutions
* Understanding of key design patterns and large data volume limitations and best practices
* Understanding of data sharing and visibility considerations and how these play into platform architecture
* Familiarity with platform authentication patterns (SAML, SSO, OAuth)
* Knowledge of data integration tools and experience integrating Salesforce with different business systems (ETL, CPQ, marketing automation, reporting, etc.)
* Strong understanding of environment management, release management, code versioning best practices, and deployment methodologies
* Experience with platform security capabilities (TLS, SSL)
* Expert level experience defining the system architecture landscape, identifying gaps between current and desired end-states, and delivering a comprehensive solution that will enable achievement of the desired business outcomes
* Strong background in design/development of large web-based systems, or complete software product lifecycle exposure
* Active Salesforce certifications or ability to achieve relevant certifications upon hire

Unleash Your Potential
  
  
When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
*be your best*
, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can
*do your best*
. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.
  
  
Accommodations
  
  
If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.
  
  
Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.
  
  
Posting Statement
  
  
Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

d6c5b7aa.title: Solution Architecture - HCL Commerce
d6c5b7aa.description:
We're looking for a seasoned **Solution Architect** with HCL Commerce expertise to drive the design and evolution of a multi-tier B2B commerce platform, steering architecture decisions across legacy Commerce systems, Spring Boot services, and modern Next.js storefronts.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Establish and maintain target and transitional architecture for a multi-tier B2B commerce environment, spanning the WCS store, business logic, Commerce tools, Spring Boot APIs, and Next.js / React storefront
* Direct the design of dual-run / strangler patterns, deciding which journeys stay on WCS versus move to Next.js and services, while safeguarding routing, session, catalog, cart, and order consistency, and setting cut-over and rollback procedures
* Produce and review solution designs, sequence/integration diagrams, and interface contracts (REST/SOAP), catching reusability, performance, security, and operability concerns prior to build
* Work closely with product, delivery leads, QA, DevOps, and enterprise/integration teams on requirements gathering, data conversion, integration testing, and cut-over execution
* Define coding and design standards across Commerce customization, Spring Boot services, and the Next.js storefront so squads stay consistent
* Steer integration with back-end systems (ERP, payments, search, CMS, punchout / customer purchasing systems), preserving a clear boundary between Preview (authoring) and Runtime (customer-facing) Commerce environments
* Evaluate designs and pull requests spanning Commerce, services, and storefront layers, and trace complex cross-layer defects back to their root cause
* Offer guidance on capacity planning, caching strategies, search, and failure handling for a high-traffic B2B storefront
* Mentor senior engineers and leads, capturing architecture decisions along with their context, options considered, and consequences to maintain continuity
* Pinpoint major obstacles and use structured problem-solving techniques to tackle complex, multi-system issues

**Requirements**

* A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* Between 12 and 20 years of professional software engineering experience, including at least 5 years serving as an architect or in an equivalent principal/staff design capacity on large-scale commerce or comparably complex multi-tier systems
* At least 8 years of hands-on expertise with HCL Commerce and/or IBM WebSphere Commerce (WCS) 8.x, including store customization, commands/tasks, tools, catalog/order/user/organization workflows, and back-end integration
* At least 8 years of expertise in Java / J2EE and object-oriented design for large IT systems, with a strong preference for WebSphere Application Server experience
* At least 5 years working with Spring / Spring MVC, with practical Spring Boot architecture experience covering service boundaries, APIs, resilience, and authentication
* At least 5 years of experience building web services (REST and SOAP), including the ability to define contracts that other teams can implement against
* Hands-on production architecture experience with Next.js and React, covering routing, data fetching, BFF/API integration, and storefront performance optimization; TypeScript experience is preferred
* At least 5 years using source control systems, with Git experience required
* Preferred background in designing B2B commerce architecture, including punchout functionality, organization/user models, and complex contract/pricing logic
* Experience delivering work through Agile methods using Atlassian tooling (Jira, Bitbucket/Git, Confluence)
* Strong written and verbal communication skills for engaging both technical and non-technical audiences

**Nice to have**

* Familiarity with headless/composable commerce concepts (API-first storefronts, BFF, packaged capabilities) and iPaaS platforms such as MuleSoft
* Exposure to search technologies (Solr or similar), caching systems (Redis or similar), and CMS-powered storefronts (Optimizely or similar) working alongside a commerce engine
* Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (GKE/Kubernetes or similar) supporting storefront and Spring Boot deployments, plus WAS/IHS for Commerce
* Solid grasp of security practices, PCI-adjacent payment flows, and session/identity management spanning legacy and modern storefronts
* Prior involvement in dual-run initiatives or large-scale commerce migration efforts
