Join us and be part of this journey towards greater opportunities and brighter futures.
  
  
JD for
**Genesys Tech Lead**
Experience: 15+ years
  
  
**Summary**
The
**Genesys Technical Lead and Solution Architect**
is responsible for leading the design, architecture, implementation, and successful delivery of enterprise-grade Contact Center as a Service (CCaaS) solution, with primary expertise in
**Genesys Cloud CX**
. This role combines deep technical expertise, solution architecture, client consulting, and delivery leadership to help organizations transform their customer experience capabilities.
  
  
The role involves working directly with clients to understand business objectives, define solution strategies, lead technical workshops, architect scalable omnichannel customer engagement solutions, and drive end-to-end implementation from discovery through production deployment. The individual will collaborate with cross-functional teams, provide technical leadership and mentoring, ensure adherence to enterprise architecture and engineering best practices, and deliver secure, scalable, and high-performing CCaaS solutions.
  
  
In addition to technical delivery, the role is expected to contribute to solution innovation, technology strategy, governance, and continuous improvement initiatives by leveraging modern cloud technologies, APIs, integrations, Conversational AI, and automation to enhance customer and agent experiences.
  
  
Key Duties and Responsibilities
  
  
**Leadership & Strategy**

* Lead a team of CCaaS Engineers, Genesys Developers, Integration Engineers, Solution Architects, QA Engineers, and Technical Consultants in designing, developing, deploying, and supporting enterprise CCaaS and Customer Experience (CX) solutions.
* Act as the primary technical point of contact for customers, working directly with client stakeholders to understand business objectives, define solution strategies, and drive successful project execution.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, product managers, enterprise architects, infrastructure teams, security teams, and client stakeholders to define business requirements, solution strategy, and implementation roadmaps.
* Build strong client relationships by providing technical consulting, solution recommendations, and trusted advisory throughout the project lifecycle.
* Facilitate client workshops, discovery sessions, architecture discussions, and requirement-gathering workshops to translate business needs into scalable technical solutions.
* Provide technical leadership, mentoring, and coaching to engineering teams while promoting best practices, innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning.
* Define development standards, architectural principles, coding guidelines, reusable frameworks, deployment standards, and implementation best practices for CCaaS solutions.
* Drive solution standardization across projects by creating reusable components, design patterns, and implementation accelerators.
* Evaluate emerging CCaaS technologies, Conversational AI, cloud services, automation capabilities, and Genesys platform enhancements to continuously improve customer and agent experiences.

**Solution Architecture & Design**

* Design scalable, secure, resilient, and enterprise-grade CCaaS solutions using Genesys Cloud CX as the primary platform.
* Architect end-to-end omnichannel customer engagement solutions including Voice, Digital Messaging, Web Chat, Email, SMS, Social Channels, Outbound Campaigns, and AI-powered self-service.
* Design IVR, Intelligent Routing, Call Flows, Digital Flows, Workforce Engagement Management (WEM), Agent Desktop, Supervisor capabilities, Customer Journey, Quality Management, and Self-Service solutions.
* Define enterprise integration architecture between the CCaaS platform and CRM, Core Banking, ERP, Identity Management, Payment Systems, Knowledge Management, AI platforms, and third-party applications.
* Design API-driven and event-driven integrations using REST APIs, Webhooks, Event Notifications, Middleware, and Microservices.
* Architect high-availability, disaster recovery, business continuity, security, compliance, and multi-region deployment strategies.
* Produce architecture diagrams, technical design documents, interface specifications, deployment architectures, and solution blueprints.

**Technical Responsibilities**

* Lead the end-to-end implementation of CCaaS solutions, primarily on Genesys Cloud CX, from discovery through production deployment.
* Configure and develop Genesys platform components including Architect Flows, Queues, Routing, Skills, User Management, Digital Channels, Knowledge, Workforce Engagement Management (WEM), Outbound Campaigns, Agent Scripts, Reporting, and Analytics.
* Develop reusable Architect modules, Data Actions, Scripts, APIs, and integration components to improve maintainability, scalability, and operational efficiency.
* Design secure integrations using REST APIs, OAuth, JWT, Web Services, JSON, XML, Event Notifications, and enterprise middleware platforms.
* Integrate the CCaaS platform with enterprise applications including Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics, ServiceNow, SAP, core banking systems, customer databases, and custom applications.
* Design and implement Conversational AI solutions by integrating CCaaS platforms with Google Dialogflow, Kore.ai, OpenAI, Microsoft Copilot, Amazon Lex, Azure AI, and other AI platforms.
* Troubleshoot complex production issues involving routing, telephony, SIP, integrations, APIs, networking, authentication, and cloud infrastructure.
* Optimize routing strategies, IVR performance, digital journeys, reporting, customer experience, and operational efficiency.
* Build reusable deployment scripts, automation tools, monitoring dashboards, and operational support utilities.

**Cloud, Infrastructure & Platform Experience**

* Design and deploy enterprise CCaaS solutions across multiple business units, business lines, and geographical regions.
* Experience integrating CCaaS platforms with AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform, and hybrid enterprise environments.
* Design secure connectivity using VPN, Direct Connect, ExpressRoute, SIP Trunks, Session Border Controllers (SBCs), and enterprise networking standards.
* Implement Identity and Access Management using SAML, OAuth, Single Sign-On (SSO), Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, Okta, or similar identity providers.
* Collaborate with Infrastructure, Cloud, Security, and Network teams to ensure scalable, secure, and highly available deployments.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), version control systems, automation frameworks, and release management processes.

**Governance & Delivery**

* Drive end-to-end technical delivery while working directly with client stakeholders, project managers, business teams, and engineering teams to ensure successful project execution.
* Lead client-facing technical governance, including architecture reviews, technical steering committee meetings, project status reviews, design walkthroughs, and executive presentations.
* Define project scope, technical assumptions, solution approach, effort estimates, implementation plans, resource requirements, dependencies, and technical risks.
* Coordinate with client teams, vendors, third-party partners, and internal delivery teams to ensure seamless implementation and successful project delivery.
* Proactively identify delivery risks, technical challenges, and dependencies, and work directly with stakeholders to define mitigation plans and ensure timely resolution.
* Lead technical design reviews, code reviews, solution walkthroughs, architecture governance activities, and technical quality assurance.
* Ensure adherence to enterprise architecture standards, SDLC, Agile methodologies, DevSecOps practices, security policies, compliance requirements, and organizational best practices.
* Support production deployments, hypercare activities, performance tuning, root cause analysis, incident management, and continuous service improvement.
* Ensure delivery of high-quality, scalable, secure, maintainable, and well-documented CCaaS solutions.
* Support pre-sales and business development activities by participating in client workshops, solution demonstrations, architecture reviews, proof of concepts (PoCs), technical proposals, effort estimation, and RFP/RFI responses.
* Drive customer satisfaction by providing proactive technical leadership, transparent communication, and successful project outcomes.

**Qualifications And Experience Required**

* Bachelor's or Master’s Degree in Computer Science required.
* Can think creatively and provide innovative designs and solutions to problems.
* Design and implement large sized high-performance and scalable solutions.
* Understand trends in technology and be able leverage them in technical solutions.
* Must have good written and verbal communication skills. Must be able to effectively communicate all aspects of a project solution with managers, client and project team.
* Strong interpersonal and leadership abilities which can execute effective negotiation and team management skill.
* Be able to think creatively.

**Job Description:**
At Cloudera, we empower people to transform complex data into clear and actionable insights. With as much data under management as the hyperscalers, we're the preferred data partner for the top companies in almost every industry. **Senior**
**Solutions Architect**

This role is a client facing opportunity that combines consulting skills with deep technical design and development in the Big Data space. This role will present the successful candidate the opportunity to travel across Asia Pacific and across multiple industries and large customer organisations.
  
  
**As the Senior**
**Solutions Architect you will:**

* Work directly with customer business and technical teams to understand requirements and develop high quality solutions
* Design highly scalable and reliable data pipelines to consume, integrate, and analyze large amounts of data from various sources.

* Install, deploy, augment, upgrade, manage and operate large Hadoop clusters
* Write and produce technical documentation, customer status reports and knowledge-base articles
* Keep up with current Hadoop, NiFi, Big Data ecosystem / technologies.

**We’re excited about you if you have:**

* Overall 12+ years IT experience, with at least 4+ years of production experience working with Hadoop and/or NiFi, data engineering.
* Hands-on experience with all aspects of developing, testing and implementing low-latency big data pipelines.
* Demonstrated production experience in data engineering, data management, cluster management and/or analytics domains.
* Experience designing data queries against data in the HDFS environment using tools such as Apache Hive
* Experience implementing MapReduce, Spark jobs
* Experience setting up multi-node Hadoop clusters
* Experience in systems administration or DevOps experience with one or more open-source operating systems [Big Data Developers interested in Administration and consulting can also apply]

* Understanding of the Java ecosystem and enterprise offerings, including debugging and profiling tools (e.g. jstack, jmap, jconsole), logging and monitoring tools (log4j, JMX)
* Ability to understand and translate customer requirements into technical requirements
* Excellent verbal and written communications

**You may also have:**

* Site Reliability Engineering concepts and practices
* Knowledge of the data management eco-system including: Concepts of data warehousing, ETL, data integration, etc.
* Experience using a compiled programming language, preferably one that runs on the JVM (Java, Scala, etc)
* Experience coding with streaming/micro-batch compute frameworks, preferably Kafka, Spark

**What you can expect from us:**

12ba29eb.title: SaaS Architect
12ba29eb.description:
Role: SaaS Architect

Exp: 12 years

Loc: Uppal

5 days office

**Role Overview**

We are building and scaling a multi-tenant SaaS platform on AWS with .NET services and React/Next.js front ends. The SaaS Solution Architect is the bridge between customer need and technical solution: you shape end-to-end solution architecture for prospects and existing customers, run technical discovery and design workshops, and translate commercial requirements into a coherent, buildable design on the shared platform. This is a customer-facing architecture role that carries real technical depth.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own end-to-end solution architecture for the multi-tenant SaaS platform across application, integration, data, security and platform layers.
* Lead customer-facing technical engagements: discovery sessions, architecture workshops, solution presentations, proof-of-concept scoping and technical deep dives with customer architects and security teams.
* Translate business requirements, commercial constraints and regulatory obligations into solution designs, architecture decision records and implementation roadmaps.
* Define and evolve the tenancy model tenant isolation strategy (pooled, bridged, silo), tenant onboarding and provisioning, per-tenant configuration, feature entitlement and tiered service levels.
* Design AWS reference architectures using EKS/ECS, Lambda, API Gateway, RDS/Aurora, S3, SQS/SNS/EventBridge, Cognito and CloudFront, with cost, resilience and multi-region considerations made explicit.
* Hands-on Architect .NET microservices and React/Next.js front ends: service boundaries, API contracts, design patterns, caching, async workflows and shared component strategy.
* Design the data architecture in partnership with data architects: tenant data segregation, data residency, retention, encryption, reporting and analytics access patterns.
* Own non-functional architecture: scalability and load modelling, availability and RTO/RPO targets, performance budgets, observability strategy and capacity/cost forecasting.
* Support the commercial cycle: respond to RFPs, security questionnaires and architecture due-diligence reviews; size and estimate solutions; contribute to statements of work and pricing inputs.
* Govern solution delivery: architecture review boards, design sign-off, technical risk registers and ensuring what is built matches what was designed.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* Certified AWS Architect, proven experience architecting production multi-tenant SaaS platforms, with a clear command of tenancy models and the trade-offs between isolation, cost and operational complexity.
* Deep AWS architecture experience across compute, containers, serverless, managed data services, networking, identity and cost management.
* Strong full-stack technical foundation: .NET / C# (ASP.NET Core, .NET 69) services and React or Next.js front ends with TypeScript.
* Microservices and distributed-systems architecture experience — service decomposition, API design, event-driven patterns, resilience and consistency trade-offs.
* Solid data architecture literacy: relational modelling (PostgreSQL, SQL Server), caching, analytics access patterns and tenant data isolation.
* Demonstrated customer-facing experience — presenting architecture to senior customer stakeholders, handling objections, and winning technical trust in sales or delivery contexts.
* Security and compliance architecture experience relevant to SaaS: OAuth 2.0/OIDC, SSO federation, encryption, tenant boundary controls and audit evidence.
* Strong commercial awareness: solution sizing, estimation, licensing/cost modelling and the ability to reason about margin impact of design choices.
* Experience with containerized, pipeline-driven delivery (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD) and Infrastructure-as-Code.

b48bbfaa.title: Technical Account Manager, ES - INDIA
b48bbfaa.description:
**Description**
AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.
  
  
Amazon has built a global reputation for being the most customer-centric company, a company that customers from all over the world recognize, value, and trust for both our products and services. Amazon has a fast-paced environment where we “Work Hard, Have Fun and Make History.”
  
  
As an increasing number of enterprises move their critical systems to the cloud, AWS India is in need of highly efficient technical consulting talent to help our largest and strategically important customers navigate the operational challenges and complexities of AWS Cloud. We are looking for Technical Consultants to support our customers creative and transformative spirit of innovation across all technologies, including Compute, Storage, Database, Data Analytics, Application services, Networking, Server-less and more. This is not a sales role, but rather an opportunity to be the principal technical advisor for organizations ranging from start-ups to large enterprises.
  
  
As a Technical Account Manager, you will be the primary technical point of contact for one or more customers helping to plan, debug, and oversee ongoing operations of business-critical applications. You will get your hands dirty, troubleshooting application, network, database, and architectural challenges using a suite of internal AWS Cloud tools as well as your existing knowledge and toolkits. We are seeking individuals with strong backgrounds in I.T. Consulting and in any of these related areas such as Solution Designing, Application and System Development, Database Management, Big Data and Analytics, DevOps Consulting, and Media technologies. Knowledge of programming and scripting is beneficial to the role.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Every day will bring new and exciting challenges on the job while you:
  
  

* Learn and use Cloud technologies.
* Interact with leading technologists around the world.
* Work on critical, highly complex customer problems that may span multiple AWS Cloud services.
* Apply advanced troubleshooting techniques to provide unique solutions to our customers' individual needs.
* Work directly with AWS Cloud subject matter experts to help reproduce and resolve customer issues.
* Write tutorials, how-to videos, and other technical articles for the customer community.
* Leverage your extensive customer support experience and provide feedback to internal AISPL teams on how to improve our services.
* Drive projects that improve support-related processes and our customers’ technical support experience.
* Assist in Design/Architecture of AWS and Hybrid cloud solutions.
* Help Enterprises define IT and business processes that work well with cloud deployments.
* Be available outside of business hours to help coordinate the handling of urgent issues as needed.

**About The Team**
Diverse Experiences
  
  
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS?
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture

839acca1.title: Lead Managed Services Engineer II
839acca1.description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Artificial Intelligence & Engineering**
AI & Engineering leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to help build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These insights are powered by engineering for business advantage, helping transform mission-critical operations.
  
  
Join our AI & Engineering team to help transform technology platforms, driving innovation, and help make a significant impact on our clients' achievements. You’ll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and re-engineering operations and processes that could be critical to businesses.
  
  
**Level**
: Lead Managed Services Engineer II
  
  
As a Lead Managed Services Engineer II, you will lead the design, implementation, and scaling of AI-powered and automation solutions across IT and business operations. This role requires a hands-on leader who can move from strategy to execution by identifying high-value opportunities, shaping solutions, and delivering production-grade outcomes. The ideal candidate combines experience in AI implementation with a strong background in infrastructure and operations and is comfortable leading teams and stakeholders in enterprise hybrid infrastructure environments.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As a Lead Managed Services Engineer II on the Hybrid Cloud Infrastructure team, you will be responsible for:
  
  

* Identify opportunities to apply AI and automation by analyzing operational data, service trends, workflow bottlenecks, and business pain points.
* Lead end-to-end delivery of AI and automation initiatives, from discovery and design through deployment, stabilization, and continuous improvement.
* Design and implement AI-powered solutions, including AI agents, that leverage LLMs, enterprise tools, APIs, and workflow platforms to automate complex processes.
* Partner with business, operations, infrastructure, and security teams to translate requirements into practical implementation plans and technical roadmaps.
* Oversee environments, integrations, observability, incident handling, and deployment readiness for AI solutions in production.
* Lead client and stakeholder discussions, present operational insights, manage escalations, and drive adoption of new solutions.
* Improve operational performance across infrastructure and service delivery by applying automation to incident management, requests, knowledge access, monitoring, and remediation workflows.
* Establish KPIs and success metrics such as efficiency gains, latency, completion rates, user satisfaction, SLA performance, and service quality.
* Develop documentation, runbooks, and handoff materials to support long-term sustainment and scale.

**The team**
At Hybrid Cloud Infrastructure we deliver solutions spanning Hybrid Cloud, Advanced Connectivity, AI Data Centers, High-Performance Computing, and AI Infrastructure to help clients achieve their desired outcomes. Our offerings include engineered transformation services for hybrid cloud infrastructure and platforms, prioritizing resiliency, optimization, and extensive automation. We integrate advanced connectivity with AI infrastructure and enterprise networks to boost operational efficiency and enable real-time data processing. Additionally, we provide comprehensive management of all facets of operations for hybrid cloud infrastructure and field operations.
  
  
**Location:**
Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai
  
  
**Shift Timings:**
24/7 as per business requirements
  
  
**Qualifications**
Required:
  
  

* 10 - 14 years of hands-on experience in Proven experience leading AI and automation implementations in enterprise or production environments.
* Significant experience in IT operations, infrastructure, automation, AI engineering, or related technology delivery roles.
* Strong knowledge of infrastructure operations, including cloud, networks, servers, virtualization, backup, disaster recovery, and end-user support.
* Good understanding of observability frameworks , self-healing platforms , and AIOPS
* Experience using data and operational analytics to identify automation and AI opportunities and build business cases for change and own the execution to deliver automation to meet efficiency targets
* Ability to lead cross-functional teams and work effectively with engineering, operations, product, security, and business stakeholders.
* Strong client-facing communication and presentation skills, including experience managing expectations and driving executive-level conversations.
* Familiarity with ITIL-based service management, including incident, change, and problem management.
* Experience working in regulated environments with awareness of governance, risk, and compliance requirements such as SOX, HIPAA, or GDPR.
* Prior people leadership or program leadership experience in a manager-level role strongly preferred.
* ITSM and Hybrid Infrastructure experience
* Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, Ansible, or CloudFormation
* Cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP
* APIs, webhooks, event-driven integrations, CI/CD, and containers
* Observability and monitoring platforms such as Dynatrace , ITOM or AppDynamics
* BE/B.Tech/M.C.A./M.Sc (CS) degree or equivalent from accredited university

**Preferred -**

* AI agent frameworks such as LangChain, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, or CrewAI
* Vector databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS, or Qdrant

#HCIFY27
  
  
**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
  
  
**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
  
  
**Recruiting tips**
From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

74013f06.title: Program Manager, IN Launch, GESI-IN Launch
74013f06.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Are you interested in launching the next generation of Amazon sites in India? Do you want to be part of the ongoing growth and expansion of Amazon’s infrastructure? The IN-Engineering Services Team is seeking an experienced Amazon Operator or Program Manager to join the IN-Launch Team to support the expansion of operation sites in India. The Launch Program Manager is a key player in the end-to-end delivery of the complex challenge of launching new buildings, driving improvements and standards to enable new buildings to achieve benchmark rates while ramping to meet network capacity. In this role, you will influence a team comprising of General Managers, Senior Operations Managers, Operation Managers, Change Ops manager, Area Managers, Project Managers, Process SMEs, Design Engineers, Real Estate, RME, CP as well as representatives of various key stakeholder teams including Supply Chain & Transportation, WHS, WFS, L&D, ICQA, EHS, Legal, L&P, ER, Finance and many others. This role calls for an individual who is operationally knowledgeable, structured, confident and professionally and socially adept to earn credibility and trust with customers and stakeholders at various levels of the organization, keeping an open mind, sense of humor, multi-tasking, ability to manage and deal with constant change, a drive-and-ambition and ability to deal with ambiguity will help you remain innovative in our culture  
In order to be successful in this position, you need to be comfortable interfacing and driving various BU’s launches, including INFC, IXD/RC, DRCC, SDC, SC, AMZL, GSF, QC & 3P launches for respective BU’s. This will be an exciting opportunity for you if you possess a high level of autonomy and integrity while managing a variety of job responsibilities. You will be part of a high functioning team that is interconnected and supportive of each other to help complete multiple, complex and high capital projects simultaneously.
  
The individual will be responsible for entire region (IN Network Operate in 3 Regions, “North & East”, “South & Central” and “West”). The role will be based out of 3 regions with up to 50% of time on job travel across states. This is the fusion of strategical as well as tactical during full cycle of launch.  
  
  
  
Key job responsibilities  
The successful candidate:  

* Is structured and organized, to plan the use of resource to meet deadlines.
* Has strong interpersonal skills, to motivate and lead core teams working on launch.
* Has strong communication skills to build relationships and identify with stakeholders across the organization.
* Is able to use their initiative and make decisions under pressure.
* Has the ability to seek opportunities to drive year on year performance and process improvements
* Will compile, manage and report on weekly launch metrics and be responsible for leading many high-profile meetings to align on launch requirements.
* Has the ability to learn fast and adapt quickly to changing circumstances.
* Has operational skills and experience.
* Can work closely with core team from operational and construction sites.
* Setup mechanism for tracking overall launch, support function 4M and signage delivery system.
* Drive learnings and adhoc requirements through CM mechanism from respective stakeholders.
* Can work independently to solve problems and drive actions with a variety of stakeholders.
* Monitors and reports on the progress of all launch activity within the site project including significant milestones and any conditions which would affect project schedule.
* Should be able to ask “Why” and request details in regards to the impact of any changes requested by different teams.
* Is capable of taking accountability while providing status, asking for help, and immediately escalating issues and problems as necessary.
* Should be able to coordinate activities while onsite as well as from the office.
* Possesses a broad technical background and has the ability to “roll up their sleeves” and jump in to support, along with Coordinating the activities of different functions and act as the anchor or single point of contact for the launch process

  
  
A day in the life  

* End-to-End project coordination, managing multiple stakeholders to ensure all Road to Launch tasks are completed as per program
* Managing Launch calls with regional teams, documenting key actionable and ensure closure of key points.
* Ensuring support function 4M cycle completion as per process.
* Ensuring all function signage cycle completion as per process.
* Ensure 5S marking BOQ closure as per site requirement.
* Coordinate with RE for site selection process as per SLA and POR NBD with SIM mechanism in place.
* Ensure TAX registration process and support seller onboarding process as per Launch tenets.
* Ensuring overall site readiness through thorough composite reviews and effective communication on in-flight changes
* Post launch lessons learned sessions to drive year-on-year improvements
* Managing continuous improvement in 4M, Playbook, Signages and launch mechanism.

  
About the team  
Our team is focused on driving programmatic excellence across Amazon, delivering results that matter to customers and the business. We operate in a collaborative environment where new ideas are welcomed and simplification is a priority. As we continue to grow, we are investing in automation, data-driven planning, and scalable mechanisms that raise the bar on how we deliver. This is a team where your leadership will have a direct impact on both the people you manage and the programs you own.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5+ years of program or project management experience
* Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
* Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
* Experience owning program strategy, end-to-end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 2+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

9428f7d5.description:
**Join us in Shaping the Future of AI & Data**

At goML, we are committed to transforming businesses by delivering world-class AI and Data solutions. Our teams are passionate about pushing boundaries, driving innovation, and delivering measurable impact. Our mission is to bridge the gap between state-of-the-art AI research and real-world enterprise applications—helping organizations innovate faster, make smarter decisions, and scale AI solutions seamlessly.

As we scale, we’re looking for a Delivery Manager who can take ownership of end-to-end project delivery, build strong client relationships, and lead cross-functional teams to consistent success. If you thrive in fast-paced environments, love delivering outcomes at scale, and bring strong leadership to complex engagements—we’d love to hear from you!

**Why You? Why Now?**

AI and Data delivery is moving faster than ever, and customers expect not just results—but predictable delivery, strong governance, and trusted partnerships. This role is perfect for a leader who can balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution, ensuring delivery excellence across multiple programs.

Joining goML now places you at the center of high-impact AI & Data initiatives where you’ll directly shape delivery processes, lead teams, and strengthen customer trust at scale.

**What You’ll Do (Key Responsibilities)**

First 30 Days: Foundation & Orientation

* Deep dive into goML’s delivery models, methodologies, and customer portfolio
* Understand ongoing projects, governance structures, and client expectations
* Establish relationships with internal stakeholders, cross-functional teams, and leadership
* Review current delivery processes, tools, reporting standards, and best practices
* Identify early opportunities to improve predictability and execution workflows

First 60 Days: Execution & Impact

* Take ownership of multiple projects and ensure smooth execution and on-time delivery
* Drive core delivery governance including:
* scope management
* resource planning
* timelines and milestone tracking
* risk identification and mitigation
* Engage with customers regularly to:
* align on delivery goals
* manage escalations
* ensure satisfaction and transparency
* Mentor project managers, coordinators, and technical leads to maintain delivery health
* Ensure strong stakeholder alignment by balancing internal priorities and client outcomes

First 180 Days: Ownership & Transformation

* Lead large-scale complex deliveries end-to-end with focus on:
* quality
* profitability
* customer value
* long-term engagement success
* Build and scale a high-performing delivery team with accountability and collaboration
* Contribute to growth by supporting:
* pre-sales solutioning
* effort estimation
* proposal development
* Identify delivery gaps and implement scalable best practices across programs
* Strengthen goML’s reputation as a trusted partner by delivering consistent outcomes and nurturing long-term relationships

**What You Bring (Qualifications & Skills)**

**Must-Haves**

* 7+ years of experience in project and delivery management, ideally in AI / Data / Software services
* Proven success managing multiple complex projects and cross-functional teams
* Strong delivery leadership in:
* planning
* risk management
* resource optimization
* stakeholder communication
* Excellent customer engagement skills:
* trusted relationship building
* escalation handling

f18eabcd.title: Technical Program Manager – Funding & Payments
f18eabcd.description:
**Overview**
**Connecting clients to markets – and talent to opportunity.**
With 5,400+ employees and over 80,000 institutional, commercial, and payments clients, we operate from more than 80 offices spread across six continents. As a Fortune 100, Nasdaq-listed provider, we connect clients to the global markets – focusing on innovation, human connection, and providing world-class products and services to all types of investors.
  
  
Whether you want to forge a career connecting our retail clients to potential trading opportunities, or ingrain yourself in the world of institutional investing, StoneX Group is made up of four business segments that offer endless potential for progression and growth.
  
  
**Business Segment Overview**
**Corporate:**
Engage in a deep variety of business-critical activities that keep our company running efficiently. From strategic marketing and financial management to human resources and operational oversight, you’ll have the opportunity to optimize processes and implement game-changing policies.
  
  
**Position Purpose:**
We are looking to recruit a Program Manager to lead delivery across our Funding and Payments portfolio, based out of our Pune, India office. The successful candidate will have previous experience leading complex, large-scale technical program deliveries spanning multiple geographies, business units and platforms, ideally across client funding, cash management and payments.
  
  
Working closely with the EPMO, Payments and Treasury leadership, Product, Technology, Operations and third-party providers, you will drive delivery of a strategic, multi-year portfolio of funding and payments initiatives. This includes the Funding as a Service (FaaS) program, which brings client funding, cash management, and ACH authorization and entitlements to commercial, introducing broker and newly integrated client bases, alongside Global Payments initiatives such as real-time payment (RTP) currencies through correspondent banks, a payment status and tracking engine, cross-currency accounts and operations automation. Much of the payments development capacity sits in India, so you will play a central role in keeping those teams aligned to firm-wide priorities. This is a great opportunity for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, challenging and collaborative working environment and who is results-driven.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Primary duties will include:**
Driving overall delivery of a strategic program of work across Funding and Payments. Your role is to define the different stages of implementation and ensure they are met. Your main roles and responsibilities will be as follows, but are not limited to:
  
  

* Work with Payments, Treasury, Product, commercial teams and senior stakeholders to identify program scope and objectives across the funding and payments lifecycle – client funding, payment initiation, authorization, routing, execution, confirmation, reconciliation and reporting
* Work with delivery teams and solution architects to build out agreed scope, define requirements and build robust plans for delivery across payment channels and rails, including ACH, wires/SWIFT, real-time payments and correspondent banking
* Define the projects and features that make up the program, bringing consensus to the most efficient way to deliver value to the organization as quickly as possible
* Monitor and assess program performance, overseeing delivery of the projects and features that make up the program, ensuring completion on time, to scope and within budget
* Take overall responsibility for ensuring everyone on the program is clear on what needs to happen, when it needs to happen by, how it is going to happen and who by
* Identify, track and monitor dependencies across shared payments development teams, dependent programs (such as CRM, client onboarding and trading platform launches) and downstream Operations and Treasury teams
* Coordinate delivery across internal teams, correspondent and partner banks, payment service providers and other third-party vendors, ensuring alignment of business, operational and technology outcomes
* Secure resource commitment and hold teams to account, applying the firm’s portfolio prioritization framework to resolve competing demands on shared development capacity quickly and transparently
* Identify high-level risks and issues and track them through to resolution, escalating promptly to sponsors where priority or resourcing conflicts put milestones at risk
* Partner with Operations, Risk, Compliance, Legal and Technology to ensure regulatory and control requirements, such as payment authorization, entitlements and audit trails, are embedded in delivery
* Own program financials: report spend to date (hrs and $) against budget, forecast to completion, and raise change and funding requests when scope or dependencies shift
* Clearly, concisely and accurately communicate program progress, RAG status, risks and decisions at regular intervals to sponsors, working groups and steering committees across the US, UK and Europe
* Build relationships with stakeholders, delivery teams, vendors and EPMO team members, acting as the EPMO’s on-the-ground delivery lead in Pune
* Identify, address and resolve differences between individuals and/or interest groups

**Qualifications**
**To land this role you will need**
:
  
  

* 7+ years of full-time program management experience or equivalent
* Proven success delivering large and complex change initiatives at program level, ideally in financial services and with budgets of over $2m / 10,000 person days
* Knowledge of payments and cash management is a must, including ACH and Stable Coin.
* Familiarity with payment platforms and messaging, such as payment hubs, payment status and tracking solutions, SWIFT and ISO 20022, or comparable treasury and cash management systems
* Comfortable working with internal teams of 50+ people across multiple geographies and time zones, with regular overlap with UK and US business hours
* A key collaborator – inclusive, results-driven, who leads by example and brings the best out of teams
* Ability to work with people, both internally and externally, to build support to achieve intended outcomes
* Knowledge of complex technical ecosystems and financial services preferred; exposure to futures, brokerage or FCM client funding would be an advantage
* Direct experience working with IT development teams, platforms and solution architects
* Ability to quickly adapt to shifting priorities, demands and timelines
* Ability to thrive in a challenging, fast-paced environment
* Strong leadership qualities with the capability to manage diverse teams
* Ability to master and navigate new subject domains quickly
* Confident in communicating with C-suites and technical delivery teams
* Experience in Jira and Confluence, Agile and Waterfall
* A background in business analysis would be an advantage.
* The role will be based in the Pune, India office 4 days per week
* A professional qualification in project / program management (e.g., PMP, PgMP, PRINCE2 or MSP) is preferred
* Candidates based in Pune location is preferred

**Working environment:**

* 4 days' a week in office.

The Technical Program Manager will serve as the **single point of accountability for client delivery**, ensuring programs are delivered on time, within scope, and with high customer satisfaction.

  

You will work closely with **Engineering, Product, Implementation, and Customer Success teams** to drive program execution while managing risks, dependencies, and stakeholder communication.

**Program & Delivery Ownership**

* Own end to end delivery accountability from program kickoff through go live and stabilization

**Client Leadership**

**Scope & Change Management**

* Own scope management and change control processes
* Partner with product and customer success teams to manage trade offs

**Governance & Reporting**

* Establish delivery governance frameworks and reporting cadence
* Track KPIs related to delivery health and client satisfaction

**Required Qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience working with enterprise clients and stakeholders

* **Bachelors or Masters degree from a Tier 1 institution(Must)**

Opella is the self-care challenger with the purest and third-largest portfolio in the Over-The-Counter (OTC) & Vitamins, Minerals & Supplements (VMS) market globally.

Our mission is to bring health in people’s hands by making self-care as simple as it should be. For half a billion consumers worldwide – and counting.

  
  

At the core of this mission is our 100 loved brands, our 11,000-strong global team, our 13 best-in-class manufacturing sites and 4 specialized science and innovation development centers. Headquartered in France, Opella is the proud maker of many of the world’s most loved brands, including Allegra, Buscopan, Doliprane, Dulcolax, Enterogermina, Essentiale and Mucosolvan.

  
  

B Corp certified in multiple markets, we are active players in the journey towards healthier people and planet. Find out more about our mission at www.opella.com.

  
  

About the Role.

As an AI Solutions Expert/Specialist, you will own the design, development, and deployment of artificial intelligence solutions that automate and optimize the end-to-end content lifecycle across a global CPG organization. You will work at the intersection of AI engineering and content operations — connecting proofs of concept, MVPs, and enterprise-grade platforms to streamline how content is generated, organized, and delivered across every consumer and professional touchpoint.

  
  

This includes finance, commercial, advertising, social media, e-commerce, email marketing, HCP communications, packaging, point-of-sale materials, in-store activations, and regulatory submissions.

  
  

Key Responsibilities.

* Architect and lead AI-driven solutions that automate content creation, adaptation, review, approval, and distribution across all content channels and markets

* Build and maintain production-grade applications on Microsoft Azure, leveraging Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search, Document Intelligence, Azure OpenAI Service, Azure Cognitive Services, and related platform services

* Integrate large language models, image generation models, video models, and multi-modal AI systems into scalable content workflows

* Design and implement data pipelines that connect AI models to enterprise content repositories, PIM systems, DAM platforms, and downstream delivery channels

* Drive initiatives through the full lifecycle — from POC through MVP to enterprise-scale deployment — establishing engineering standards, CI/CD pipelines, observability, and governance at each stage

* Collaborate cross-functionally with brand marketing, e-commerce, regulatory/legal, medical affairs, creative agencies, and IT to translate business needs into technical solutions

* Evaluate and integrate emerging AI technologies, foundation models, and Azure services to continuously advance the content ecosystem

* Define governance standards for AI model usage, data quality, content compliance, brand safety, and responsible AI practices

* Mentor developers and engineers on AI/ML engineering patterns, cloud-native development, and Azure best practices

  
  

General Business

Required Qualifications.

* 8+ years of experience in software/application development, with a significant portion focused on AI/ML solution engineering

* Hands-on expertise with Azure AI Foundry, Azure Document Intelligence, Azure AI Search, Azure OpenAI Service, and Azure Cognitive/AI Services

* Strong application development background — ability to build, ship, and maintain production-grade software, not just prototypes or notebooks

* Proven experience with LLMs including prompt engineering, fine-tuning, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and agentic architectures

* Experience with generative AI for image, video, and/or multi-modal content creation

* Solid experience designing and operating data pipelines in Azure (Azure Data Factory, Azure Functions, Event Grid, or equivalent)

* Proficiency in Python and at least one additional enterprise language (C#, TypeScript, Java)

* Strong understanding of API design, microservices architecture, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes/AKS), and cloud-native patterns

* Experience deploying AI solutions through the full maturity curve: POC MVP enterprise production

* Hands-on experience with DevOps and MLOps tooling — Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions, MLflow, model versioning, drift monitoring, automated retraining, and A/B testing in production

* Working knowledge of database technologies including Cosmos DB, Azure SQL, and data lake architectures (Azure Data Lake, Blob Storage, Azure Synapse)

* Experience building with AI orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, Semantic Kernel, or AutoGen

* Familiarity with front-end and full-stack patterns (React or Angular, FastAPI/Flask backends, serverless architectures) to deliver end-to-end solutions

  
  

Required Technical Skills.

Cloud & AI Platform

Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI Service, Azure Cognitive Services, Azure Machine Learning, Azure AI Search, Azure Document Intelligence, Azure Bot Service

Data Engineering

Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse, Azure Event Hub / Event Grid, Azure Functions, Cosmos DB, Azure SQL, Blob Storage, Data Lake

AI/ML Frameworks

LangChain, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, Hugging Face, PyTorch, TensorFlow, ONNX

Generative AI

Deep Agents, Agentic Workflow developments, multi-modal pipelines

DevOps & MLOps

Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Docker, Kubernetes / AKS, MLflow, Weights & Biases, model registry, CI/CD for ML

App Development

REST / GraphQL APIs, React or Angular, FastAPI / Flask, microservices, serverless, event-driven architectures

Security & Governance

Azure RBAC, Key Vault, Managed Identity, responsible AI tooling, content safety APIs

  
  

General Business

Languages: Python, TypeScript / JavaScript, SQL

Good to Have — Domain & Business Experience.

* Experience working in or with CPG, FMCG, consumer health, or pharmaceutical organizations

* Familiarity with consumer advertising and media production workflows (TV, digital, social, programmatic)

* Exposure to social media content operations, scheduling platforms, and performance analytics

* Understanding of e-commerce product content (product descriptions, A+ content, marketplace listings)

* Awareness of email marketing and CRM-driven personalization tools (Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Adobe Campaign, or similar)

* Experience with HCP and medical affairs communications in regulated environments

* Knowledge of packaging artwork, labeling workflows, and regulatory/legal review cycles

* Familiarity with point-of-sale and in-store activation material production

* Experience with PIM and DAM platforms (Salsify, Akeneo, Adobe AEM, Bynder, or similar)

* Understanding of regulatory submission, claims substantiation, and content compliance frameworks (FDA, EU MDR, local market regulations)

* Exposure to localization and transcreation processes across global markets

* Experience integrating with enterprise platforms such as SAP, Veeva, Salesforce, or Others

* Azure certifications (AI Engineer Associate, Solutions Architect Expert, or equivalent)

* Track record of working in AI Centers of Excellence or capability-building functions

* Experience managing vendor and agency relationships for AI tooling and creative technology

  
  

What You’ll Impact.

* Speed and cost-efficiency of content production across global markets

* Brand consistency and regulatory compliance across all consumer and professional touchpoints

* Data-driven decision-making through AI-powered content insights and performance analytics

* AI agentic automation and process efficiency gains

* The organization’s long-term AI and content technology roadmap

e8791b4a.title: Technical Program Manager – Funding & Payments
e8791b4a.description:
Overview:

**Connecting clients to markets – and talent to opportunity.**  
  
With 5,400+ employees and over 80,000 institutional, commercial, and payments clients, we operate from more than 80 offices spread across six continents. As a Fortune 100, Nasdaq-listed provider, we connect clients to the global markets – focusing on innovation, human connection, and providing world-class products and services to all types of investors.  
  
Whether you want to forge a career connecting our retail clients to potential trading opportunities, or ingrain yourself in the world of institutional investing, StoneX Group is made up of four business segments that offer endless potential for progression and growth.

**Business Segment Overview**

**Corporate:** Engage in a deep variety of business-critical activities that keep our company running efficiently. From strategic marketing and financial management to human resources and operational oversight, you’ll have the opportunity to optimize processes and implement game-changing policies.

**Position Purpose:** We are looking to recruit a Program Manager to lead delivery across our Funding and Payments portfolio, based out of our Pune, India office. The successful candidate will have previous experience leading complex, large-scale technical program deliveries spanning multiple geographies, business units and platforms, ideally across client funding, cash management and payments.

Working closely with the EPMO, Payments and Treasury leadership, Product, Technology, Operations and third-party providers, you will drive delivery of a strategic, multi-year portfolio of funding and payments initiatives. This includes the Funding as a Service (FaaS) program, which brings client funding, cash management, and ACH authorization and entitlements to commercial, introducing broker and newly integrated client bases, alongside Global Payments initiatives such as real-time payment (RTP) currencies through correspondent banks, a payment status and tracking engine, cross-currency accounts and operations automation. Much of the payments development capacity sits in India, so you will play a central role in keeping those teams aligned to firm-wide priorities. This is a great opportunity for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, challenging and collaborative working environment and who is results-driven.

Responsibilities:

**Primary duties will include:**

Driving overall delivery of a strategic program of work across Funding and Payments. Your role is to define the different stages of implementation and ensure they are met. Your main roles and responsibilities will be as follows, but are not limited to:

* Work with Payments, Treasury, Product, commercial teams and senior stakeholders to identify program scope and objectives across the funding and payments lifecycle – client funding, payment initiation, authorization, routing, execution, confirmation, reconciliation and reporting
* Work with delivery teams and solution architects to build out agreed scope, define requirements and build robust plans for delivery across payment channels and rails, including ACH, wires/SWIFT, real-time payments and correspondent banking
* Define the projects and features that make up the program, bringing consensus to the most efficient way to deliver value to the organization as quickly as possible
* Monitor and assess program performance, overseeing delivery of the projects and features that make up the program, ensuring completion on time, to scope and within budget
* Take overall responsibility for ensuring everyone on the program is clear on what needs to happen, when it needs to happen by, how it is going to happen and who by
* Identify, track and monitor dependencies across shared payments development teams, dependent programs (such as CRM, client onboarding and trading platform launches) and downstream Operations and Treasury teams
* Coordinate delivery across internal teams, correspondent and partner banks, payment service providers and other third-party vendors, ensuring alignment of business, operational and technology outcomes
* Secure resource commitment and hold teams to account, applying the firm’s portfolio prioritization framework to resolve competing demands on shared development capacity quickly and transparently
* Identify high-level risks and issues and track them through to resolution, escalating promptly to sponsors where priority or resourcing conflicts put milestones at risk
* Partner with Operations, Risk, Compliance, Legal and Technology to ensure regulatory and control requirements, such as payment authorization, entitlements and audit trails, are embedded in delivery
* Own program financials: report spend to date (hrs and $) against budget, forecast to completion, and raise change and funding requests when scope or dependencies shift
* Clearly, concisely and accurately communicate program progress, RAG status, risks and decisions at regular intervals to sponsors, working groups and steering committees across the US, UK and Europe
* Build relationships with stakeholders, delivery teams, vendors and EPMO team members, acting as the EPMO’s on-the-ground delivery lead in Pune
* Identify, address and resolve differences between individuals and/or interest groups

Qualifications:

**To land this role you will need**:

* **7+ years of full-time program management experience or equivalent**
* **Proven success delivering large and complex change initiatives at program level, ideally in financial services and with budgets of over $2m / 10,000 person days**
* **Knowledge of payments and cash management is a must, including ACH and Stable Coin.**
* **Familiarity with payment platforms and messaging, such as payment hubs, payment status and tracking solutions, SWIFT and ISO 20022, or comparable treasury and cash management systems**
* Comfortable working with internal teams of 50+ people across multiple geographies and time zones, with regular overlap with UK and US business hours
* A key collaborator – inclusive, results-driven, who leads by example and brings the best out of teams
* Ability to work with people, both internally and externally, to build support to achieve intended outcomes
* Knowledge of complex technical ecosystems and financial services preferred; exposure to futures, brokerage or FCM client funding would be an advantage
* Direct experience working with IT development teams, platforms and solution architects
* Ability to quickly adapt to shifting priorities, demands and timelines
* Ability to thrive in a challenging, fast-paced environment
* Strong leadership qualities with the capability to manage diverse teams
* Ability to master and navigate new subject domains quickly
* Confident in communicating with C-suites and technical delivery teams
* Experience in Jira and Confluence, Agile and Waterfall
* A background in business analysis would be an advantage.
* The role will be based in the Pune, India office 4 days per week
* A professional qualification in project / program management (e.g., PMP, PgMP, PRINCE2 or MSP) is preferred
* **Candidates based in Pune location is preferred**

**Working environment:**

* 4 days' a week in office.

efcf372d.title: Storage & Backup Architect
efcf372d.description:
**Job Summary**
---------------

We are looking for an experienced Storage & Backup Architect to design, implement, manage, and optimize enterprise storage, backup, and disaster recovery infrastructure. The candidate should have strong expertise in SAN/NAS technologies, enterprise backup solutions, data protection, replication, recovery planning, capacity management, and performance optimization across large-scale data center environments.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, implement, and maintain enterprise storage and backup architectures aligned with business continuity, performance, scalability, and availability requirements.

* Architect and manage SAN, NAS, block, file, and object storage solutions.
* Configure and manage Fibre Channel, iSCSI, NFS, SMB, RAID, LUN provisioning, zoning, and multipathing.
* Design and implement enterprise backup, recovery, archival, and data retention solutions.
* Manage backup policies, schedules, retention, replication, and recovery procedures for physical and virtual environments.
* Implement backup solutions for VMware, Windows, Linux, databases, applications, and file systems.
* Design and manage backup infrastructure, including backup servers, media servers, repositories, deduplication appliances, and backup storage.
* Implement and manage immutable backups, air-gapped protection, and ransomware recovery strategies.
* Design and validate disaster recovery solutions, including storage replication, backup copies, recovery objectives (RPO/RTO), and DR testing.
* Monitor backup job status, resolve failures, troubleshoot performance issues, and ensure successful backup and restore operations.
* Perform periodic recovery testing and validate data integrity and recoverability.
* Manage storage capacity planning, performance monitoring, utilization, and lifecycle management.
* Lead storage and backup migrations, upgrades, refresh activities, and infrastructure transformation projects.
* Integrate storage and backup solutions with VMware, enterprise servers, databases, and data center infrastructure.
* Prepare HLDs, LLDs, implementation plans, SOPs, backup policies, and disaster recovery documentation.
* Coordinate with infrastructure, network, virtualization, application, and security teams to resolve complex technical issues.
* Provide technical leadership for incident management, root cause analysis, and infrastructure optimization.

### **Requirements**

**Required Technical Skills**
-----------------------------

* Strong expertise in enterprise storage architecture, administration, and troubleshooting.

* Hands-on experience with SAN/NAS, Fibre Channel, iSCSI, RAID, storage provisioning, and multipathing.
* Experience with enterprise storage platforms such as Dell PowerStore/PowerMax, NetApp, HPE Alletra/Primera, IBM FlashSystem, or equivalent.
* Strong experience with enterprise backup solutions such as Veeam, Veritas NetBackup, Dell NetWorker, Commvault, or equivalent.
* Knowledge of backup architecture, backup repositories, deduplication, compression, replication, and retention management.
* Experience in backup and recovery for VMware virtual machines, Windows/Linux servers, databases, and enterprise applications.
* Understanding of immutable backups, ransomware protection, off-site backup copies, and air-gapped recovery.
* Expertise in disaster recovery planning, RPO/RTO requirements, recovery testing, and business continuity.
* Experience with storage replication, snapshots, thin provisioning, and data migration.
* Knowledge of VMware vSphere integration with storage and backup infrastructure.
* Experience in performance monitoring, capacity planning, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis.
* Ability to create technical architecture documents, implementation plans, and operational procedures.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline.

* Relevant storage or backup vendor certifications are an advantage.
* Experience working in large enterprise, telecom, or service-provider data center environments.
* Exposure to automation, monitoring, and infrastructure management tools.

**Key Competencies**
--------------------

* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.

* Excellent communication and technical documentation skills.
* Ability to lead technical discussions and coordinate with cross-functional teams.
* Strong focus on data protection, service availability, security, and operational excellence

**Expected Outcome**
--------------------

Deliver a secure, scalable, and resilient storage and backup infrastructure that ensures data availability, reliable backup and recovery, disaster recovery readiness, and business continuity across enterprise IT environments.

**Working Hours**

Monday to Saturday (6 Days)

### **Benefits**

* 8+ years of expertise in HCL Commerce and/or IBM WebSphere Commerce (WCS) 8.x, covering store customization, commands/tasks, tools, catalog/order/user/organization flows, and back-end integration

* Strong hands-on architectural expertise in Microsoft Azure
* Deep understanding of Azure platform and systems architecture, including Azure Landing Zones, Management Groups, and Subscriptions

4a8afd59.description:
We are looking for a seasoned **AS/400 Architect** to define the technical vision and architectural direction for the AI Tools team, shaping EPAM's in-house solution for IBM iSeries (AS/400) application reverse engineering, analysis, and modernization at an enterprise scale.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Define the architectural vision, standards, and technical roadmap for the IBM iSeries (AS/400) reverse-engineering and modernization solution
* Conduct application portfolio analysis to identify redundant, unreachable, duplicated, obsolete, tightly coupled, and highly complex code, and assess application quality, maintainability, performance, technical debt, modernization readiness, and potential risks
* Analyze legacy IBM AS/400 applications, identify dependencies and business rules, trace data flows, document application behavior, and assess undocumented or complex codebases
* Drive IBM AS/400 modernization approaches, including code refactoring, format conversion, database modernization, API and web-service enablement, UI modernization, application decomposition, cloud integration, re-platforming, and application retirement
* Collaborate with the AI Tools team to define requirements, validate analysis logic, improve prompts and rules, and enhance the accuracy of AI-generated application documentation and code insights
* Architect AI capabilities for program understanding, dependency discovery, business-rule extraction, data-flow analysis, impact analysis, code summarization, test-case generation, and modernization recommendations
* Contribute to technical assessments, proofs of concept, solution demonstrations, effort estimation, project planning, risk identification, progress reporting, and executive-level presentations
* Partner with customer IBM i SMEs, application owners, business analysts, modernization specialists, AI Tools team members, testing teams, cloud architects, and Technical Leadership across the client and EPAM organizations
* Ensure that the reverse-engineering and modernization solution complies with enterprise architecture standards, customer security policies, source-code handling requirements, data-protection controls, audit requirements, and applicable regulatory obligations

**Requirements**

* 13+ years of experience in enterprise midrange (iSeries or AS/400) technologies, with 5+ years focused on application analysis, reverse engineering, and modernization solutions
* Expertise in RPG III, RPG IV, and RPGLE, including hands-on development, maintenance, and refactoring of large-scale legacy applications
* Proficiency in free-format RPG, CL/CLLE, and COBOL, with the ability to analyze and convert fixed-format code to modern equivalents
* Skills in DDS, DSPFs, and SQL, including designing, interpreting, and optimizing display files, physical/logical files, and complex queries
* Background in Db2 for i, covering database design, performance tuning, journaling, stored procedures, triggers, and DDS-to-DDL conversion
* Understanding of IBM i architecture, including libraries, objects, service programs, printer files, commitment control, and integrated file systems
* Knowledge of reverse engineering techniques for legacy AS/400 applications, including dependency mapping, business-rule extraction, and data-flow tracing
* Familiarity with modernization strategies such as API enablement, web-service integration, UI modernization, application decomposition, cloud migration, and re-platforming
* Competency in application portfolio assessment, technical debt evaluation, code quality analysis, and modernization readiness reviews
* Capability to collaborate with AI Tools teams by defining requirements, validating analysis logic, refining prompts, and improving AI-generated documentation and code insights
* Flexibility to support delivery activities, including proofs of concept, effort estimation, project planning, risk identification, and executive-level presentations
* Showcase of strong stakeholder management skills to engage IBM i SMEs, application owners, business analysts, cloud architects, and technical leadership across client and internal organizations
* Qualifications in governance and compliance, ensuring adherence to enterprise architecture standards, security policies, data-protection controls, and regulatory obligations
* Proficiency in English at an Upper-Intermediate level (B2) or higher

9e7a1662.title: Global Cybersecurity Senior Manager - Architecture
9e7a1662.description:
Who We Are

Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

What You'll Do

As the Infrastructure Security Architect – Secure Data, you will serve as the dedicated security architecture partner for BCG’s Secure Data Engineering Squad, owning the cyber defense governance and technical protection requirements for data security architecture covering data loss prevention, classification enforcement, encryption, and secrets management.

The role operates under the shared accountability model between ISRM Security Architecture and Secure Infrastructure Engineering: ISRM defines how platforms are secured and governed through security standards and architecture strategy; Platform Engineering owns the physical and logical implementation, delivery, and operation of those platforms.

You will ensure the Secure Data portfolio aligns with BCG’s Global Information Security Policy (GISP), the Cybersecurity Control Framework (CSF-10 (Data Protection)), the Security Architecture Reference Model, and the CISA Zero Trust Maturity Model (Data pillar), embedding security from design through delivery while preserving control integrity and audit defensibility.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Define and maintain data security architecture: data loss prevention (DLP), data classification and tagging enforcement, encryption, and data privacy governance interfaces.
* Own architectural requirements for Microsoft Purview enforcement: sensitivity labeling, auto-labeling policy design, DLP policy architecture across endpoints, email, and cloud services.
* Define data classification enforcement architecture in alignment with the Global Data Classification Policy and Global Data Protection Policy, ensuring controls scale with data sensitivity.
* Own encryption and key management architecture requirements for infrastructure-managed data, including interfaces to secrets management and enterprise key management platforms including crypto-agility and post-quantum cryptography (PQC) migration readiness for infrastructure-managed data and key material.
* Define secure data access patterns for infrastructure-managed data stores and application interfaces, preventing unauthorized access, exposure, or tampering.
* Architect DLP coverage for emerging data egress channels, including AI-enabled tooling and agentic workflows, in coordination with Enterprise Security Architecture.
* Author and maintain the security standards, reference architectures, and control requirements that govern the Secure Data domain, mapped to CSF-10 (Data Protection) and ZTMM maturity targets.
* Conduct security architecture reviews for secure data initiatives; issue dispositions, conditions, and architectural decision records traceable to ISRM governance.
* Contribute domain expertise to ZTMM maturity assessments, control gap analyses, and the security architecture roadmap.
* Serve as the dedicated architecture counterpart to the Secure Data Engineering Squad, validating feasibility and effectiveness of security controls through implementation without assuming delivery ownership.
* Define logging, telemetry, and monitoring requirements (CSF-12) for secure data services in partnership with Security Operations, which owns SIEM, detection engineering, and continuous monitoring

What You'll Bring

* Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field or equivalent practical experience.

* 6–10 years in security architecture, security engineering, or infrastructure security with demonstrated architecture responsibility.

* Experience operating in large, audit-sensitive, or regulated enterprise environments with formal governance and exception processes.

* Strong understanding of zero trust architecture (NIST SP 800-207, CISA ZTMM), enterprise control frameworks, and hybrid cloud environments (Azure, AWS, GCP).

* Deep hands-on architecture experience with Microsoft Purview (Information Protection, DLP), enterprise data classification programs, and encryption architecture.

* Working knowledge of key management and secrets management platforms (e.g., HashiCorp Vault, cloud-native KMS/HSM), BYOK patterns, and cryptographic standards lifecycle.

* Familiarity with insider risk, data egress monitoring, and DLP enforcement across endpoint, network, and SaaS channels.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Professional certifications such as CISSP, SABSA, or relevant cloud security certifications.

Who You'll Work With

You will join the Infrastructure Security Architecture team within Information Security Risk Management (ISRM), serving as the dedicated security architecture partner for BCG’s Secure Data Engineering Squad. In this role, you will own the governance and technical architecture requirements that protect data across loss prevention, classification enforcement, encryption, and secrets management.

You will collaborate closely with engineering, cloud, identity, infrastructure, and security teams across BCG’s global technology organization to ensure data security controls are consistently designed, implemented, and governed. You will also partner with Security Operations, Risk Management, and architecture peers to advance Zero Trust Data pillar maturity and support enterprise-wide cybersecurity initiatives.

Working within a highly collaborative, matrixed environment, you will influence technical direction, build alignment on architectural decisions, and help teams deliver secure, scalable solutions that balance business objectives, operational effectiveness, and risk management.

Additional info

At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.

For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.

We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork.

**You’re Good At**

* Translating enterprise security standards into practical, implementable engineering requirements.

* Holding architecture authority constructively: enabling delivery teams rather than blocking them, while keeping governance boundaries intact.

* Communicating precisely across engineering squads, architecture peers, and senior security leadership.

Regular, Full-Time (local employment terms apply)

Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.
