d7064e00.title: Vice President - Product Delivery Manager
d7064e00.description:
**Job Description**
Join our Employee Assistant team for managing deliverables across strategic priorities.
  
  
**Job Summary**
As a
**Product Delivery Manager**
in the Employee Assistant team, you are trusted with enabling the delivery of Agentic AI products in a stable and scalable way. You will work with cross-functional teams, build key relationships, and enable the product to continuously deliver value.
  
  
You will organize project deliverables and activities in accordance with the strategic direction and goals of the organization, evaluate method to assess program strengths and identify areas of improvements, produce accurate and timely reporting of program status throughout its life cycle as well as analyze program risks.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Leads end-to-end product delivery processes including intake, dependency management, release management, product operationalization, delivery feasibility decision-making, and product performance reporting, while escalating opportunities to improve efficiencies and functional coordination
* Leads the completion of change management activities across functional partners and ensures adherence to the firm's risk, controls, compliance, and regulatory requirements
* Effectively manages timelines and dependencies while monitoring blockers, ensuring adequate resourcing, and liaising with stakeholders and functional partners
* Facilitate product planning sessions and Agile ceremonies, contributes ideas and insights, and assists in the execution of product initiatives, ensuring timely and successful feature delivery
* Raises blockers and other impediments to the Strategy & Execution Lead to manage dependencies and ensure adequate resources
* Assist with the planning and delivery of the strategic product roadmap through collaboration with various stakeholders across different functions including external vendors
* Tracks and communicates team progress as it relates to the agreed-upon plan

**Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**

* 5+ years of experience or equivalent expertise in product delivery or a relevant domain area
* Demonstrated ability to execute operational management and change readiness activities
* Strong understanding of delivery and a proven track record of implementing continuous improvement processes
* Experience in product or platform-wide release management, in addition to deployment processes and strategies
* Proficient with MS Office applications (Excel/PowerPoint) and Jira, Jira Align and Confluence

**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**

* Proficient knowledge of the product development life cycle, design, and data analytics

**About Us**
JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.
  
  
We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.
  
  
**About The Team**
Our professionals in our Corporate Functions cover a diverse range of areas from finance and risk to human resources and marketing. Our corporate teams are an essential part of our company, ensuring that we're setting our businesses, clients, customers and employees up for success.
  
  
Human Resources plays a critical role in driving the employee experience, shaping the firm's culture and building a diverse and inclusive workforce. We are a strategic partner to the business — working with leaders across the firm to hire, develop and retain the best people and help meet business goals. Together, we foster a work environment in which our people are supported, feel like they belong and are able to make an impact through their work. We develop and deliver a suite of products and services that help make JPMorgan Chase an employer of choice and drive our business forward.

c3ff769f.title: Data Delivery Manager
c3ff769f.description:
We're looking for a dynamic **Data Delivery Manager** who will lead data solution delivery from start to finish and ensure clients receive top-quality outcomes.

This position requires managing complex data migration, platform, and management projects while building strong client relationships and maintaining best practices in data solution architecture.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Take ownership of end-to-end delivery for assigned accounts
* Act as the single point of accountability for all delivery-related matters, including escalations and client engagement issues
* Ensure delivery management and production processes follow governance aligned with the delivery model
* Coordinate resource allocation to match project roadmaps and required skill sets
* Provide technical leadership to guarantee robust, future-proof architecture and quality standard adherence
* Cultivate and sustain long-term client partnerships
* Identify and manage engagement risks while proactively addressing client concerns
* Coordinate the preparation of proposals and statements of work for customer engagements
* Align projects with organizational processes and agile methodologies
* Ensure clients fulfill their responsibilities to facilitate accountability
* Create delivery plans that include resource estimations and timeframes
* Implement continuous risk management strategies across project lifecycles
* Measure and improve delivery productivity
* Contribute expertise to sales efforts and bid processes to help win new business
* Mentor and coach fellow delivery managers to build talent within the organization
* Participate actively in EPAM's delivery management community
* Support growth and operational management of the local Data Practice

**Requirements**

* 14-20 years of experience with a strong foundation in data delivery management and data solution architecture
* Demonstrated expertise leading complex data migration, platform, or management solution projects
* Strong command of governance processes and delivery models, especially agile approaches
* Experience coordinating multiple disciplines and stakeholders
* Knowledge of developing risk management and productivity improvement strategies
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field
* Ability to deliver technical leadership that ensures sound architecture and technical quality

d08a8b5e.title: Delivery Management Leader – AI productivity solutions
d08a8b5e.description:
We are seeking a **Delivery Management Leader** for AI productivity solutions to drive the successful delivery of high-impact AI programs across diverse industries.

This role requires a strong background in application development (Java/.Net), expertise in cloud platforms (AWS/Azure), and the ability to lead large cross-functional teams in delivering scalable, efficient AI solutions that accelerate time-to-market and business value.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Oversee the end-to-end delivery lifecycle for client engagements, including strategic planning, implementation, governance and post-implementation support
* Ensure delivery metrics such as scope, schedule adherence, quality, budget compliance and operational KPIs are consistently met across all engagements
* Manage multi-project portfolios and large cross-functional teams, fostering collaboration across engineering, quality assurance, business analysis, architecture and DevOps
* Own the program governance model, engaging stakeholders at all delivery levels and maintaining alignment on key deliverables, risks and financial health
* Take full accountability for client portfolio financials, including revenue recognition, profitability, margin improvement, budget forecasting and corrective action planning
* Identify and drive cost optimization and OPEX reduction through automation, resource optimization and enhanced delivery models
* Monitor resource utilization, productivity metrics and workforce optimization strategies to align resources with program outcomes
* Serve as the primary client liaison for senior-level relationships, translating business challenges into actionable delivery strategies and maintaining alignment with client objectives
* Conduct Steering Committee sessions and executive-level communications to provide delivery updates, propose innovations and manage escalations
* Build, lead and mentor large distributed teams, cultivating high performance and driving talent development through mentoring and coaching
* Mediate resource conflicts, resolve escalations and ensure delivery deadlines are met, planning for contingencies with robust mitigation actions
* Identify, assess and mitigate program risks to ensure delivery schedules and client KPIs are not impacted, ensuring continuity of services during high-pressure situations
* Identify up-sell and cross-sell opportunities, develop strategies for expanding the organization’s footprint and partner with sales and pre-sales teams on RFPs, SOWs and business proposals
* Drive continuous innovation for client projects through automation, process enhancements and adoption of emerging technologies, promoting best practices in cloud-native applications, data platforms, AI/ML and DevOps pipelines
* Lead end-to-end AI program delivery, including execution of Agentic AI and AI productivity solutions, management of delivery roadmaps, implementation of AI accelerators, and establishment of KPIs to track and improve delivery efficiency

**Requirements**

* 13 to 15 years of IT experience, with 8+ years in delivery leadership roles and 3+ years in AI/ML projects
* Proven track record of delivering enterprise AI programs, including LLMs, RAG, Agentic AI and automation use cases
* Deep understanding of cloud-native AI services on AWS or Azure
* Expertise in large-scale enterprise programs across industries such as BFSI, Telecom, Healthcare, Retail or Life Sciences
* Strong ability to influence and manage senior-level client stakeholders, including Directors, VPs and CXOs, while building trusted relationships
* Pragmatic leadership approach to resolve escalations, handle conflicts within delivery teams and overcome program challenges effectively
* Familiarity with modern engineering technologies and delivery methods, including cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), microservices and DevOps, data analytics platforms (Tableau, Power BI, BigQuery) and automation frameworks like RPA (UiPath, Blue Prism)
* Understanding of ITIL/ITSM frameworks and SLA-driven managed services delivery
* Knowledge of Agile development methodologies (Scrum, SAFe) and traditional Waterfall-based delivery
* Exceptional leadership, negotiation and decision-making skills for managing high-pressure situations and improving delivery performance
* Ability to thrive in ambiguity and deliver results under challenging timelines
* Strong analytical, communication and interpersonal abilities for fostering team and client collaboration
